apps.name: Calendar
apps.label: Calendar
apps.description: Your upcoming events, read-only. Sign in with Google or Microsoft, connect iCloud, or paste any shared calendar link. Add as many as you like, star the one that should open first, or see them all together.

title.labelOption: Show today's next event on the button

google.name: Google Calendar
steps: Sign in with your Google account.
On the left, under “Settings for my calendars”, click the calendar you want.
Scroll down to “Integrate calendar” and click the eye next to “Secret address in iCal format”.

outlook.name: Outlook
steps: Sign in with your Microsoft account.
Under “Publish a calendar”, pick your calendar and “Can view all details”, then click Publish.
If it was already published, the links show straight away.

icloud.name: iCloud Calendar
steps: Sign in with your Apple Account (you may need to approve it on your iPhone).
In the list of calendars, click the share icon next to the one you want.
Tick “Public Calendar”. Only people with the link can see it.

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en-GB">
<head>

  <style>
    /* The hub theme (src/theme.css) is inlined at the marker below when the library is built. */
    /* Mini Apps theme: Apple Human Interface Guidelines. System colours in light and dark (follows Windows' app mode),
   SF-style type (SF Pro when installed, otherwise the bundled Inter, which is drawn on the same principles),
   the iOS type scale, 8pt spacing, concentric radii and Apple's standard easing. No glass: solid surfaces only.
   Shared by the software centre and every panel. The library build inlines this file into each app page
   at its theme marker, so pages stay self-contained; they then set --primary etc. to their own system colour. */
@font-face {
  font-family: "Inter var"; font-style: normal; font-weight: 100 900; font-display: block;
  src: url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");
}
:root {
  color-scheme: light dark;

  /* Apple system colours, light. "-text" variants are the accessible shades for text on light backgrounds. */
  --blue: #007aff;   --blue-text: #0066cc;
  --green: #34c759;  --green-text: #248a3d;
  --red: #ff3b30;    --red-text: #d70015;
  --orange: #ff9500; --orange-text: #c93400;
  --yellow: #ffcc00; --yellow-text: #a05a00;
  --indigo: #5856d6; --indigo-text: #3634a3;
  --purple: #af52de; --purple-text: #8944ab;
  --pink: #ff2d55;   --pink-text: #d30f45;
  --cyan: #32ade6;   --cyan-text: #0071a4;
  --mint: #00c7be;   --mint-text: #0c817b;

  /* Surfaces, in the order they stack: window, grouped content, controls on content. */
  --bg: #f5f5f7;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --surface-2: #f2f2f4;
  --surface-3: #e8e8ed;
  --fill: rgba(120, 120, 128, .12);      /* resting control fill (segmented track, search fields) */
  --fill-2: rgba(120, 120, 128, .2);     /* hover */
  --line: rgba(60, 60, 67, .13);         /* hairline separators and card edges */
  --line-strong: rgba(60, 60, 67, .29);  /* Apple's separator */
  --text: #1d1d1f;
  --muted: #6e6e73;                      /* secondary label, 4.9:1 on white */
  --faint: #76767b;                      /* tertiary, small labels only, 4.5:1 on white */

  --primary: var(--blue);   --primary-hover: #0077ed; --on-primary: #ffffff; --primary-text: var(--blue-text);
  --primary-tint: rgba(0, 122, 255, .1);
  --teal: var(--green);     --on-teal: #ffffff;       --teal-text: var(--green-text);  /* switches on, success */
  --danger: var(--red);     --danger-text: var(--red-text);

  --shadow-1: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04), 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
  --shadow-2: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
  --shadow-pop: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .1), 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .14), 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06);
  --knob-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
  --focus-ring: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 45%, transparent);   /* follows each app's accent */
  --scrim: rgba(0, 0, 0, .32);

  /* 8pt grid, concentric radii (inner + padding = outer). */
  --space-1: 4px; --space-2: 8px; --space-3: 12px; --space-4: 16px; --space-5: 20px; --space-6: 24px; --space-8: 32px;
  --radius-xs: 6px; --radius-sm: 8px; --radius: 12px; --radius-lg: 16px; --radius-xl: 20px; --radius-full: 999px;

  /* Motion: Apple's default curve and a soft spring-like ease-out (no overshoot on UI chrome). */
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.25, .1, .25, 1);
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1);
  --fast: 180ms;
  --normal: 280ms;

  /* Type: iOS scale. Body text is 14px here (desktop panels), titles follow the scale above it. */
  --font: "SF Pro Text", "Inter var", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-display: "SF Pro Display", "Inter var", "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --mono: "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace;
  --text-caption2: 11px; --text-caption: 12px; --text-footnote: 13px; --text-body: 14px; --text-callout: 15px;
  --text-headline: 17px; --text-title3: 20px; --text-title2: 22px; --text-title1: 28px; --text-large: 34px;
  --track-display: -.022em;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --blue: #0a84ff;   --blue-text: #2997ff;
    --green: #30d158;  --green-text: #30d158;
    --red: #ff453a;    --red-text: #ff6961;
    --orange: #ff9f0a; --orange-text: #ffb340;
    --yellow: #ffd60a; --yellow-text: #ffd426;
    --indigo: #5e5ce6; --indigo-text: #7d7aff;
    --purple: #bf5af2; --purple-text: #da8fff;
    --pink: #ff375f;   --pink-text: #ff6482;
    --cyan: #64d2ff;   --cyan-text: #70d7ff;
    --mint: #63e6e2;   --mint-text: #66d4cf;

    --bg: #161617;
    --surface: #232325;
    --surface-2: #2c2c2e;
    --surface-3: #3a3a3c;
    --fill: rgba(120, 120, 128, .24);
    --fill-2: rgba(120, 120, 128, .34);
    --line: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
    --line-strong: rgba(84, 84, 88, .65);
    --text: #f5f5f7;
    --muted: #a1a1a6;
    --faint: #8e8e93;

    --primary-hover: #409cff;
    --primary-tint: rgba(10, 132, 255, .18);

    --shadow-1: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .06), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3);
    --shadow-2: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .08), 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
    --shadow-pop: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .12), 0 12px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
    --knob-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .16);
    --scrim: rgba(0, 0, 0, .5);
  }
}
html { font-family: var(--font); letter-spacing: -.006em; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { transition-duration: 0ms !important; animation-duration: 0ms !important; }
}
/* Keyboard focus: Apple's soft accent ring on controls. Text fields show focus on their own rounded field instead
   (pages use :focus-within on the wrapper), so the ring never lands on a bare input inside a styled box. */
:where(button, a, summary, select, [tabindex], [role="button"], [role="tab"], [role="radio"], [role="switch"], input[type="checkbox"], input[type="radio"], input[type="range"]):focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); }
:where(input, textarea):focus { outline: none; }
::selection { background: var(--primary-tint); }

    :root { --primary: var(--red); --primary-text: var(--red-text); --on-primary: #fff; --primary-tint: color-mix(in srgb, var(--red) 12%, transparent); }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { transition-duration: 0ms !important; animation-duration: 0ms !important; } }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; }
    body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font: 14px/1.45 var(--font); display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    button { font: inherit; }

    /* ---------- top ---------- */
    .top { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 12px; padding: 18px 20px 14px; }
    .top .grow { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
    .eyebrow { color: var(--primary-text); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .today { font: 600 22px/1.2 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -.01em; margin: 2px 0 0; }
    .icon-btn { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); color: var(--muted);
      display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--fast), color var(--fast); flex: none; }
    .icon-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text); }
    .icon-btn:disabled svg { animation: spin 900ms linear infinite; }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; flex: none; }

    main { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 0 20px 16px; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: var(--line-strong) transparent; }

    /* ---------- next up ---------- */
    .next { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid transparent; box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 14px 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
    .next::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 4px; background: var(--primary); }
    .next.live::before { background: var(--teal); }
    .next .label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .next .title { font: 600 18px/1.3 var(--font-display); margin: 6px 0 4px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
    .next .meta { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }

    /* ---------- agenda ---------- */
    .group { margin-top: 18px; }
    .group h2 { font: 600 13px/1.3 var(--font); color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
    .group h2::after { content: ""; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--line); }
    .day { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 6px 0; }
    .tile { width: 48px; height: 52px; flex: none; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid transparent; box-shadow: var(--shadow-1);
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; line-height: 1.1; }
    .tile .wd { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--primary-text); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; }
    .tile .dn { font: 600 20px/1.1 var(--font-display); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .tile .mo { font-size: 10px; color: var(--faint); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; }
    .day.is-today .tile { background: var(--primary); border-color: var(--primary); }
    .day.is-today .tile .wd, .day.is-today .tile .dn, .day.is-today .tile .mo { color: var(--on-primary); }
    .events { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }

    .ev { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; color: inherit; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 8px 10px; transition: background var(--fast), border-color var(--fast); }
    .ev.has-notes { cursor: pointer; }
    .ev.has-notes:hover { background: var(--surface); border-color: var(--line); }
    .ev .row1 { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; }
    .ev .title { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-weight: 600; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
    .ev .dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--c); flex: none; align-self: center; }
    .ev .meta { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }
    .line { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 6px; }
    .line svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--faint); }
    .line a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
    .line a:hover { color: var(--text); text-decoration: underline; }
    .time { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .pill { flex: none; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; }
    .pill.now { background: var(--teal); color: var(--on-teal); }
    .pill.soon { background: var(--primary-tint); color: var(--primary-text); }
    .notes { display: none; white-space: pre-wrap; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 8px; padding: 10px 12px;
      background: var(--fill); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
    .ev.open .notes { display: block; }
    .chev { width: 14px; height: 14px; color: var(--faint); transition: transform var(--fast); }
    .ev.open .chev { transform: rotate(180deg); }

    /* ---------- states ---------- */
    .state { text-align: center; padding: 40px 20px; color: var(--muted); }
    .state h3 { color: var(--text); font: 600 16px/1.3 var(--font-display); margin: 10px 0 4px; }
    .state .big { width: 40px; height: 40px; color: var(--faint); stroke-width: 1.6; }
    .state.error .big { color: var(--danger-text); }
    .state button { margin-top: 14px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 0; background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }
    .skel { height: 64px; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--surface); margin: 10px 0; animation: pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
    @keyframes pulse { 50% { opacity: .55; } }

    footer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--faint); font-size: 12px; }
    footer .grow { flex: 1; }
    footer .warn { color: var(--danger-text); }
    .eyebrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
    .eyebrow span { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
    .eyebrow svg.fav { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: currentColor; stroke: none; }
    .top { align-items: center; }

    /* ---------- calendars drawer ---------- */
    .scrim { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: var(--scrim); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 200ms ease; z-index: 10; }
    .scrim.show { opacity: 1; }
    .drawer { position: fixed; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: min(320px, 88vw); z-index: 11; background: var(--surface); border-right: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; transform: translateX(-100%); transition: transform 220ms ease-out; box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop); }
    .drawer.show { transform: none; }
    .dhead { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 16px 12px 10px 18px; }
    .dhead b { flex: 1; font: 600 17px var(--font-display); }
    .dbody { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 0 10px 16px; }
    .ditem { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; border-radius: var(--radius); margin-bottom: 2px; }
    .ditem.sel { background: var(--surface-2); }
    .dpick { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--text);
      text-align: left; cursor: pointer; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }
    .dpick:hover { background: var(--surface-3); }
    .dpick .dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--c); flex: none; }
    .dpick .dot.all { background: conic-gradient(#ff3b30 0 33%, #34c759 0 66%, #007aff 0); }
    .dpick .txt { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
    .dpick .txt b { font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
    .dpick .txt small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
    .dpick .txt small.bad { color: var(--danger-text); }
    .mini { width: 34px; height: 34px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: none; color: var(--faint); display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; flex: none; }
    .mini:hover { background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--text); }
    .mini[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--primary-text); }
    .mini[aria-pressed="true"] svg { fill: currentColor; }
    .mini.del:hover { color: var(--danger-text); }
    .dsec { font: 600 12px var(--font); color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 18px 8px 8px; }
    .addform { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 0 8px; }
    .addform label { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }
    .addform input { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--fill); color: var(--text); font: inherit; }
    .addform input:focus { border-color: var(--primary); outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); }
    .addform .err { color: var(--danger-text); font-size: 13px; min-height: 1em; }
    .addform button { min-height: 36px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 0; background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }
    .addform button:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: default; }
    .dnote { color: var(--faint); font-size: 12px; margin: 14px 8px 0; }
    .providers { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 0 8px; }
    .prov { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 52px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius);
      background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; transition: background 150ms, border-color 150ms; }
    .prov:hover { background: var(--surface-3); border-color: var(--line-strong); }
    .prov:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: default; }
    .plogo { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; }
    .plogo svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; fill: initial; stroke: none; }
    .ptxt { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
    .ptxt b { font-weight: 600; }
    .ptxt small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
    .prov.busy small { color: var(--primary-text); }
    .providers .err { color: var(--danger-text); font-size: 13px; min-height: 1em; }
    .acct-pick { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--bg); }
    .acct-pick .who { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; padding: 0 2px 4px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .acct-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 2px; }
    .acct-row span { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .acct-row button { min-height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); background: none; color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; }
    .acct-row button:hover { background: var(--surface-3); }
    .acct-row button:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: default; }
    .acct-pick .done { align-self: flex-end; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--primary-text); font: inherit; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; padding: 6px 2px 0; }
    .paste { margin: 10px 8px 0; }
    .paste summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; padding: 6px 0; list-style-position: inside; }
    .paste summary:hover { color: var(--text); }
    .paste .addform { padding: 6px 0 0; }
    [hidden] { display: none !important; }
  </style>
</head>

          <path fill="#EA4335" d="M152.6 200 200 152.6h-47.4z"/>
          <path fill="#FBBC04" d="M200 47.4h-47.4v105.2H200z"/>
          <path fill="#34A853" d="M152.6 152.6H47.4V200h105.2z"/>
          <path fill="#188038" d="M0 152.6v31.6A15.8 15.8 0 0 0 15.8 200h31.6v-47.4z"/>
          <path fill="#1967D2" d="M200 47.4V15.8A15.8 15.8 0 0 0 184.2 0h-31.6v47.4z"/>
          <path fill="#4285F4" d="M152.6 0H15.8A15.8 15.8 0 0 0 0 15.8v136.8h47.4V47.4h105.2z"/>
          <text x="100" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="64" fill="#4285F4">31</text>

          <rect x="9" y="5" width="21" height="22" rx="2.5" fill="#1490DF"/>
          <rect x="9" y="5" width="21" height="6" rx="2.5" fill="#28A8EA"/>
          <path fill="#0364B8" d="M9 15l10.5 6.5L30 15v9.5a2.5 2.5 0 0 1-2.5 2.5h-16A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 9 24.5z"/>
          <path fill="#28A8EA" d="M9 15v9.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 0 11.5 27h16a2.5 2.5 0 0 0 2.3-1.5z"/>
          <rect x="2" y="9" width="15" height="15" rx="2" fill="#0078D4"/>
          <ellipse cx="9.5" cy="16.5" rx="3.4" ry="4.2" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2.1"/>

        <button type="button" class="prov" data-p="icloud"><span class="plogo" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 32 32">
          <defs><linearGradient id="icg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#3E9BF8"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#1A6EE0"/></linearGradient></defs>
          <rect width="32" height="32" rx="7" fill="#fff"/>
          <path fill="url(#icg)" d="M9.5 23a5 5 0 0 1-.9-9.92 7 7 0 0 1 13.24-1.6A5.75 5.75 0 1 1 22.75 23z"/>
        </svg></span><span class="ptxt"><b>iCloud</b><small>Calendars from your iPhone</small></span></button>

        <div class="err" id="provErr" role="alert"></div>
      </div>
      <details class="paste" id="paste">
        <summary>Paste a link instead</summary>
        <form class="addform" id="addForm">
          <label>Name <input id="addName" placeholder="e.g. Family" autocomplete="off" maxlength="40"></label>
          <label>Link (starts with webcal:// or https://) <input id="addUrl" placeholder="webcal://…" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"></label>
          <div class="err" id="addErr" role="alert"></div>
          <button type="submit" id="addBtn">Add calendar</button>
        </form>
      </details>
      <p class="dnote" id="dnote">The starred calendar is the one that opens first.</p>
    </div>
  </aside>
  <script>
  (() => {
    const HORIZON_DAYS = 180;     // how far ahead to list
    const MAX_EVENTS = 150;
    const REFRESH_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000;
    const COLOURS = ['#ff3b30', '#34c759', '#007aff', '#ff2d55', '#ff9500', '#af52de']; // Apple Calendar's colours
    const DAY = 86400000;
    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

    // ---------- ICS parsing ----------
    function unescapeText(v) { return v.replace(/\\[nN]/g, '\n').replace(/\\([,;\\])/g, '$1'); }

    function parseLine(line) {
      let i = 0, quoted = false;
      for (; i < line.length; i++) {
        const c = line[i];
        if (c === '"') quoted = !quoted;
        else if (c === ':' && !quoted) break;
      }
      const head = line.slice(0, i), value = line.slice(i + 1);
      const parts = head.split(';');
      const params = {};
      for (const p of parts.slice(1)) { const k = p.indexOf('='); if (k > 0) params[p.slice(0, k).toUpperCase()] = p.slice(k + 1).replace(/^"|"$/g, ''); }
      return { name: parts[0].toUpperCase(), params, value };
    }

    const fmtCache = {};
    function tzOffset(tz, ms) {
      const f = fmtCache[tz] || (fmtCache[tz] = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        timeZone: tz, hourCycle: 'h23', year: 'numeric', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric', hour: 'numeric', minute: 'numeric', second: 'numeric',
      }));
      const p = {};
      for (const x of f.formatToParts(new Date(ms))) p[x.type] = x.value;
      return Date.UTC(+p.year, +p.month - 1, +p.day, +p.hour % 24, +p.minute, +p.second) - ms;
    }
    function zoned(y, mo, d, h, mi, s, tz) {
      const guess = Date.UTC(y, mo - 1, d, h, mi, s);
      const off = tzOffset(tz, guess);
      let t = guess - off;
      const off2 = tzOffset(tz, t);
      if (off2 !== off) t = guess - off2;
      return t;
    }

    // -> { ms, allDay } ; dates in a time zone we can't read are treated as this PC's local time
    function parseDate(value, params = {}) {
      const v = value.trim();
      let m = /^(\d{4})(\d\d)(\d\d)$/.exec(v);
      if (m || params.VALUE === 'DATE') {
        m = m || /^(\d{4})(\d\d)(\d\d)/.exec(v);
        return { ms: new Date(+m[1], +m[2] - 1, +m[3]).getTime(), allDay: true };
      }
      m = /^(\d{4})(\d\d)(\d\d)T(\d\d)(\d\d)(\d\d)?(Z)?$/.exec(v);
      if (!m) return null;
      const n = [+m[1], +m[2], +m[3], +m[4], +m[5], +(m[6] || 0)];
      if (m[7]) return { ms: Date.UTC(n[0], n[1] - 1, n[2], n[3], n[4], n[5]), allDay: false };
      if (params.TZID) {
        try { return { ms: zoned(...n, params.TZID.replace(/^\//, '')), allDay: false }; } catch {}
      }
      return { ms: new Date(n[0], n[1] - 1, n[2], n[3], n[4], n[5]).getTime(), allDay: false };
    }

    function parseDuration(v) {
      const m = /^([+-])?P(?:(\d+)W)?(?:(\d+)D)?(?:T(?:(\d+)H)?(?:(\d+)M)?(?:(\d+)S)?)?$/.exec(v.trim());
      if (!m) return 0;
      const ms = (((+m[2] || 0) * 7 + (+m[3] || 0)) * DAY) + ((+m[4] || 0) * 3600 + (+m[5] || 0) * 60 + (+m[6] || 0)) * 1000;
      return m[1] === '-' ? -ms : ms;
    }

    function parseICS(text, calIndex) {
      const lines = text.replace(/\r?\n[ \t]/g, '').split(/\r?\n/);
      const events = [];
      let ev = null, depth = 0, calName = '';
      for (const raw of lines) {
        if (!raw) continue;
        const { name, params, value } = parseLine(raw);
        if (name === 'BEGIN') {
          if (value === 'VEVENT' && !ev) { ev = { exdates: new Set(), cal: calIndex }; depth = 0; }
          else if (ev) depth++;
          continue;
        }
        if (name === 'END') {
          if (ev && value === 'VEVENT' && depth === 0) { events.push(ev); ev = null; }
          else if (ev) depth--;
          continue;
        }
        if (!ev) { if (name === 'X-WR-CALNAME') calName = unescapeText(value); continue; }
        if (depth > 0) continue; // inside VALARM etc.
        switch (name) {
          case 'UID': ev.uid = value; break;
          case 'SUMMARY': ev.summary = unescapeText(value); break;
          case 'LOCATION': ev.location = unescapeText(value); break;
          case 'DESCRIPTION': ev.description = unescapeText(value); break;
          case 'STATUS': ev.status = value.toUpperCase(); break;
          case 'DTSTART': { const d = parseDate(value, params); if (d) { ev.start = d.ms; ev.allDay = d.allDay; } break; }
          case 'DTEND': { const d = parseDate(value, params); if (d) ev.end = d.ms; break; }
          case 'DURATION': ev.duration = parseDuration(value); break;
          case 'RRULE': ev.rrule = Object.fromEntries(value.split(';').map((p) => p.split('=')).map(([k, v]) => [k.toUpperCase(), v])); break;
          case 'EXDATE': for (const x of value.split(',')) { const d = parseDate(x, params); if (d) ev.exdates.add(d.ms); } break;
          case 'RECURRENCE-ID': { const d = parseDate(value, params); if (d) ev.recurrenceId = d.ms; break; }
        }
      }
      for (const e of events) {
        if (e.end === undefined) e.end = e.duration ? e.start + e.duration : e.start + (e.allDay ? DAY : 0);
      }
      return { name: calName, events: events.filter((e) => e.start !== undefined) };
    }

    // ---------- repeating events ----------
    const WD = ['SU', 'MO', 'TU', 'WE', 'TH', 'FR', 'SA'];
    function nthWeekday(year, month, wd, ord, s) {
      if (ord > 0) {
        const first = new Date(year, month, 1).getDay();
        const day = 1 + ((wd - first + 7) % 7) + (ord - 1) * 7;
        const d = new Date(year, month, day, s.getHours(), s.getMinutes(), s.getSeconds());
        return d.getMonth() === ((month % 12) + 12) % 12 ? d : null;
      }
      const lastDay = new Date(year, month + 1, 0);
      const day = lastDay.getDate() - ((lastDay.getDay() - wd + 7) % 7) + (ord + 1) * 7;
      if (day < 1) return null;
      return new Date(year, month, day, s.getHours(), s.getMinutes(), s.getSeconds());
    }
    function allWeekdays(year, month, wd, s) {
      const out = [];
      for (let ord = 1; ord <= 5; ord++) { const d = nthWeekday(year, month, wd, ord, s); if (d) out.push(d); }
      return out;
    }
    function dayOf(year, month, md, s) {
      const last = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
      const day = md > 0 ? md : last + md + 1;
      if (day < 1 || day > last) return null;
      return new Date(year, month, day, s.getHours(), s.getMinutes(), s.getSeconds());
    }

    function candidates(r, s, i) {
      const interval = Math.max(1, +r.INTERVAL || 1);
      const byday = r.BYDAY ? r.BYDAY.split(',').map((c) => ({ ord: parseInt(c, 10) || 0, wd: WD.indexOf(c.slice(-2)) })) : null;
      const bymd = r.BYMONTHDAY ? r.BYMONTHDAY.split(',').map(Number) : null;
      const at = (y, mo, d) => new Date(y, mo, d, s.getHours(), s.getMinutes(), s.getSeconds());
      const monthDays = (y, mo) => {
        if (byday) return byday.flatMap((b) => (b.ord ? [nthWeekday(y, mo, b.wd, b.ord, s)] : allWeekdays(y, mo, b.wd, s)));
        if (bymd) return bymd.map((md) => dayOf(y, mo, md, s));
        return [dayOf(y, mo, s.getDate(), s)];
      };
      switch (r.FREQ) {
        case 'DAILY': return [at(s.getFullYear(), s.getMonth(), s.getDate() + i * interval)];
        case 'WEEKLY': {
          const base = s.getDate() - s.getDay() + i * 7 * interval;
          const days = byday ? byday.map((b) => b.wd) : [s.getDay()];
          return days.map((wd) => at(s.getFullYear(), s.getMonth(), base + wd));
        }
        case 'MONTHLY': {
          const mo = s.getMonth() + i * interval;
          return monthDays(s.getFullYear() + Math.floor(mo / 12), ((mo % 12) + 12) % 12);
        }
        case 'YEARLY': {
          const y = s.getFullYear() + i * interval;
          const months = r.BYMONTH ? r.BYMONTH.split(',').map((x) => +x - 1) : [s.getMonth()];
          if (!r.BYMONTH && !byday && !bymd) return [dayOf(y, s.getMonth(), s.getDate(), s)];
          return months.flatMap((mo) => monthDays(y, mo));
        }
        default: return [];
      }
    }

    function expand(e, from, to, overrides) {
      const dur = e.end - e.start;
      if (!e.rrule) return e.end > from && e.start < to ? [e.start] : [];
      const r = e.rrule;
      const count = r.COUNT ? +r.COUNT : Infinity;
      let until = Infinity;
      if (r.UNTIL) { const u = parseDate(r.UNTIL); if (u) until = u.ms + (u.allDay ? DAY - 1 : 0); }
      const s = new Date(e.start);
      const out = [];
      let n = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < 50000; i++) {
        const list = candidates(r, s, i).filter(Boolean).map((d) => d.getTime()).sort((a, b) => a - b);
        if (!list.length) { if (r.FREQ !== 'MONTHLY' && r.FREQ !== 'YEARLY') return out; continue; }
        for (const t of list) {
          if (t < e.start) continue;
          if (t > until || n >= count) return out;
          n++;
          if (t >= to) return out;
          if (e.exdates.has(t) || (overrides && overrides.has(t))) continue;
          if (t + dur > from) out.push(t);
        }
      }
      return out;
    }

    function upcoming(calendars) {
      const now = Date.now();
      const today = new Date(); today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      const from = today.getTime();
      const to = from + HORIZON_DAYS * DAY;
      const all = calendars.flatMap((c) => c.events);
      const overrides = new Map(); // uid -> Set(recurrence-id times)
      for (const e of all) if (e.recurrenceId !== undefined && e.uid) {
        if (!overrides.has(e.uid)) overrides.set(e.uid, new Set());
        overrides.get(e.uid).add(e.recurrenceId);
      }
      const out = [];
      for (const e of all) {
        if (e.status === 'CANCELLED') continue;
        const ov = e.recurrenceId === undefined ? overrides.get(e.uid) : null;
        for (const t of expand(e, from, to, ov)) out.push({ ...e, start: t, end: t + (e.end - e.start) });
      }
      return out.filter((e) => e.end > now || (e.allDay && e.end > from))
        .sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start || (b.allDay - a.allDay) || (a.summary || '').localeCompare(b.summary || ''))
        .slice(0, MAX_EVENTS);
    }

    // ---------- view ----------
    const ICON = {
      clock: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v5l3 2"/></svg>',
      pin: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 21s-7-6.2-7-11.5A7 7 0 0 1 19 9.5C19 14.8 12 21 12 21z"/><circle cx="12" cy="9.5" r="2.5"/></svg>',
      chev: '<svg class="chev" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/></svg>',
      cal: '<svg class="big" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="16" rx="3"/><path d="M3 10h18M8 3v4M16 3v4"/></svg>',
      star: '<svg class="fav" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 3.5l2.6 5.3 5.8.8-4.2 4.1 1 5.8L12 16.8l-5.2 2.7 1-5.8-4.2-4.1 5.8-.8z"/></svg>',
      starLine: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 3.5l2.6 5.3 5.8.8-4.2 4.1 1 5.8L12 16.8l-5.2 2.7 1-5.8-4.2-4.1 5.8-.8z"/></svg>',
      bin: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 7h16M9 7V4h6v3M6 7l1 13h10l1-13"/></svg>',
      off: '<svg class="big" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 9v4M12 17h.01"/><path d="M10.3 3.9 2.4 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.7 3h15.8a2 2 0 0 0 1.7-3L13.7 3.9a2 2 0 0 0-3.4 0z"/></svg>',
    };
    function h(tag, cls, text) { const el = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) el.className = cls; if (text !== undefined) el.textContent = text; return el; }
    function icon(name) { const t = document.createElement('template'); t.innerHTML = ICON[name]; return t.content.firstChild; }

    const time = (ms) => new Date(ms).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    const longDay = (ms) => new Date(ms).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
    const dayStart = (ms) => { const d = new Date(ms); d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0); return d.getTime(); };
    const daysBetween = (a, b) => Math.round((dayStart(b) - dayStart(a)) / DAY);
    const weekStart = (ms) => { const d = new Date(dayStart(ms)); d.setDate(d.getDate() - ((d.getDay() + 6) % 7)); return d.getTime(); }; // Monday

    function whenText(e) {
      if (e.allDay) {
        const lastDay = e.end - DAY;
        return dayStart(lastDay) > dayStart(e.start) ? `All day · until ${longDay(lastDay)}` : 'All day';
      }
      if (dayStart(e.end - 1) === dayStart(e.start)) return e.end > e.start ? `${time(e.start)} – ${time(e.end)}` : time(e.start);
      return `${time(e.start)} → ${longDay(e.end)}, ${time(e.end)}`;
    }

    function relative(e) {
      const now = Date.now();
      if (e.start <= now && e.end > now) return { text: e.allDay ? 'Today' : 'Now', cls: 'now' };
      const days = daysBetween(now, e.start);
      if (days <= 0) {
        if (e.allDay) return { text: 'Today', cls: 'soon' };
        const mins = Math.round((e.start - now) / 60000);
        if (mins < 60) return { text: `in ${mins} min`, cls: 'soon' };
        const hrs = Math.round(mins / 60);
        return { text: hrs === 1 ? 'in 1 hour' : `in ${hrs} hours`, cls: 'soon' };
      }
      if (days === 1) return { text: 'Tomorrow', cls: 'soon' };
      if (days < 14) return { text: `in ${days} days`, cls: '' };
      if (days < 30) return { text: `in ${Math.round(days / 7)} weeks`, cls: '' };
      const months = Math.round(days / 30.4);
      return { text: months <= 1 ? 'in a month' : `in ${months} months`, cls: '' };
    }

    function groupName(ms) {
      const now = Date.now();
      const d = daysBetween(now, ms);
      if (d <= 0) return 'Today';
      if (d === 1) return 'Tomorrow';
      const ws = weekStart(now);
      if (ms < ws + 7 * DAY) return 'Later this week';
      if (ms < ws + 14 * DAY) return 'Next week';
      const dt = new Date(ms);
      const sameYear = dt.getFullYear() === new Date(now).getFullYear();
      return dt.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', sameYear ? { month: 'long' } : { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
    }

    function metaLines(e) {
      const meta = h('div', 'meta');
      const l1 = h('div', 'line');
      l1.append(icon('clock'), h('span', 'time', whenText(e)));
      meta.append(l1);
      if (e.location) {
        const l2 = h('div', 'line');
        const place = e.location.replace(/\n/g, ', ');
        const a = h('a', '', place);
        a.href = `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(place)}`;
        a.target = '_blank';
        a.title = 'Open in Maps';
        a.addEventListener('click', (ev) => ev.stopPropagation());
        l2.append(icon('pin'), a);
        meta.append(l2);
      }
      return meta;
    }

    function eventEl(e, multiCal) {
      const hasNotes = !!(e.description && e.description.trim());
      const el = h(hasNotes ? 'button' : 'div', `ev${hasNotes ? ' has-notes' : ''}`);
      if (hasNotes) { el.type = 'button'; el.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'); }
      el.style.setProperty('--c', COLOURS[e.cal % COLOURS.length]);
      const row1 = h('div', 'row1');
      if (multiCal) row1.append(h('span', 'dot'));
      const rel = relative(e);
      row1.append(h('span', 'title', e.summary || '(No title)'), h('span', `pill ${rel.cls}`, rel.text));
      if (hasNotes) row1.append(icon('chev'));
      el.append(row1, metaLines(e));
      if (hasNotes) {
        el.append(h('div', 'notes', e.description.trim()));
        el.addEventListener('click', () => {
          el.classList.toggle('open');
          el.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(el.classList.contains('open')));
        });
      }
      return el;
    }

    function nextCard(e) {
      const rel = relative(e);
      const card = h('section', `next${rel.cls === 'now' ? ' live' : ''}`);
      const label = h('div', 'label', rel.cls === 'now' ? 'Happening now' : 'Next up');
      label.append(h('span', `pill ${rel.cls}`, rel.cls === 'now' ? (e.allDay ? 'All day' : `until ${time(e.end)}`) : rel.text));
      const meta = metaLines(e);
      if (daysBetween(Date.now(), e.start) > 0) meta.firstChild.lastChild.textContent = `${longDay(e.start)} · ${whenText(e)}`;
      card.append(label, h('div', 'title', e.summary || '(No title)'), meta);
      return card;
    }

    function stateEl(kind, title, text, action, onAction) {
      const box = h('div', `state${kind === 'error' ? ' error' : ''}`);
      box.append(icon(kind === 'error' ? 'off' : 'cal'), h('h3', '', title), h('div', '', text));
      if (action) { const b = h('button', '', action); b.type = 'button'; b.addEventListener('click', onAction || load); box.append(b); }
      return box;
    }

    // ---------- calendars: list, favourite, selection ----------
    // store.calendars = [{ id, name, url }] or, signed in (1.4.0+, hub 1.5.0+), [{ id, name, account, provider, calId }];
    // store.favourite = a calendar id, or 'all'.
    // Older hubs (before 1.4) have no store: then the list comes from the setup links, read-only.
    const canStore = !!(window.miniPage && window.miniPage.store);
    const RESET_AFTER = 2 * 60 * 1000;   // hidden this long → reopen on the favourite
    let store = {};
    let cals = [];            // the list
    const parsed = {};        // id → { cal, error }
    let selected = null;      // id or 'all'
    let loadedAt = 0;
    let loading = false;
    let hiddenAt = 0;

    const nameOf = (c) => (c.name || (parsed[c.id] && parsed[c.id].cal && parsed[c.id].cal.name) || 'Calendar').trim();
    const colourOf = (c) => COLOURS[cals.indexOf(c) % COLOURS.length];
    function validSel(id) {
      if (id === 'all' && cals.length > 1) return 'all';
      if (cals.some((c) => c.id === id)) return id;
      return cals.length > 1 ? 'all' : cals[0] ? cals[0].id : null;
    }
    const favourite = () => validSel(store.favourite);
    const shownCals = (sel) => (sel === 'all' ? cals : cals.filter((c) => c.id === sel));
    const loadedFor = (sel) => shownCals(sel).map((c) => parsed[c.id] && parsed[c.id].cal).filter(Boolean);

    async function initCals() {
      const values = await window.miniPage.values();
      const urls = String(values.calendar || '').split(/[\s,]+/).filter(Boolean);
      if (canStore) {
        store = await window.miniPage.store.get();
        if (!Array.isArray(store.calendars)) {   // first run: bring over the link(s) given at install
          const calendars = urls.map((url, i) => ({ id: `c${i + 1}`, name: '', url }));
          store = await window.miniPage.store.set({ calendars, favourite: calendars.length > 1 ? 'all' : calendars[0] ? calendars[0].id : null });
        }
        cals = store.calendars;
      } else {
        cals = urls.map((url, i) => ({ id: `c${i + 1}`, name: '', url }));
      }
      selected = favourite();
    }
    async function saveCals(patch) {
      store = await window.miniPage.store.set(patch);
      cals = store.calendars || [];
    }

    function render() {
      $('today').textContent = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' });
      const main = $('main');
      const open = new Set([...main.querySelectorAll('.ev.open')].map((x) => x.dataset.key));
      const scroll = main.scrollTop;
      selected = validSel(selected);
      const calendars = loadedFor(selected);
      const events = upcoming(calendars);
      const multiCal = calendars.length > 1;
      const errs = shownCals(selected).map((c) => parsed[c.id] && parsed[c.id].error).filter(Boolean);
      const lastError = errs.length ? (calendars.length ? `${errs.length} calendar${errs.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} failed: ${errs[0]}` : errs[0]) : '';

      const eb = $('calName');
      eb.replaceChildren();
      if (selected && selected === favourite() && cals.length > 1) eb.append(icon('star'));
      eb.append(h('span', '', !selected ? 'Calendar' : selected === 'all' ? 'All calendars' : nameOf(cals.find((c) => c.id === selected))));

      if (!cals.length) main.replaceChildren(stateEl('empty', 'No calendars yet', 'Connect Google, Outlook or iCloud to see your events here.', 'Add a calendar', () => openDrawer(true)));
      else if (!calendars.length && lastError) main.replaceChildren(stateEl('error', "Couldn't load this calendar", lastError, 'Try again'));
      else if (!calendars.length) main.replaceChildren(...[1, 2, 3].map(() => h('div', 'skel')));
      else if (!events.length) main.replaceChildren(stateEl('empty', 'Nothing coming up', 'Your next six months are clear.'));
      else {
        const parts = [nextCard(events[0])];
        const todayStart = dayStart(Date.now());
        let group = null;
        let day = null;
        for (const e of events.slice(1)) { // the first one is already in the "Next up" card
          const key = Math.max(dayStart(e.start), todayStart); // ongoing multi-day events show under today
          const gName = groupName(key);
          if (!group || group.name !== gName) {
            group = { name: gName, el: h('section', 'group') };
            group.el.append(h('h2', '', gName));
            parts.push(group.el);
            day = null;
          }
          if (!day || day.key !== key) {
            const dt = new Date(key);
            const row = h('div', `day${key === todayStart ? ' is-today' : ''}`);
            const tile = h('div', 'tile');
            tile.append(h('span', 'wd', dt.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { weekday: 'short' })),
              h('span', 'dn', String(dt.getDate())),
              h('span', 'mo', dt.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { month: 'short' })));
            tile.setAttribute('aria-label', longDay(key));
            day = { key, list: h('div', 'events') };
            row.append(tile, day.list);
            group.el.append(row);
          }
          const el = eventEl(e, multiCal);
          el.dataset.key = `${e.uid}|${e.start}`;
          if (open.has(el.dataset.key)) { el.classList.add('open'); el.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true'); }
          day.list.append(el);
        }
        main.replaceChildren(...parts);
        main.scrollTop = scroll;
      }

      // The taskbar button shows today's next event from the favourite calendar.
      const now = Date.now();
      const favEvents = favourite() === selected ? events : upcoming(loadedFor(favourite()));
      const next = favEvents.find((e) => !e.allDay && e.end > now && dayStart(e.start) <= dayStart(now));
      document.title = next ? `${next.start <= now ? 'Now' : time(next.start)} ${next.summary || ''}`.trim() : 'Calendar';

      const status = $('status');
      status.className = lastError && calendars.length ? 'warn' : '';
      status.textContent = loading ? 'Refreshing…' : lastError && calendars.length ? `Couldn't refresh · ${lastError}` : loadedAt ? `Updated ${time(loadedAt)}` : '';
      $('cals').textContent = selected === 'all' ? shownCals('all').map(nameOf).join(' · ') : '';
      if ($('drawer').classList.contains('show')) renderDrawer();
    }

    const cleanErr = (e) => String((e && e.message) || e).replace(/^Error invoking remote method '[^']+': (Error: )?/, '');
    // ---------- signed-in accounts (hub 1.5.0+) ----------
    const accounts = window.miniPage && window.miniPage.accounts;
    let oauth = [];   // providers this hub can sign in with: 'google', 'microsoft'
    const OAUTH_FOR = { google: 'google', outlook: 'microsoft' };
    async function api(key, url, headers) {
      const r = await accounts.request(key, { url, headers });
      if (r.status === 401 || r.status === 403) throw new Error('Sign in again (remove it and add it back)');
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`the calendar service said ${r.status}`);
      return JSON.parse(r.text);
    }
    const dateOnly = (d) => { const [y, m, dd] = String(d).slice(0, 10).split('-').map(Number); return new Date(y, m - 1, dd).getTime(); };
    async function fetchApi(c, index) {
      const from = new Date(Date.now() - DAY), to = new Date(Date.now() + HORIZON_DAYS * DAY);
      const events = [];
      if (c.provider === 'google') {
        let page = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
          const q = new URLSearchParams({ singleEvents: 'true', orderBy: 'startTime', timeMin: from.toISOString(), timeMax: to.toISOString(), maxResults: '250' });
          if (page) q.set('pageToken', page);
          const j = await api(c.account, `https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/${encodeURIComponent(c.calId)}/events?${q}`);
          for (const e of j.items || []) {
            if (e.status === 'cancelled' || !e.start) continue;
            const allDay = !e.start.dateTime;
            const start = allDay ? dateOnly(e.start.date) : Date.parse(e.start.dateTime);
            const end = e.end ? (allDay ? dateOnly(e.end.date) : Date.parse(e.end.dateTime)) : start + (allDay ? DAY : 0);
            events.push({ uid: e.id, summary: e.summary || '(No title)', location: e.location || '', description: e.description || '', status: (e.status || '').toUpperCase(),
              start, end, allDay, cal: index, exdates: new Set() });
          }
          page = j.nextPageToken;
          if (!page || events.length >= MAX_EVENTS) break;
        }
      } else {
        let url = `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/calendars/${encodeURIComponent(c.calId)}/calendarView?${new URLSearchParams({
          startDateTime: from.toISOString(), endDateTime: to.toISOString(), $top: '250', $orderby: 'start/dateTime',
          $select: 'id,subject,location,bodyPreview,start,end,isAllDay,isCancelled' })}`;
        for (let i = 0; i < 4 && url; i++) {
          const j = await api(c.account, url, { prefer: 'outlook.timezone="UTC"' });
          for (const e of j.value || []) {
            if (e.isCancelled || !e.start) continue;
            const allDay = !!e.isAllDay;
            const t = (x) => (allDay ? dateOnly(x.dateTime) : Date.parse(/Z$|[+-]\d\d:\d\d$/.test(x.dateTime) ? x.dateTime : x.dateTime + 'Z'));
            const start = t(e.start), end = e.end ? t(e.end) : start;
            events.push({ uid: e.id, summary: e.subject || '(No title)', location: (e.location && e.location.displayName) || '', description: e.bodyPreview || '',
              status: '', start, end, allDay, cal: index, exdates: new Set() });
          }
          const next = j['@odata.nextLink'];
          url = next && /^https:\/\/graph\.microsoft\.com\//.test(next) ? next : '';
          if (events.length >= MAX_EVENTS) break;
        }
      }
      return { name: c.name, events };
    }

    async function fetchCal(c) {
      if (c.account) {
        try {
          if (!accounts) throw new Error('Update Mini Apps (Check for updates) to use this calendar');
          parsed[c.id] = { cal: await fetchApi(c, cals.indexOf(c)), error: '' };
        } catch (err) {
          parsed[c.id] = { cal: parsed[c.id] && parsed[c.id].cal, error: cleanErr(err) };
        }
        return parsed[c.id];
      }
      try {
        const text = await window.miniPage.fetchText(c.url);
        if (!/BEGIN:VCALENDAR/.test(text)) throw new Error("that link isn't a calendar");
        parsed[c.id] = { cal: parseICS(text, cals.indexOf(c)), error: '' };
      } catch (err) {
        parsed[c.id] = { cal: parsed[c.id] && parsed[c.id].cal, error: cleanErr(err) };
      }
      return parsed[c.id];
    }

    async function load() {
      if (loading) return;
      loading = true;
      $('refresh').disabled = true;
      render();
      try {
        await Promise.all(cals.map(fetchCal));
        loadedAt = Date.now();
        window.miniPage.log(`loaded ${cals.filter((c) => parsed[c.id].cal).length}/${cals.length} calendars`);
      } finally {
        loading = false;
        $('refresh').disabled = false;
        render();
      }
    }

    // ---------- the calendars menu ----------
    function renderDrawer() {
      const list = $('dlist');
      const fav = favourite();
      const items = cals.length > 1 ? [{ id: 'all' }, ...cals] : cals;
      list.replaceChildren(...items.map((c) => {
        const all = c.id === 'all';
        const row = h('div', `ditem${c.id === selected ? ' sel' : ''}`);
        const pick = h('button', 'dpick'); pick.type = 'button';
        const dot = h('span', `dot${all ? ' all' : ''}`); if (!all) dot.style.setProperty('--c', colourOf(c));
        const txt = h('span', 'txt');
        const p = parsed[c.id];
        const sub = all ? `${cals.length} calendars together` : p && p.error ? p.error : p && p.cal ? `${upcoming([p.cal]).length} upcoming` : 'Loading…';
        txt.append(h('b', '', all ? 'All calendars' : nameOf(c)), h('small', !all && p && p.error ? 'bad' : '', sub));
        pick.append(dot, txt);
        pick.setAttribute('aria-current', String(c.id === selected));
        pick.addEventListener('click', () => { selected = c.id; closeDrawer(); render(); $('main').scrollTop = 0; });
        row.append(pick);
        if (canStore && (cals.length > 1 || !all)) {
          const star = h('button', 'mini'); star.type = 'button';
          star.append(icon('starLine'));
          star.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(fav === c.id));
          star.setAttribute('aria-label', fav === c.id ? `${all ? 'All calendars' : nameOf(c)} opens first` : `Open ${all ? 'all calendars' : nameOf(c)} first`);
          star.title = fav === c.id ? 'Opens first' : 'Open this first';
          star.addEventListener('click', async () => { await saveCals({ favourite: c.id }); render(); renderDrawer(); });
          row.append(star);
        }
        if (canStore && !all) {
          const del = h('button', 'mini del'); del.type = 'button';
          del.append(icon('bin'));
          del.setAttribute('aria-label', `Remove ${nameOf(c)}`); del.title = 'Remove';
          del.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            if (!confirm(`Remove "${nameOf(c)}" from this app? ${c.account ? 'You can add it again by signing in.' : 'You can add it again with its link.'}`)) return;
            delete parsed[c.id];
            const rest = cals.filter((x) => x.id !== c.id);
            await saveCals({ calendars: rest, favourite: store.favourite === c.id ? null : store.favourite });
            if (c.account && accounts && !rest.some((x) => x.account === c.account)) accounts.signOut(c.account).catch(() => {});
            selected = validSel(selected === c.id ? favourite() : selected);
            render(); renderDrawer();
          });
          row.append(del);
        }
        return row;
      }));
      if (!cals.length) list.append(h('p', 'dnote', 'No calendars yet. Add one below.'));
      $('providers').hidden = !canStore; $('paste').hidden = !canStore;
      $('dnote').textContent = canStore ? (cals.length > 1 ? 'The starred one opens first.' : '') : 'Update Mini Apps (Check for updates) to add more calendars here.';
    }

    let lastFocus = null;
    function openDrawer(focusAdd) {
      lastFocus = document.activeElement;
      renderDrawer();
      $('drawer').hidden = false; $('scrim').hidden = false;
      requestAnimationFrame(() => { $('drawer').classList.add('show'); $('scrim').classList.add('show'); });
      $('menu').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      setTimeout(() => (focusAdd && canStore ? document.querySelector('.prov') : $('drawer').querySelector('.dpick') || $('dclose')).focus(), 60);
    }
    function closeDrawer() {
      $('drawer').classList.remove('show'); $('scrim').classList.remove('show');
      $('menu').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      setTimeout(() => { $('drawer').hidden = true; $('scrim').hidden = true; }, 230);
      if (lastFocus && lastFocus.focus) lastFocus.focus();
    }
    $('menu').addEventListener('click', () => openDrawer(false));
    $('dclose').addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
    $('scrim').addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape' && !$('drawer').hidden) closeDrawer(); });

    // Adds a calendar by link; returns an error message, or '' when it worked.
    async function addCalendar(url, name) {
      if (cals.some((c) => c.url === url)) return 'That calendar is already in the list.';
      const id = `c${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
      await saveCals({ calendars: [...cals, { id, name, url }] });   // saved first, so the hub allows the download
      const c = cals.find((x) => x.id === id);
      const res = await fetchCal(c);
      if (!res.cal) {
        delete parsed[id];
        await saveCals({ calendars: cals.filter((x) => x.id !== id) });
        return `Couldn't add it: ${res.error}`;
      }
      if (cals.length === 1) await saveCals({ favourite: id });
      selected = id;
      closeDrawer();
      render();
      return '';
    }

    $('addForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const url = $('addUrl').value.trim();
      const name = $('addName').value.trim();
      const err = $('addErr');
      if (!/^(webcals?|https?):\/\/\S+$/i.test(url)) { err.textContent = 'Paste the calendar\'s link, starting with webcal:// or https://'; $('addUrl').focus(); return; }
      err.textContent = '';
      $('addBtn').disabled = true; $('addBtn').textContent = 'Checking the link…';
      err.textContent = await addCalendar(url, name);
      $('addBtn').disabled = false; $('addBtn').textContent = 'Add calendar';
      if (!err.textContent) { $('addUrl').value = ''; $('addName').value = ''; }
    });

    // Google / Outlook / iCloud: the hub opens their site; the person signs in and follows the steps,
    // and the calendar's link comes back here by itself.
    const PROV_NAMES = { google: 'Google', outlook: 'Outlook', icloud: 'iCloud' };
    document.querySelectorAll('.prov').forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const p = btn.dataset.p;
      const err = $('provErr');
      const small = btn.querySelector('small');
      const was = small.textContent;
      err.textContent = '';
      if (OAUTH_FOR[p] && oauth.includes(OAUTH_FOR[p])) { signInWith(btn, OAUTH_FOR[p]); return; }
      if (!window.miniPage.connect) { err.textContent = 'Update Mini Apps (Check for updates) to use this.'; return; }
      document.querySelectorAll('.prov').forEach((b) => { b.disabled = true; });
      btn.classList.add('busy'); small.textContent = 'Finish in the window that opened…';
      try {
        const url = await window.miniPage.connect(p);
        if (url) {
          small.textContent = 'Adding it…';
          err.textContent = await addCalendar(url, PROV_NAMES[p]);
        }
      } catch (e2) {
        err.textContent = `Couldn't connect: ${e2.message.replace(/^Error invoking remote method '[^']+': (Error: )?/, '')}`;
      }
      btn.classList.remove('busy'); small.textContent = was;
      document.querySelectorAll('.prov').forEach((b) => { b.disabled = false; });
    }));

    // Signing in opens the browser; then the person picks which of that account's calendars to show.
    async function signInWith(btn, provider) {
      const err = $('provErr');
      const small = btn.querySelector('small');
      const was = small.textContent;
      document.querySelectorAll('.prov').forEach((b) => { b.disabled = true; });
      btn.classList.add('busy'); small.textContent = 'Finish signing in in your browser…';
      try {
        const acct = await accounts.signIn(provider);
        small.textContent = 'Getting your calendars…';
        const list = provider === 'google'
          ? ((await api(acct.key, 'https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/users/me/calendarList?minAccessRole=reader')).items || [])
            .map((x) => ({ calId: x.id, name: x.summaryOverride || x.summary || 'Calendar', main: !!x.primary }))
          : ((await api(acct.key, 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/calendars?$select=id,name,isDefaultCalendar&$top=50')).value || [])
            .map((x) => ({ calId: x.id, name: x.name || 'Calendar', main: !!x.isDefaultCalendar }));
        list.sort((a, b) => b.main - a.main);
        showPicker(acct, provider, list);
      } catch (e2) {
        err.textContent = `Couldn't sign in: ${cleanErr(e2)}`;
      }
      btn.classList.remove('busy'); small.textContent = was;
      document.querySelectorAll('.prov').forEach((b) => { b.disabled = false; });
    }
    function showPicker(acct, provider, list) {
      const box = $('acctPick');
      const has = (x) => cals.some((c) => c.account === acct.key && c.calId === x.calId);
      const draw = () => {
        const done = h('button', 'done', 'Done'); done.type = 'button';
        done.addEventListener('click', () => { box.hidden = true; if (!cals.some((c) => c.account === acct.key)) accounts.signOut(acct.key).catch(() => {}); });
        box.replaceChildren(h('div', 'who', list.length ? `Signed in as ${acct.email || 'your account'}. Pick calendars to show:` : 'There are no calendars on this account.'),
          ...list.map((x) => {
            const row = h('div', 'acct-row');
            const b = h('button', '', has(x) ? 'Added' : 'Add'); b.type = 'button'; b.disabled = has(x);
            b.addEventListener('click', async () => {
              b.disabled = true; b.textContent = 'Adding…';
              const id = `c${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
              await saveCals({ calendars: [...cals, { id, name: x.name, account: acct.key, provider, calId: x.calId }] });
              const res = await fetchCal(cals.find((y) => y.id === id));
              if (!res.cal) { delete parsed[id]; await saveCals({ calendars: cals.filter((y) => y.id !== id) }); $('provErr').textContent = `Couldn't add it: ${res.error}`; }
              else { if (cals.length === 1) await saveCals({ favourite: id }); if (cals.length === 1 || !selected) selected = id; }
              render(); renderDrawer(); draw();
            });
            row.append(h('span', '', x.name + (x.main ? ' (main)' : '')), b);
            return row;
          }), done);
      };
      draw();
      box.hidden = false;
      const first = box.querySelector('.acct-row button:not(:disabled)');
      if (first) first.focus();
    }

    // Reopening the panel after a while goes back to the favourite.
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
      if (document.hidden) { hiddenAt = Date.now(); return; }
      if (hiddenAt && Date.now() - hiddenAt > RESET_AFTER && $('drawer').hidden) { selected = favourite(); render(); $('main').scrollTop = 0; }
      hiddenAt = 0;
    });

    $('refresh').addEventListener('click', load);
    initCals().then(async () => { if (accounts) { try { oauth = await accounts.available(); } catch {} } }).then(load).catch((err) => { window.miniPage.log(`start failed: ${err.message}`); render(); });
    setInterval(load, REFRESH_MS);
    setInterval(render, 60 * 1000);
    window.addEventListener('online', load);
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en-GB">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:">
  <title>Hue</title>
  <style>
    /* The hub theme (src/theme.css) is inlined at the marker below when the library is built. */
    /* Mini Apps theme: Apple Human Interface Guidelines. System colours in light and dark (follows Windows' app mode),
   SF-style type (SF Pro when installed, otherwise the bundled Inter, which is drawn on the same principles),
   the iOS type scale, 8pt spacing, concentric radii and Apple's standard easing. No glass: solid surfaces only.
   Shared by the software centre and every panel. The library build inlines this file into each app page
   at its theme marker, so pages stay self-contained; they then set --primary etc. to their own system colour. */
@font-face {
  font-family: "Inter var"; font-style: normal; font-weight: 100 900; font-display: block;
  src: url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");
}
:root {
  color-scheme: light dark;

  /* Apple system colours, light. "-text" variants are the accessible shades for text on light backgrounds. */
  --blue: #007aff;   --blue-text: #0066cc;
  --green: #34c759;  --green-text: #248a3d;
  --red: #ff3b30;    --red-text: #d70015;
  --orange: #ff9500; --orange-text: #c93400;
  --yellow: #ffcc00; --yellow-text: #a05a00;
  --indigo: #5856d6; --indigo-text: #3634a3;
  --purple: #af52de; --purple-text: #8944ab;
  --pink: #ff2d55;   --pink-text: #d30f45;
  --cyan: #32ade6;   --cyan-text: #0071a4;
  --mint: #00c7be;   --mint-text: #0c817b;

  /* Surfaces, in the order they stack: window, grouped content, controls on content. */
  --bg: #f5f5f7;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --surface-2: #f2f2f4;
  --surface-3: #e8e8ed;
  --fill: rgba(120, 120, 128, .12);      /* resting control fill (segmented track, search fields) */
  --fill-2: rgba(120, 120, 128, .2);     /* hover */
  --line: rgba(60, 60, 67, .13);         /* hairline separators and card edges */
  --line-strong: rgba(60, 60, 67, .29);  /* Apple's separator */
  --text: #1d1d1f;
  --muted: #6e6e73;                      /* secondary label, 4.9:1 on white */
  --faint: #76767b;                      /* tertiary, small labels only, 4.5:1 on white */

  --primary: var(--blue);   --primary-hover: #0077ed; --on-primary: #ffffff; --primary-text: var(--blue-text);
  --primary-tint: rgba(0, 122, 255, .1);
  --teal: var(--green);     --on-teal: #ffffff;       --teal-text: var(--green-text);  /* switches on, success */
  --danger: var(--red);     --danger-text: var(--red-text);

  --shadow-1: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04), 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
  --shadow-2: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
  --shadow-pop: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .1), 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .14), 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06);
  --knob-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
  --focus-ring: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 45%, transparent);   /* follows each app's accent */
  --scrim: rgba(0, 0, 0, .32);

  /* 8pt grid, concentric radii (inner + padding = outer). */

:where(input, textarea):focus { outline: none; }

    :root { --primary: var(--orange); --primary-text: var(--orange-text); --on-primary: #fff; --primary-tint: color-mix(in srgb, var(--orange) 14%, transparent); --gold: var(--yellow); --gold-text: var(--yellow-text); }

    // ---------- model helpers ----------

    // ---------- rendering ----------

    function render() {

      $('title').textContent = g.name;
      $('hint').hidden = !!store.favourite;
      $('star').hidden = false; $('settings').hidden = false; $('rooms').hidden = false; $('picker').disabled = false;

        <span class="lit" data-lit="${g.id}"></span><b>${esc(g.name)}</b>${g.id === store.favourite ? ICON.star : ''}<small data-count="${g.id}"></small></button>`;

    function draw() {
      const g = groupById(current);

        idsIn(g).map((id) => id + lights[id].name + hasColour(lights[id]) + hasCt(lights[id])), sceneList(current).map((s) => s.id + s.name)]);

    // ---------- polling ----------

    async function onError(e) {

        const same = found.find((b) => b.id && b.id.toLowerCase() === store.bridgeId.toLowerCase());
        if (same && same.ip !== store.bridge) { store = await window.miniPage.store.set({ bridge: same.ip }); return; }

    }

    function showOffline() {
      mode = 'offline'; structure = '';
      hideChrome();
      $('title').textContent = 'Hue';
      $('main').innerHTML = `<div class="state error">${ICON.wifi}<h3>Can't reach your Hue Bridge</h3>
        <p>It was at ${esc(store.bridge)}. Check it's plugged in and this PC is on your home network.</p>
        <div class="actions"><button class="btn primary" type="button" data-act="retry">Try again</button>

    }

    function hideChrome() {

    }

    // ---------- connecting a bridge ----------
    async function discover() {
      let list = [];

      await Promise.all(list.map(async (b) => {
        try { const c = await call('GET', `${baseOf(b.ip)}/api/0/config`); b.name = c.name; b.id = b.id || c.bridgeid; } catch { b.unreachable = true; }
      }));

    }

    let pairing = 0;
    async function setup(message) {

      $('bridgeName').textContent = '';
      $('main').innerHTML = `<div class="state">${ICON.bulb.replace('<svg', '<svg class="big"')}
        <h3>Find your Hue Bridge</h3><p id="setupMsg">${esc(message || 'Looking on your home network…')}</p>
        <div class="bridges" id="bridges"><div class="skel"></div></div>
        <form class="manual" id="manual"><label for="ip">Or type the bridge's address (in the Hue app: Settings › My Hue system › Bridge)</label>
          <div class="row"><input id="ip" placeholder="192.168.0.20" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"><button class="btn" type="submit">Connect</button></div>
          <div class="err" id="ipErr" role="alert"></div></form></div>`;
      $('manual').onsubmit = async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const ip = $('ip').value.trim();
        if (!/^(10|172|192)\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}$/.test(ip)) { $('ipErr').textContent = 'That should look like 192.168.0.20'; return; }
        try { const c = await call('GET', `${baseOf(ip)}/api/0/config`); pair({ ip, name: c.name, id: c.bridgeid }); }
        catch { $('ipErr').textContent = `Nothing answered at ${ip}. Check the address.`; }
      };
      const found = await discover();
      if (mode !== 'setup' || !$('bridges')) return;
      if (!message) $('setupMsg').textContent = found.length ? 'Choose your bridge to connect this PC.' : 'Make sure this PC is on your home network.';
      $('bridges').innerHTML = found.length
        ? found.map((b, i) => `<div class="bridge"><div class="grow"><b>${esc(b.name || 'Hue Bridge')}</b><span>${esc(b.ip)}</span></div>
            <button class="btn primary" type="button" data-act="pair" data-i="${i}">Connect</button></div>`).join('')
        : '<p class="err" style="text-align:center">No bridge found automatically. Type its address below.</p>';
      $('bridges').found = found;
    }

    async function pair(b) {
      const run = ++pairing;
      mode = 'pairing';
      $('title').textContent = 'Connect your lights';
      $('main').innerHTML = `<div class="state"><div class="press" aria-hidden="true"><span class="ring"></span><span class="dev"><i></i></span></div>
        <h3>Press the button on your bridge</h3><p>Press the big round button on top of <b>${esc(b.name || 'your Hue Bridge')}</b>. This PC connects as soon as you do.</p>
        <div class="count" id="count"></div>
        <div class="actions"><button class="btn" type="button" data-act="cancel">Cancel</button></div></div>`;
      const until = Date.now() + 40000;
      while (run === pairing && Date.now() < until) {
        $('count').textContent = `Waiting… ${Math.ceil((until - Date.now()) / 1000)}s`;
        try {
          const d = await call('POST', `${baseOf(b.ip)}/api`, { devicetype: 'mini_apps#windows' });
          const ok = Array.isArray(d) && d[0] && d[0].success && d[0].success.username;
          if (ok) {
            if (run !== pairing) return;
            store = await window.miniPage.store.set({ bridge: b.ip, key: ok, bridgeName: b.name || 'Hue Bridge', bridgeId: b.id || null });
            return start();
          }
          const err = Array.isArray(d) && d[0] && d[0].error;
          if (err && err.type !== 101) throw new Error(err.description || 'The bridge refused.');
        } catch (e) {
          if (run !== pairing) return;
          if (e.code !== 'offline') $('count').textContent = e.message;
        }
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000));
      }
      if (run !== pairing) return;
      $('main').innerHTML = `<div class="state">${ICON.bulb.replace('<svg', '<svg class="big"')}<h3>We didn't see the button pressed</h3>
        <p>Make sure you press the button on the bridge itself, then try again.</p>
        <div class="actions"><button class="btn primary" type="button" data-act="repair">Try again</button><button class="btn" type="button" data-act="cancel">Back</button></div></div>`;
      $('main').lastBridge = b;
    }

    // ---------- actions ----------
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => { if (e.target.matches('input[type=range]')) dragging = true; });
    document.addEventListener('pointerup', () => { if (dragging) { dragging = false; setTimeout(() => { if (mode === 'lights') patch(); }, 50); } });

    function holdGroup(ms) { hold['g' + current] = Date.now() + ms; idsIn(groupById(current)).forEach((id) => { hold['l' + id] = Date.now() + ms; }); }

    function setLight(id, change) {
      const l = lights[id]; if (!l) return;
      Object.assign(l.state, change);
      if (change.xy) l.state.colormode = 'xy';
      if (change.ct) l.state.colormode = 'ct';
      hold['l' + id] = Date.now() + 2500;
      patch();
      send('l' + id, `/lights/${id}/state`, change);
    }
    function setGroup(change) {
      const g = groupById(current);
      const targets = change.on === false ? idsIn(g) : change.bri !== undefined && onIn(g).length ? onIn(g) : idsIn(g);
      for (const id of targets) {
        const l = lights[id], c = { ...change };
        if (c.xy && !hasColour(l)) delete c.xy;
        if (c.ct && !hasCt(l)) delete c.ct;
        if (c.bri !== undefined && !dimmable(l)) delete c.bri;
        Object.assign(l.state, c);
        if (c.xy) l.state.colormode = 'xy';
        if (c.ct) l.state.colormode = 'ct';
      }
      holdGroup(2500);
      patch();
      send('g' + current, `/groups/${current}/action`, change);
    }

    document.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
      const t = e.target, act = t.dataset && t.dataset.act;
      if (act !== 'lbri' && act !== 'gbri') return;
      const pct = +t.value;
      t.style.setProperty('--p', `${((pct - 1) / 99) * 100}%`);
      const label = t.parentElement.querySelector('.pct'); if (label) label.textContent = `${pct}%`;
      if (act === 'lbri') setLight(t.dataset.id, { on: true, bri: briOf(pct) });
      else setGroup({ on: true, bri: briOf(pct) });
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
      const t = e.target.closest('[data-act]'); if (!t) return;
      const act = t.dataset.act, id = t.dataset.id;
      if (act === 'room') { closeSheet(); current = id; openLight = null; draw(); $('main').scrollTop = 0; }
      else if (act === 'picker') openSheet();
      else if (act === 'open') { openLight = openLight === id ? null : id; draw(); }
      else if (act === 'lswitch') setLight(id, { on: !lights[id].state.on });
      else if (act === 'gswitch') setGroup({ on: onIn(groupById(current)).length === 0 });
      else if (act === 'lct' || act === 'gct') {
        const m = +t.dataset.v;
        if (act === 'lct') { const c = lights[id].capabilities, r = (c && c.control && c.control.ct) || { min: 153, max: 500 }; setLight(id, { on: true, ct: clamp(m, r.min, r.max) }); }
        else setGroup({ on: true, ct: m });
      } else if (act === 'lxy' || act === 'gxy') {
        const xy = hexToXy(t.dataset.v);
        if (act === 'lxy') setLight(id, { on: true, xy }); else setGroup({ on: true, xy });
      } else if (act === 'scene') {
        holdGroup(0);
        t.classList.add('done'); setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('done'), 1200);
        try { await api('PUT', `/groups/${current}/action`, { scene: id }); } catch (err) { onError(err); }
        setTimeout(tick, 700);
      } else if (act === 'retry') start();
      else if (act === 'rescan') setup();
      else if (act === 'pair') pair($('bridges').found[+t.dataset.i]);
      else if (act === 'repair') pair($('main').lastBridge);
      else if (act === 'cancel') { pairing++; store.key ? start() : setup(); }
    });

    $('star').onclick = async () => {
      store = await window.miniPage.store.set({ favourite: store.favourite === current ? null : current });
      draw();
    };
    $('settings').onclick = () => {
      $('dlgText').textContent = `${store.bridgeName || 'Hue Bridge'} at ${store.bridge}. Forgetting it disconnects this PC; you can connect again by pressing the bridge button.`;
      $('dlg').showModal();
    };
    $('dlgClose').onclick = () => $('dlg').close();
    $('forget').onclick = async () => {
      $('dlg').close();
      store = await window.miniPage.store.set({ key: null, bridge: null, bridgeName: null, bridgeId: null });
      lights = {}; groups = {}; scenes = {}; current = null; lastScenes = 0;
      setup();
    };

    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
      if (document.hidden) { hiddenAt = Date.now(); return; }
      if (mode === 'lights' && hiddenAt && Date.now() - hiddenAt > RESET_AFTER && store.favourite && groupById(store.favourite)) {
        current = store.favourite; openLight = null; closeSheet(); $('main').scrollTop = 0;
      }
      hiddenAt = 0;
      if (store.key && mode === 'lights') tick();
    });

    function start() {
      mode = 'loading'; structure = ''; failures = 0;
      $('bridgeName').textContent = store.bridgeName || '';
      $('main').innerHTML = '<div class="skel"></div><div class="skel"></div><div class="skel"></div>';
      tick();
    }

    window.miniPage.store.get().then((s) => { store = s || {}; store.key && store.bridge ? start() : setup(); });
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
