<body>
  <main id="main"></main>
  <script>
  (() => {
    // Robot vacuum (1.0.0, hub 1.7.3+): cleans the rooms you pick, vacuum only, mop only or vacuum then mop, through
    // your Home Assistant's Ecovacs integration (its "Work mode" select and the vacuum's spot_area command). The Home
    // Assistant token is kept encrypted by the hub, which adds it to requests to your Home Assistant address only.
    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
    const api = window.miniPage;
    const MODES = [['vacuum', 'Vacuum'], ['mop', 'Mop'], ['mop_after_vacuum', 'Vacuum, then mop']];
    const SHORT = { mop_after_vacuum: 'Both' };   // fits the three-way switch
    const STATE = { cleaning: 'Cleaning', docked: 'Docked', idle: 'Ready', paused: 'Paused', returning: 'Going home', error: 'Needs help', unavailable: 'Offline', unknown: 'Offline' };
    const ICON = {
      play: '<path d="M7 5l12 7-12 7z"/>', pause: '<path d="M8 5v14M16 5v14"/>', stop: '<rect x="6" y="6" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/>',
      home: '<path d="M4 11l8-7 8 7M6 9.5V20h12V9.5"/>',
    };
    const svg = (n) => `<svg class="ui" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">${ICON[n]}</svg>`;
    const h = (tag, props = {}, ...kids) => {
      const el = document.createElement(tag);
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(props)) {
        if (k.startsWith('on')) el.addEventListener(k.slice(2), v);
        else if (k === 'html') el.innerHTML = v;
        else if (v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== false) el.setAttribute(k, v === true ? '' : v);
      }
      el.append(...kids.flat().filter((x) => x !== null && x !== undefined && x !== false));
      return el;
    };
    const cleanErr = (e) => String((e && e.message) || e).replace(/^Error invoking remote method '[^']+': (Error: )?/, '');
    const roomName = (slug) => { const s = slug.replace(/_/g, ' '); return s[0].toUpperCase() + s.slice(1); };

    let base = '';                 // Home Assistant address, from the app's settings
    let hasToken = false, tokenNote = '';
    let vac = null, workMode = null, battery = null, findNote = '';
    let picked = new Set(), mode = 'vacuum', busy = false, msg = '', msgBad = false;
    let shown = false, timer = null;

    async function ha(method, path, body) {
      const r = await api.apiKey.request('ha', { method, url: base + path, body });
      if (r.status === 401 || r.status === 403) { hasToken = false; tokenNote = "Home Assistant didn't accept the token. Make a new one and paste it here."; throw new Error('token'); }
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`Home Assistant said ${r.status}.`);
      return r.text ? JSON.parse(r.text) : null;
    }
    const call = (domain, service, data) => ha('POST', `/api/services/${domain}/${service}`, data);

    // Finds the robot: the vacuum that lists rooms (the Ecovacs integration does), its Work mode select and battery.
    async function load() {
      const states = await ha('GET', '/api/states');
      const vacs = states.filter((s) => s.entity_id.startsWith('vacuum.'));
      vac = vacs.find((s) => s.attributes && s.attributes.rooms && Object.keys(s.attributes.rooms).length) || vacs[0] || null;
      if (!vac) { findNote = 'No robot vacuum found in Home Assistant.'; workMode = battery = null; return; }
      findNote = '';
      const key = vac.entity_id.slice('vacuum.'.length);
      workMode = states.find((s) => s.entity_id === `select.${key}_work_mode`)
        || states.find((s) => s.entity_id.startsWith('select.') && s.entity_id.endsWith('_work_mode') && (s.attributes.options || []).includes('mop_after_vacuum')) || null;
      const bat = states.find((s) => s.entity_id === `sensor.${key}_battery`)
        || states.find((s) => s.entity_id.startsWith(`sensor.${key}`) && s.attributes.device_class === 'battery');
      battery = bat && !isNaN(+bat.state) ? +bat.state : (vac.attributes.battery_level ?? null);
    }
    function rooms() {
      const r = (vac && vac.attributes.rooms) || {};
      return Object.entries(r).map(([slug, ids]) => ({ slug, name: roomName(slug), ids: [].concat(ids).map(Number).filter((n) => !isNaN(n)) }));
    }
    const modes = () => MODES.filter(([k]) => !workMode || (workMode.attributes.options || []).includes(k));

    async function refresh() {
      if (!hasToken || !base || !api.apiKey) return;   // nothing to fetch yet (and don't redraw over a token being typed)
      try { await load(); } catch (e) { if (e.message !== 'token') { findNote = `Can't reach Home Assistant: ${cleanErr(e)}`; vac = null; } }
      if (!busy) draw();
    }
    function schedule() { clearInterval(timer); timer = setInterval(refresh, shown ? 4000 : 60000); }

    async function act(fn, done) {
      busy = true; msg = ''; draw();
      try { await fn(); msg = done; msgBad = false; } catch (e) { if (e.message !== 'token') { msg = cleanErr(e); msgBad = true; } }
      busy = false;
      draw();
      setTimeout(refresh, 1500);
      setTimeout(() => { if (!msgBad) { msg = ''; draw(); } }, 6000);
    }
    function start() {
      const ids = rooms().filter((r) => picked.has(r.slug)).flatMap((r) => r.ids);
      return act(async () => {
        // Work mode first (the robot keeps it), then the rooms, or everywhere if none are picked.
        if (workMode && workMode.state !== mode) await call('select', 'select_option', { entity_id: workMode.entity_id, option: mode });
        if (ids.length) await call('vacuum', 'send_command', { entity_id: vac.entity_id, command: 'spot_area', params: { rooms: ids, cleanings: 1 } });
        else await call('vacuum', 'start', { entity_id: vac.entity_id });
      }, 'Off it goes.');
    }
    const save = () => api.store.set({ rooms: [...picked], mode }).catch(() => {});

    // ---------- drawing ----------
    function tokenSetup() {
      const input = h('input', { type: 'password', placeholder: 'Paste the token here', autocomplete: 'off', spellcheck: 'false', 'aria-label': 'Home Assistant token' });
      const saveTok = async () => {
        if (!input.value.trim()) { input.focus(); return; }
        try { await api.apiKey.set('ha', input.value.trim()); hasToken = true; tokenNote = ''; findNote = ''; vac = null; draw(); refresh(); }
        catch (e) { tokenNote = cleanErr(e); draw(); }
      };
      input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') saveTok(); });
      setTimeout(() => input.focus(), 50);
      return h('div', { class: 'setup' },
        h('h1', {}, 'Connect to Home Assistant'),
        h('ol', {},
          h('li', { html: 'Open Home Assistant, click your name (bottom left), then <b>Security</b>.' }),
          h('li', { html: 'Under <b>Long-lived access tokens</b>, click <b>Create token</b> and call it "Mini Apps".' }),
          h('li', {}, 'Copy the token and paste it below.')),
        input,
        h('p', { class: tokenNote ? 'note bad' : 'note' }, tokenNote || 'Kept encrypted on this PC, and only ever sent to your Home Assistant.'),
        h('button', { class: 'go', type: 'button', onclick: saveTok }, 'Connect'));
    }
    function draw() {
      const main = $('main');
      if (!api.apiKey) { main.replaceChildren(h('div', { class: 'empty' }, h('b', {}, 'Update Mini Apps'), 'This app needs Mini Apps 1.7.3 or later (Check for updates).')); return; }
      if (!base) { main.replaceChildren(h('div', { class: 'empty' }, h('b', {}, 'Add your Home Assistant address'), 'Right-click this app\'s button, choose Customise and fill it in.')); return; }
      if (!hasToken) { main.replaceChildren(tokenSetup()); document.title = 'Vacuum'; return; }
      if (!vac) {
        main.replaceChildren(h('div', { class: 'empty' }, h('b', {}, findNote || 'Looking for your robot…'),
          findNote.startsWith('No robot') ? 'Add the Ecovacs integration in Home Assistant (Settings, Devices & services), then reopen this.' : ''));
        return;
      }
      const st = vac.state;
      const cleaning = st === 'cleaning', paused = st === 'paused';
      document.title = cleaning ? 'Cleaning' : st === 'returning' ? 'Going home' : st === 'error' ? 'Needs help' : 'Vacuum';
      const list = rooms();
      if (list.length) for (const s of [...picked]) if (!list.some((r) => r.slug === s)) picked.delete(s);
      const ms = modes();
      if (!ms.some(([k]) => k === mode)) mode = ms[0] ? ms[0][0] : 'vacuum';

      const els = [
        h('div', { class: `bot ${st}` }, h('span', { class: 'dot' }),
          h('span', { class: 'name' }, vac.attributes.friendly_name || 'Robot'),
          h('span', { class: 'state' }, [STATE[st] || st, battery != null ? `${Math.round(battery)}%` : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))),
      ];
      if (list.length) {
        els.push(h('section', {},
          h('h2', {}, h('span', {}, 'Rooms'), picked.size ? h('button', { type: 'button', onclick: () => { picked.clear(); save(); draw(); } }, 'Clear') : null),
          h('div', { class: 'rooms', role: 'group', 'aria-label': 'Rooms to clean' }, ...list.map((r) => h('button', {
            class: 'room', type: 'button', 'aria-pressed': picked.has(r.slug) ? 'true' : 'false',
            onclick: () => { picked.has(r.slug) ? picked.delete(r.slug) : picked.add(r.slug); save(); draw(); },
          }, r.name))),
          h('p', { class: 'note' }, picked.size ? '' : 'None picked: it cleans everywhere.')));
      } else {
        els.push(h('p', { class: 'note' }, "Home Assistant hasn't shared your rooms yet. Open the Ecovacs phone app once so the map is saved, then wait a minute."));
      }
      els.push(h('section', {},
        h('h2', {}, h('span', {}, 'How')),
        h('div', { class: 'seg', role: 'group', 'aria-label': 'Cleaning mode' }, ...MODES.map(([k, label]) => h('button', {
          type: 'button', 'aria-pressed': k === mode ? 'true' : 'false', disabled: !workMode || !ms.some(([x]) => x === k),
          onclick: () => { mode = k; save(); draw(); },
        }, SHORT[k] || label))),
        mode === 'mop_after_vacuum' && workMode ? h('p', { class: 'note' }, 'Vacuums the rooms first, then goes back and mops them.') : null,
        workMode ? null : h('p', { class: 'note bad' }, 'To choose vacuum or mop, turn on your robot\'s "Work mode" in Home Assistant: Settings, Devices, your Deebot, Work mode, then Enable.')));
      const n = picked.size;
      els.push(h('button', { class: 'go', type: 'button', disabled: busy || st === 'unavailable', onclick: start },
        busy ? 'Sending…' : `${workMode ? MODES.find(([k]) => k === mode)[1] : 'Clean'} ${n ? `${n} room${n === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : 'everywhere'}`));
      els.push(h('div', { class: 'acts' },
        h('button', { type: 'button', disabled: busy || !(cleaning || paused), html: svg(paused ? 'play' : 'pause') + (paused ? 'Resume' : 'Pause'),
          onclick: () => act(() => call('vacuum', paused ? 'start' : 'pause', { entity_id: vac.entity_id }), paused ? 'Carrying on.' : 'Paused.') }),
        h('button', { type: 'button', disabled: busy || !(cleaning || paused || st === 'returning'), html: svg('stop') + 'Stop',
          onclick: () => act(() => call('vacuum', 'stop', { entity_id: vac.entity_id }), 'Stopped.') }),
        h('button', { type: 'button', disabled: busy || st === 'docked', html: svg('home') + 'Go home',
          onclick: () => act(() => call('vacuum', 'return_to_base', { entity_id: vac.entity_id }), 'Heading home.') })));
      els.push(h('div', { class: msgBad ? 'msg bad' : 'msg', role: 'status' }, msg));
      main.replaceChildren(...els);
    }

    window.addEventListener('mini-panel', (e) => { shown = e.detail === 'shown'; if (shown) refresh(); schedule(); });
    (async () => {
      try { const v = await api.values(); base = String(v.ha || '').trim().replace(/\/+$/, ''); } catch {}
      if (base && !/^https?:\/\//i.test(base)) base = 'http://' + base;
      try { const s = await api.store.get(); if (s && Array.isArray(s.rooms)) picked = new Set(s.rooms); if (s && s.mode) mode = s.mode; } catch {}
      try { hasToken = !!(api.apiKey && (await api.apiKey.has('ha'))); } catch { hasToken = false; }
      draw();
      refresh();
      schedule();
    })();
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

apps.name: Clipboard
apps.label: Clipboard
apps.description: Everything you've copied lately, text, links and pictures, one click from the taskbar. Click one to copy it again, search, and pin the bits you paste all the time. Kept on this PC only, encrypted, and passwords from password managers are never saved.

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en-GB">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:">
  <title>Clipboard</title>
  <style>
    /* The hub theme (src/theme.css) is inlined at the marker below when the library is built. */
    /* Mini Apps theme: Apple Human Interface Guidelines. System colours in light and dark (follows Windows' app mode),
   SF-style type (SF Pro when installed, otherwise the bundled Inter, which is drawn on the same principles),
   the iOS type scale, 8pt spacing, concentric radii and Apple's standard easing. No glass: solid surfaces only.
   Shared by the software centre and every panel. The library build inlines this file into each app page
   at its theme marker, so pages stay self-contained; they then set --primary etc. to their own system colour. */
@font-face {
  font-family: "Inter var"; font-style: normal; font-weight: 100 900; font-display: block;
  src: url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");
}
:root {
  color-scheme: light dark;

  /* Apple system colours, light. "-text" variants are the accessible shades for text on light backgrounds. */
  --blue: #007aff;   --blue-text: #0066cc;
  --green: #34c759;  --green-text: #248a3d;
  --red: #ff3b30;    --red-text: #d70015;
  --orange: #ff9500; --orange-text: #c93400;
  --yellow: #ffcc00; --yellow-text: #a05a00;
  --indigo: #5856d6; --indigo-text: #3634a3;
  --purple: #af52de; --purple-text: #8944ab;
  --pink: #ff2d55;   --pink-text: #d30f45;
  --cyan: #32ade6;   --cyan-text: #0071a4;
  --mint: #00c7be;   --mint-text: #0c817b;

  /* Surfaces, in the order they stack: window, grouped content, controls on content. */
  --bg: #f5f5f7;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --surface-2: #f2f2f4;
  --surface-3: #e8e8ed;
  --fill: rgba(120, 120, 128, .12);      /* resting control fill (segmented track, search fields) */
  --fill-2: rgba(120, 120, 128, .2);     /* hover */
  --line: rgba(60, 60, 67, .13);         /* hairline separators and card edges */
  --line-strong: rgba(60, 60, 67, .29);  /* Apple's separator */
  --text: #1d1d1f;
  --muted: #6e6e73;                      /* secondary label, 4.9:1 on white */
  --faint: #76767b;                      /* tertiary, small labels only, 4.5:1 on white */

  --primary: var(--blue);   --primary-hover: #0077ed; --on-primary: #ffffff; --primary-text: var(--blue-text);
  --primary-tint: rgba(0, 122, 255, .1);
  --teal: var(--green);     --on-teal: #ffffff;       --teal-text: var(--green-text);  /* switches on, success */
  --danger: var(--red);     --danger-text: var(--red-text);

  --shadow-1: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04), 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
  --shadow-2: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
  --shadow-pop: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .1), 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .14), 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06);
  --knob-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
  --focus-ring: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 45%, transparent);   /* follows each app's accent */
  --scrim: rgba(0, 0, 0, .32);

  /* 8pt grid, concentric radii (inner + padding = outer). */
  --space-1: 4px; --space-2: 8px; --space-3: 12px; --space-4: 16px; --space-5: 20px; --space-6: 24px; --space-8: 32px;
  --radius-xs: 6px; --radius-sm: 8px; --radius: 12px; --radius-lg: 16px; --radius-xl: 20px; --radius-full: 999px;

  /* Motion: Apple's default curve and a soft spring-like ease-out (no overshoot on UI chrome). */
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.25, .1, .25, 1);
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1);
  --fast: 180ms;
  --normal: 280ms;

  /* Type: iOS scale. Body text is 14px here (desktop panels), titles follow the scale above it. */
  --font: "SF Pro Text", "Inter var", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-display: "SF Pro Display", "Inter var", "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --mono: "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace;
  --text-caption2: 11px; --text-caption: 12px; --text-footnote: 13px; --text-body: 14px; --text-callout: 15px;
  --text-headline: 17px; --text-title3: 20px; --text-title2: 22px; --text-title1: 28px; --text-large: 34px;
  --track-display: -.022em;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --blue: #0a84ff;   --blue-text: #2997ff;
    --green: #30d158;  --green-text: #30d158;
    --red: #ff453a;    --red-text: #ff6961;
    --orange: #ff9f0a; --orange-text: #ffb340;
    --yellow: #ffd60a; --yellow-text: #ffd426;
    --indigo: #5e5ce6; --indigo-text: #7d7aff;
    --purple: #bf5af2; --purple-text: #da8fff;
    --pink: #ff375f;   --pink-text: #ff6482;
    --cyan: #64d2ff;   --cyan-text: #70d7ff;
    --mint: #63e6e2;   --mint-text: #66d4cf;

    --bg: #161617;
    --surface: #232325;
    --surface-2: #2c2c2e;
    --surface-3: #3a3a3c;
    --fill: rgba(120, 120, 128, .24);
    --fill-2: rgba(120, 120, 128, .34);
    --line: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
    --line-strong: rgba(84, 84, 88, .65);
    --text: #f5f5f7;
    --muted: #a1a1a6;
    --faint: #8e8e93;

    --primary-hover: #409cff;
    --primary-tint: rgba(10, 132, 255, .18);

    --shadow-1: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .06), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3);
    --shadow-2: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .08), 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
    --shadow-pop: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .12), 0 12px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
    --knob-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .16);
    --scrim: rgba(0, 0, 0, .5);
  }
}
html { font-family: var(--font); letter-spacing: -.006em; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { transition-duration: 0ms !important; animation-duration: 0ms !important; }
}
/* Keyboard focus: Apple's soft accent ring on controls. Text fields show focus on their own rounded field instead
   (pages use :focus-within on the wrapper), so the ring never lands on a bare input inside a styled box. */
:where(button, a, summary, select, [tabindex], [role="button"], [role="tab"], [role="radio"], [role="switch"], input[type="checkbox"], input[type="radio"], input[type="range"]):focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); }
:where(input, textarea):focus { outline: none; }
::selection { background: var(--primary-tint); }

    :root { --gold: var(--yellow); --gold-text: var(--yellow-text); }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { transition-duration: 0ms !important; animation-duration: 0ms !important; } }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    [hidden] { display: none !important; }
    html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 10px; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--fill-2); border-radius: 999px; border: 3px solid var(--bg); }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--line-strong); }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-button { display: none; }
    body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font: 14px/1.45 var(--font); display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    button, input { font: inherit; }
    svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; flex: none; }

    /* ---------- top ---------- */
    .top { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; padding: 18px 20px 10px; }
    .top .grow { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
    .eyebrow { color: var(--teal); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    h1 { font: 600 22px/1.2 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -.01em; margin: 2px 0 0; }
    .icon-btn { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); color: var(--muted);
      display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--fast), color var(--fast), border-color var(--fast); flex: none; }
    .icon-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text); }
    .icon-btn[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--gold-text); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--yellow) 45%, transparent); }
    .clear { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); color: var(--muted);
      cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; transition: background var(--fast), color var(--fast), border-color var(--fast); flex: none; }
    .clear:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text); }
    .clear:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; }
    .clear.confirm { color: var(--danger-text); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--red) 50%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--red) 8%, transparent); }

    .search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 2px 20px 10px; padding: 0 12px; height: 40px; border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); color: var(--muted); }
    .search:focus-within { border-color: var(--primary); box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); }
    .search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: none; color: var(--text); }
    .search input::placeholder { color: var(--faint); }
    .search input::-webkit-search-cancel-button { -webkit-appearance: none; }
    .search kbd { font: 11px var(--font); color: var(--faint); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 5px; white-space: nowrap; }

    .paused { margin: 0 20px 10px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--yellow) 12%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--yellow) 35%, transparent);
      color: var(--gold); font-size: 13px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
    .paused span { flex: 1; }
    .paused button { border: 0; background: none; color: var(--text); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; }
    .paused button:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--yellow) 22%, transparent); }

    /* ---------- list ---------- */
    .list { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 0 12px 16px 20px; }
    .list h4 { margin: 10px 0 6px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .row { position: relative; border-radius: var(--radius); margin-bottom: 6px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid transparent; transition: background var(--fast), border-color var(--fast); }
    .row:hover { background: var(--surface-2); }
    .row.sel { border-color: var(--primary); background: var(--surface-2); }
    .row .main { width: 100%; display: block; padding: 10px 76px 10px 12px; border: 0; background: none; color: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; border-radius: var(--radius); }
    .row .main:focus-visible { outline-offset: -2px; }
    .text { display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }
    .text.code { font: 12.5px/1.5 var(--mono); }
    .text.link { color: var(--blue-text); -webkit-line-clamp: 2; word-break: break-all; }
    .thumb { display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 150px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: repeating-conic-gradient(var(--surface-3) 0 25%, var(--surface-2) 0 50%) 0 0 / 14px 14px; }
    .meta { margin-top: 5px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 12px; display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; }
    .meta svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; }
    .acts { position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 6px; display: flex; gap: 2px; }
    .acts button { width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: none; color: var(--faint); cursor: pointer;
      display: grid; place-items: center; opacity: 0; transition: background var(--fast), color var(--fast), opacity var(--fast); }
    .row:hover .acts button, .row.sel .acts button, .row:focus-within .acts button, .acts .pin[aria-pressed="true"] { opacity: 1; }
    .acts button:hover { background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--text); }
    .acts .pin[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--teal); }
    .acts .pin[aria-pressed="true"] svg { fill: currentColor; }
    .acts .del:hover { color: var(--danger); }

    .empty { margin: 40px 16px; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); }
    .empty .art { width: 56px; height: 56px; margin: 0 auto 14px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface); display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--teal); }
    .empty .art svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; }
    .empty b { display: block; color: var(--text); font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .empty p { margin: 0 auto; max-width: 280px; font-size: 13px; }
    .foot { padding: 8px 20px 12px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 11.5px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
    .foot svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; }

    .toast { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 52px; transform: translate(-50%, 12px); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--teal); color: var(--on-teal); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; transition: opacity 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; }
    .toast.show { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, 0); }
    .toast.err { background: var(--danger); color: #fff; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="top">
    <div class="grow">
      <div class="eyebrow">Clipboard</div>
      <h1>Recent copies</h1>
    </div>
    <button class="icon-btn" id="pause" aria-pressed="false" title="Pause recording" aria-label="Pause recording">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="6" y="5" width="4" height="14" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="5" width="4" height="14" rx="1"/></svg>
    </button>
    <button class="clear" id="clear" title="Clear everything except pinned items">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 6h18M8 6V4h8v2M6 6l1 14h10l1-14"/></svg><span>Clear</span>
    </button>
  </div>
  <label class="search">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-3.5-3.5"/></svg>
    <input id="q" type="search" placeholder="Search your copies" aria-label="Search your copies" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
    <kbd>↑↓ Enter</kbd>
  </label>
  <div class="paused" id="pausedBar" hidden>
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="6" y="5" width="4" height="14" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="5" width="4" height="14" rx="1"/></svg>
    <span>Paused. New copies aren't being saved.</span>
    <button id="resume">Resume</button>
  </div>
  <div class="list" id="list" role="listbox" aria-label="Clipboard history"></div>
  <div class="foot">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="10" rx="2"/><path d="M8 11V7a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v4"/></svg>
    <span>Kept on this PC only, encrypted. Passwords copied from password managers are never saved.</span>
  </div>
  <div class="toast" id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>

<script>
'use strict';
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const api = window.miniPage && window.miniPage.clipboard;
const ICON = {
  pin: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 17v5M9 3h6l-1 6 3 3v2H7v-2l3-3z"/></svg>',
  del: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg>',
  text: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h10"/></svg>',
  link: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M10 14a4 4 0 0 0 5.7 0l3-3a4 4 0 0 0-5.7-5.7l-1 1"/><path d="M14 10a4 4 0 0 0-5.7 0l-3 3a4 4 0 0 0 5.7 5.7l1-1"/></svg>',
  image: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><circle cx="9" cy="10" r="2"/><path d="m21 16-5-5-9 9"/></svg>',
  clip: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="8" y="3" width="8" height="4" rx="1"/><path d="M16 5h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v12a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H6a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V7a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h2"/></svg>',
};

let data = { paused: false, items: [] };
let shown = [];   // items in the order they're drawn
let sel = -1;     // selected index into shown

const isLink = (t) => /^https?:\/\/\S+$/i.test(t.trim());
const isCode = (t) => t.includes('\n') && /[{};]|=>|^\s{2,}\S/m.test(t);
const cleanErr = (e) => String((e && e.message) || e).replace(/^Error invoking remote method '[^']+': (Error: )?/, '');
function ago(at) {
  const s = Math.max(0, (Date.now() - at) / 1000);
  if (s < 45) return 'Just now';
  if (s < 3600) return `${Math.round(s / 60)} min ago`;
  if (s < 86400) return `${Math.round(s / 3600)} h ago`;
  const d = new Date(at);
  return s < 7 * 86400 ? d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { weekday: 'long' }) : d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
}
function describe(x) {
  if (x.kind === 'image') return [ICON.image, `Picture · ${x.w}×${x.h}`];
  if (isLink(x.text)) { let h = ''; try { h = new URL(x.text.trim()).hostname.replace(/^www\./, ''); } catch {} return [ICON.link, `Link · ${h}`]; }
  const n = x.text.length;
  return [ICON.text, n > 80 ? `${n.toLocaleString('en-GB')} characters` : 'Text'];
}
function el(tag, cls, html) { const e = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) e.className = cls; if (html != null) e.innerHTML = html; return e; }

function row(x, i) {
  const r = el('div', `row${i === sel ? ' sel' : ''}`);
  r.setAttribute('role', 'option');
  r.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(i === sel));
  const main = el('button', 'main');
  main.title = 'Click to copy';
  if (x.kind === 'image') {
    const img = document.createElement('img');
    img.className = 'thumb'; img.alt = `Copied picture, ${x.w} by ${x.h}`; img.src = x.thumb;
    main.append(img);
  } else {
    const t = el('div', `text${isLink(x.text) ? ' link' : isCode(x.text) ? ' code' : ''}`);
    t.textContent = x.text.length > 600 ? `${x.text.slice(0, 600)}…` : x.text;
    main.append(t);
  }
  const [icon, what] = describe(x);
  const meta = el('div', 'meta', icon);
  meta.append(document.createTextNode(`${what} · ${ago(x.at)}`));
  main.append(meta);
  main.addEventListener('click', () => copy(x));
  main.addEventListener('focus', () => select(i, false));

  const acts = el('div', 'acts');
  const pin = el('button', 'pin', ICON.pin);
  pin.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(!!x.pinned));
  pin.title = x.pinned ? 'Unpin' : 'Pin (kept until you unpin it)';
  pin.setAttribute('aria-label', pin.title);
  pin.addEventListener('click', () => act(() => api.pin(x.id, !x.pinned)));
  const del = el('button', 'del', ICON.del);
  del.title = 'Remove'; del.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Remove');
  del.addEventListener('click', () => act(() => api.remove(x.id)));
  acts.append(pin, del);
  r.append(main, acts);
  return r;
}

function render() {
  const q = $('q').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const match = (x) => !q || (x.kind === 'text' ? x.text.toLowerCase().includes(q) : 'picture image screenshot'.includes(q));
  const pinned = data.items.filter((x) => x.pinned && match(x));
  const recent = data.items.filter((x) => !x.pinned && match(x));
  shown = [...pinned, ...recent];
  if (sel >= shown.length) sel = shown.length - 1;
  const list = $('list');
  list.textContent = '';
  if (!shown.length) {
    const e = el('div', 'empty', `<div class="art">${ICON.clip}</div>`);
    const b = el('b'); const p = el('p');
    if (q) { b.textContent = 'Nothing matches'; p.textContent = `None of your copies contain “${$('q').value.trim()}”.`; }
    else if (data.paused) { b.textContent = 'Recording is paused'; p.textContent = 'Resume to start saving what you copy.'; }
    else { b.textContent = 'Copy something'; p.textContent = 'Text, links and pictures you copy show up here. Click one to copy it again.'; }
    e.append(b, p);
    list.append(e);
  } else {
    let i = 0;
    if (pinned.length) { list.append(el('h4', null, 'Pinned')); pinned.forEach((x) => list.append(row(x, i++))); }
    if (recent.length) { if (pinned.length) list.append(el('h4', null, 'Recent')); recent.forEach((x) => list.append(row(x, i++))); }
  }
  const p = $('pause');
  p.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(data.paused));
  p.title = data.paused ? 'Resume recording' : 'Pause recording';
  p.setAttribute('aria-label', p.title);
  $('pausedBar').hidden = !data.paused;
  if (!clearArmed) $('clear').disabled = !data.items.some((x) => !x.pinned);
}

function select(i, scroll = true) {
  sel = Math.max(-1, Math.min(i, shown.length - 1));
  const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.row');
  rows.forEach((r, k) => { r.classList.toggle('sel', k === sel); r.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(k === sel)); });
  if (rows[sel] && scroll) rows[sel].scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
}

let toastTimer;
function toast(msg, err) {
  const t = $('toast');
  t.textContent = msg; t.classList.toggle('err', !!err); t.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(toastTimer); toastTimer = setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), 1600);
}
async function act(fn) {
  try { await fn(); } catch (e) { toast(cleanErr(e), true); }
  await refresh();
}
async function copy(x) {
  try {
    await api.copy(x.id, true); // the panel closes (unless kept open) so you can paste straight away
    toast('Copied');
    $('q').value = ''; sel = 0;
  } catch (e) { toast(cleanErr(e), true); }
  await refresh();
}
async function refresh() {
  if (!api) return;
  try { data = await api.list(); } catch { return; }
  render();
}

// ---------- controls ----------
$('pause').addEventListener('click', () => act(() => api.pause(!data.paused)));
$('resume').addEventListener('click', () => act(() => api.pause(false)));
let clearArmed = null;
function disarmClear() {
  clearTimeout(clearArmed); clearArmed = null;
  $('clear').classList.remove('confirm'); $('clear').querySelector('span').textContent = 'Clear';
  $('clear').disabled = !data.items.some((x) => !x.pinned);
}
$('clear').addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (!clearArmed) { // first click asks, second click clears
    const n = data.items.filter((x) => !x.pinned).length;
    $('clear').classList.add('confirm');
    $('clear').querySelector('span').textContent = `Clear ${n}?`;
    clearArmed = setTimeout(disarmClear, 3000);
    return;
  }
  disarmClear();
  act(() => api.clear());
});
$('q').addEventListener('input', () => { sel = 0; render(); select(sel); });

document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const inSearch = document.activeElement === $('q');
  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); select(sel + 1); }
  else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); select(sel - 1); }
  else if (e.key === 'Enter' && shown[sel] && (inSearch || document.activeElement === document.body)) { e.preventDefault(); copy(shown[sel]); }
  else if (e.key === 'Delete' && shown[sel] && !inSearch) { e.preventDefault(); act(() => api.remove(shown[sel].id)); }
  else if (e.key === 'Escape' && $('q').value) { $('q').value = ''; render(); }
  else if (e.key.length === 1 && !e.ctrlKey && !e.altKey && !e.metaKey && !inSearch) $('q').focus();
});

// Opening the panel: start at the top with the search box ready.
window.addEventListener('mini-panel', (e) => {
  if (e.detail !== 'shown') return;
  $('q').value = ''; sel = 0;
  refresh().then(() => { select(sel); $('q').focus(); });
});

if (api) {
  api.onChange(() => refresh());
  refresh().then(() => select(0));
  setInterval(() => { if (!document.querySelector('.row:hover')) render(); }, 60000); // keeps "5 min ago" fresh
} else {
  $('list').innerHTML = '<div class="empty"><b>Update Mini Apps</b><p>This app needs Mini Apps 1.4.7 or newer.</p></div>';
}
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en-GB">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:">
  <title>Weather</title>
  <style>
    /* The hub theme (src/theme.css) is inlined at the marker below when the library is built. */
    /* Mini Apps theme: Apple Human Interface Guidelines. System colours in light and dark (follows Windows' app mode),
   SF-style type (SF Pro when installed, otherwise the bundled Inter, which is drawn on the same principles),
   the iOS type scale, 8pt spacing, concentric radii and Apple's standard easing. No glass: solid surfaces only.
   Shared by the software centre and every panel. The library build inlines this file into each app page
   at its theme marker, so pages stay self-contained; they then set --primary etc. to their own system colour. */
@font-face {
  font-family: "Inter var"; font-style: normal; font-weight: 100 900; font-display: block;
  src: url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");
}
:root {
  color-scheme: light dark;

  /* Apple system colours, light. "-text" variants are the accessible shades for text on light backgrounds. */
  --blue: #007aff;   --blue-text: #0066cc;
  --green: #34c759;  --green-text: #248a3d;
  --red: #ff3b30;    --red-text: #d70015;
  --orange: #ff9500; --orange-text: #c93400;
  --yellow: #ffcc00; --yellow-text: #a05a00;
  --indigo: #5856d6; --indigo-text: #3634a3;
  --purple: #af52de; --purple-text: #8944ab;
  --pink: #ff2d55;   --pink-text: #d30f45;
  --cyan: #32ade6;   --cyan-text: #0071a4;
  --mint: #00c7be;   --mint-text: #0c817b;

  /* Surfaces, in the order they stack: window, grouped content, controls on content. */
  --bg: #f5f5f7;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --surface-2: #f2f2f4;
  --surface-3: #e8e8ed;
  --fill: rgba(120, 120, 128, .12);      /* resting control fill (segmented track, search fields) */
  --fill-2: rgba(120, 120, 128, .2);     /* hover */
  --line: rgba(60, 60, 67, .13);         /* hairline separators and card edges */
  --line-strong: rgba(60, 60, 67, .29);  /* Apple's separator */
  --text: #1d1d1f;
  --muted: #6e6e73;                      /* secondary label, 4.9:1 on white */
  --faint: #76767b;                      /* tertiary, small labels only, 4.5:1 on white */

  --primary: var(--blue);   --primary-hover: #0077ed; --on-primary: #ffffff; --primary-text: var(--blue-text);
  --primary-tint: rgba(0, 122, 255, .1);
  --teal: var(--green);     --on-teal: #ffffff;       --teal-text: var(--green-text);  /* switches on, success */
  --danger: var(--red);     --danger-text: var(--red-text);

  --shadow-1: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04), 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
  --shadow-2: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
  --shadow-pop: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .1), 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .14), 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06);
  --knob-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
  --focus-ring: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 45%, transparent);   /* follows each app's accent */
  --scrim: rgba(0, 0, 0, .32);

  /* 8pt grid, concentric radii (inner + padding = outer). */
  --space-1: 4px; --space-2: 8px; --space-3: 12px; --space-4: 16px; --space-5: 20px; --space-6: 24px; --space-8: 32px;
  --radius-xs: 6px; --radius-sm: 8px; --radius: 12px; --radius-lg: 16px; --radius-xl: 20px; --radius-full: 999px;

  /* Motion: Apple's default curve and a soft spring-like ease-out (no overshoot on UI chrome). */
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.25, .1, .25, 1);
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1);
  --fast: 180ms;
  --normal: 280ms;

  /* Type: iOS scale. Body text is 14px here (desktop panels), titles follow the scale above it. */
  --font: "SF Pro Text", "Inter var", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-display: "SF Pro Display", "Inter var", "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --mono: "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace;
  --text-caption2: 11px; --text-caption: 12px; --text-footnote: 13px; --text-body: 14px; --text-callout: 15px;
  --text-headline: 17px; --text-title3: 20px; --text-title2: 22px; --text-title1: 28px; --text-large: 34px;
  --track-display: -.022em;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --blue: #0a84ff;   --blue-text: #2997ff;
    --green: #30d158;  --green-text: #30d158;
    --red: #ff453a;    --red-text: #ff6961;
    --orange: #ff9f0a; --orange-text: #ffb340;
    --yellow: #ffd60a; --yellow-text: #ffd426;
    --indigo: #5e5ce6; --indigo-text: #7d7aff;
    --purple: #bf5af2; --purple-text: #da8fff;
    --pink: #ff375f;   --pink-text: #ff6482;
    --cyan: #64d2ff;   --cyan-text: #70d7ff;
    --mint: #63e6e2;   --mint-text: #66d4cf;

    --bg: #161617;
    --surface: #232325;
    --surface-2: #2c2c2e;
    --surface-3: #3a3a3c;
    --fill: rgba(120, 120, 128, .24);
    --fill-2: rgba(120, 120, 128, .34);
    --line: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
    --line-strong: rgba(84, 84, 88, .65);
    --text: #f5f5f7;
    --muted: #a1a1a6;
    --faint: #8e8e93;

    --primary-hover: #409cff;
    --primary-tint: rgba(10, 132, 255, .18);

    --shadow-1: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .06), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3);
    --shadow-2: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .08), 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
    --shadow-pop: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .12), 0 12px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
    --knob-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .16);
    --scrim: rgba(0, 0, 0, .5);
  }
}
html { font-family: var(--font); letter-spacing: -.006em; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { transition-duration: 0ms !important; animation-duration: 0ms !important; }
}
/* Keyboard focus: Apple's soft accent ring on controls. Text fields show focus on their own rounded field instead
   (pages use :focus-within on the wrapper), so the ring never lands on a bare input inside a styled box. */
:where(button, a, summary, select, [tabindex], [role="button"], [role="tab"], [role="radio"], [role="switch"], input[type="checkbox"], input[type="radio"], input[type="range"]):focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); }
:where(input, textarea):focus { outline: none; }
::selection { background: var(--primary-tint); }

    :root { --cloud: #a9b3c2; --primary: var(--blue); --primary-text: var(--blue-text); --rain: var(--cyan-text); }
    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root { --cloud: #d1d7e2; } }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { transition-duration: 0ms !important; } }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 10px; height: 8px; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--fill-2); border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid var(--bg); }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-button { display: none; }
    body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font: 14px/1.45 var(--font); display: flex; flex-direction: column; position: relative; }
    button, input { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
    svg { flex: none; }
    .ui { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    [hidden] { display: none !important; }

    .top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 14px 16px 6px; }
    .place { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 36px; padding: 4px 8px; margin-left: -8px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: none; cursor: pointer; font: 600 16px/1.3 var(--font-display); text-align: left; transition: background var(--fast); }
    .place:hover { background: var(--surface-2); }
    .place span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .seg { display: inline-flex; background: var(--fill); border-radius: 9px; padding: 2px; }
    .seg button { border: 0; background: none; color: var(--text); min-height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; }
    .seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.12), 0 3px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.04), 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0,0,0,.04); }
    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #636366; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.3); } }

    .main { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; padding: 0 16px 16px; }
    .now { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 8px 0 14px; }
    .now svg { width: 72px; height: 72px; }
    .temp { font: 300 56px/1 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -2px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .cond { font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; }
    .sub { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }
    .facts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .fact { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid transparent; box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 8px 10px; }
    .fact b { display: block; font-size: 15px; }
    .fact small { color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; font-weight: 600; }
    h2 { margin: 6px 0 8px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .hours { display: flex; gap: 6px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 6px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .hour { flex: none; width: 58px; padding: 8px 4px; text-align: center; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid transparent; box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); border-radius: var(--radius); }
    .hour .t { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
    .hour svg { width: 28px; height: 28px; margin: 4px auto; display: block; }
    .hour b { font-size: 14px; }
    .hour .p { color: var(--rain); font-size: 11px; min-height: 15px; }
    .days { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
    .day { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 48px 26px 36px 30px 1fr 30px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }
    .day:nth-child(odd) { background: var(--surface); }
    .day svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; }
    .day .p { color: var(--rain); font-size: 12px; }
    .day .lo { color: var(--muted); text-align: right; }
    .day .hi { text-align: right; }
    .bar { position: relative; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-3); }
    .bar i { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--cyan), var(--yellow), var(--orange)); }
    .foot { color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; margin-top: 12px; }

    .sheet { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 5; background: var(--bg); display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 14px 16px 8px; padding: 0 4px 0 12px; height: 44px; border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); background: var(--surface); color: var(--muted); }
    .search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: none; color: var(--text); }
    .search input::placeholder { color: var(--faint); }
    .icon-btn { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 0; background: none; color: var(--muted); display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; flex: none; }
    .icon-btn:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--surface-2); }
    .results { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 0 12px 12px 16px; }
    .opt { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 4px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
    .opt:hover, .opt:focus-visible { background: var(--surface); }
    .opt b { font-weight: 600; }
    .opt small { color: var(--muted); }
    .msg { padding: 28px 16px; color: var(--muted); text-align: center; }
    .msg b { display: block; color: var(--text); font: 600 17px/1.3 var(--font-display); margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .btn { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 0; background: var(--primary); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; margin-top: 12px; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="top">
    <button class="place" id="place" type="button" title="Change place"><svg class="ui" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 21s-7-6.2-7-11a7 7 0 0 1 14 0c0 4.8-7 11-7 11z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="2.5"/></svg><span id="placeName">Choose a place</span></button>
    <div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Units"><button type="button" id="uC" aria-pressed="true">°C</button><button type="button" id="uF" aria-pressed="false">°F</button></div>
  </div>
  <div class="main">
    <div class="msg" id="msg">Loading…</div>
    <div id="wx" hidden>
      <div class="now"><span id="nowIcon"></span><div class="temp" id="temp"></div><div><div class="cond" id="cond"></div><div class="sub" id="feels"></div><div class="sub" id="hilo"></div></div></div>
      <div class="facts">
        <div class="fact"><small>Rain</small><b id="fRain"></b></div>
        <div class="fact"><small>Wind</small><b id="fWind"></b></div>
        <div class="fact"><small>Humidity</small><b id="fHum"></b></div>
      </div>
      <h2>Next hours</h2>
      <div class="hours" id="hours"></div>
      <h2>This week</h2>
      <div class="days" id="days"></div>
      <div class="foot" id="foot"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="sheet" id="sheet" hidden>
    <div class="search"><svg class="ui" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M20 20l-3.5-3.5"/></svg>
      <input id="q" type="search" placeholder="Search for a town or city" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" aria-label="Search for a town or city">
      <button class="icon-btn" id="closeSheet" type="button" aria-label="Close"><svg class="ui" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg></button></div>
    <div class="results" id="results"></div>
  </div>
<script>
'use strict';
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const api = window.miniPage;
let store = {};
let data = null, fetchedAt = 0;

// ---------- weather codes (WMO) -> words and pictures ----------
const WORDS = { 0: 'Clear', 1: 'Mostly clear', 2: 'Partly cloudy', 3: 'Cloudy', 45: 'Fog', 48: 'Freezing fog', 51: 'Light drizzle', 53: 'Drizzle', 55: 'Heavy drizzle',
  56: 'Freezing drizzle', 57: 'Freezing drizzle', 61: 'Light rain', 63: 'Rain', 65: 'Heavy rain', 66: 'Freezing rain', 67: 'Freezing rain', 71: 'Light snow', 73: 'Snow',
  75: 'Heavy snow', 77: 'Snow grains', 80: 'Light showers', 81: 'Showers', 82: 'Heavy showers', 85: 'Snow showers', 86: 'Heavy snow showers', 95: 'Thunderstorm', 96: 'Thunder and hail', 99: 'Thunder and hail' };
const kind = (c) => c === 0 || c === 1 ? 'clear' : c === 2 ? 'part' : c === 3 ? 'cloud' : c === 45 || c === 48 ? 'fog'
  : (c >= 71 && c <= 77) || c === 85 || c === 86 ? 'snow' : c >= 95 ? 'storm' : 'rain';
const CLOUD = '<path d="M17.5 19H8a5 5 0 1 1 1.1-9.9A6 6 0 0 1 20.6 12 3.5 3.5 0 0 1 17.5 19z" style="fill:var(--cloud)"/>';
const SUN = '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5" fill="#ffcc00"/><g stroke="#ffcc00" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M2 12h2M20 12h2M4.9 4.9l1.4 1.4M17.7 17.7l1.4 1.4M4.9 19.1l1.4-1.4M17.7 6.3l1.4-1.4"/></g>';
const MOON = '<path d="M20 14.5A8 8 0 1 1 9.5 4a6.5 6.5 0 0 0 10.5 10.5z" style="fill:var(--cloud)"/>';
function icon(code, day = true) {
  const k = kind(code);
  let g;
  if (k === 'clear') g = day ? SUN : MOON;
  else if (k === 'part') g = `<g transform="translate(-2 -2) scale(.75)">${day ? SUN : MOON}</g><g transform="translate(3 4) scale(.82)">${CLOUD}</g>`;
  else if (k === 'cloud') g = `<g transform="translate(0 -1)">${CLOUD}</g>`;
  else if (k === 'fog') g = '<g style="stroke:var(--cloud)" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M4 9h16M3 13h18M5 17h14"/></g>';
  else if (k === 'snow') g = `<g transform="translate(0 -3)">${CLOUD}</g><g style="fill:var(--cloud)"><circle cx="8" cy="20" r="1.3"/><circle cx="12" cy="22" r="1.3"/><circle cx="16" cy="20" r="1.3"/></g>`;
  else if (k === 'storm') g = `<g transform="translate(0 -3)">${CLOUD}</g><path d="M13 15l-3 5h3l-2 4 5-6h-3l2-3z" fill="#ffcc00"/>`;
  else g = `<g transform="translate(0 -3)">${CLOUD}</g><g stroke="#32ade6" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M8 18l-1 3M12 18l-1 3M16 18l-1 3"/></g>`;
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">${g}</svg>`;
}

// ---------- talking to Open-Meteo (free, no account) ----------
async function getJson(url) {
  const r = await api.request({ url });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`The weather service said ${r.status}.`);
  return JSON.parse(r.text);
}
const F = () => store.units === 'f';
async function load(force) {
  if (!store.place) return showMsg('Where are you?', 'Pick your town or city to see the weather there.', true);
  if (!force && data && Date.now() - fetchedAt < 10 * 60 * 1000) return;
  const p = store.place;
  const q = new URLSearchParams({
    latitude: p.lat, longitude: p.lon, timezone: 'auto', forecast_days: '7',
    current: 'temperature_2m,apparent_temperature,weather_code,is_day,wind_speed_10m,relative_humidity_2m',
    hourly: 'temperature_2m,weather_code,precipitation_probability,is_day',
    daily: 'weather_code,temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_probability_max',
    temperature_unit: F() ? 'fahrenheit' : 'celsius', wind_speed_unit: F() ? 'mph' : 'kmh',
  });
  try {
    data = await getJson(`https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?${q}`);
    fetchedAt = Date.now();
    draw();
  } catch (err) {
    if (!data) showMsg("Couldn't get the weather", `${err.message || err} It'll try again in a few minutes.`);
  }
}

function showMsg(title, text, pick) {
  $('wx').hidden = true;
  $('msg').hidden = false;
  const b = document.createElement('b'); b.textContent = title;
  $('msg').replaceChildren(b, text);
  if (pick) {
    const btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.className = 'btn'; btn.type = 'button'; btn.textContent = 'Choose a place';
    btn.onclick = openSheet; $('msg').append(document.createElement('br'), btn);
  }
  document.title = 'Weather';
}

const r0 = (n) => Math.round(n);
function draw() {
  const c = data.current, d = data.daily, hr = data.hourly;
  $('msg').hidden = true; $('wx').hidden = false;
  $('nowIcon').innerHTML = icon(c.weather_code, !!c.is_day);
  $('temp').textContent = `${r0(c.temperature_2m)}°`;
  $('cond').textContent = WORDS[c.weather_code] || '';
  $('feels').textContent = `Feels like ${r0(c.apparent_temperature)}°`;
  $('hilo').textContent = `High ${r0(d.temperature_2m_max[0])}° · Low ${r0(d.temperature_2m_min[0])}°`;
  $('fRain').textContent = `${d.precipitation_probability_max[0] ?? 0}%`;
  $('fWind').textContent = `${r0(c.wind_speed_10m)} ${F() ? 'mph' : 'km/h'}`;
  $('fHum').textContent = `${c.relative_humidity_2m}%`;
  // the next 24 hours from now (times are local to the place)
  const nowHour = c.time.slice(0, 13);
  const start = Math.max(0, hr.time.findIndex((t) => t.slice(0, 13) >= nowHour));
  const hours = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < 24 && start + k < hr.time.length; k++) {
    const j = start + k, p = hr.precipitation_probability[j];
    const el = document.createElement('div'); el.className = 'hour';
    el.innerHTML = `<div class="t">${k === 0 ? 'Now' : hr.time[j].slice(11, 16)}</div>${icon(hr.weather_code[j], !!hr.is_day[j])}<b>${r0(hr.temperature_2m[j])}°</b><div class="p">${p >= 20 ? p + '%' : ''}</div>`;
    hours.push(el);
  }
  $('hours').replaceChildren(...hours);
  const lo = Math.min(...d.temperature_2m_min), hi = Math.max(...d.temperature_2m_max), span = Math.max(1, hi - lo);
  $('days').replaceChildren(...d.time.map((t, j) => {
    const el = document.createElement('div'); el.className = 'day';
    const name = j === 0 ? 'Today' : new Date(`${t}T12:00`).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { weekday: 'short' });
    const p = d.precipitation_probability_max[j];
    const left = ((d.temperature_2m_min[j] - lo) / span) * 100, width = ((d.temperature_2m_max[j] - d.temperature_2m_min[j]) / span) * 100;
    el.innerHTML = `<span>${name}</span>${icon(d.weather_code[j])}<span class="p">${p >= 20 ? p + '%' : ''}</span>`
      + `<span class="lo">${r0(d.temperature_2m_min[j])}°</span><div class="bar"><i style="left:${left.toFixed(1)}%;width:${Math.max(width, 4).toFixed(1)}%"></i></div>`
      + `<span class="hi">${r0(d.temperature_2m_max[j])}°</span>`;
    return el;
  }));
  $('foot').textContent = `Updated ${new Date(fetchedAt).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })} · Forecast by Open-Meteo`;
  // What the taskbar button shows, e.g. "14° Cloudy"
  document.title = `${r0(c.temperature_2m)}° ${WORDS[c.weather_code] || ''}`.trim();
}

// ---------- choosing a place ----------
function openSheet() { $('sheet').hidden = false; $('q').value = ''; $('results').replaceChildren(); $('closeSheet').hidden = !store.place; $('q').focus(); }
function closeSheet() { $('sheet').hidden = true; }
const note = (text) => { const m = document.createElement('div'); m.className = 'msg'; m.textContent = text; $('results').replaceChildren(m); };
let searchTimer = null, searchSeq = 0;
$('q').addEventListener('input', () => {
  clearTimeout(searchTimer);
  const text = $('q').value.trim();
  if (text.length < 2) { $('results').replaceChildren(); return; }
  searchTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
    const seq = ++searchSeq;
    try {
      const r = await getJson(`https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search?${new URLSearchParams({ name: text, count: '8', language: 'en', format: 'json' })}`);
      if (seq !== searchSeq) return;
      const list = r.results || [];
      if (!list.length) return note('No places found. Try another spelling.');
      $('results').replaceChildren(...list.map((x) => {
        const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'opt';
        const area = [x.admin1, x.country].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
        const n = document.createElement('b'); n.textContent = x.name;
        const s = document.createElement('small'); s.textContent = area;
        b.append(n, s);
        b.onclick = async () => {
          store = await api.store.set({ place: { name: x.name, area, lat: x.latitude, lon: x.longitude } });
          closeSheet(); data = null; showPlace(); $('msg').textContent = 'Loading…'; load(true);
        };
        return b;
      }));
    } catch { if (seq === searchSeq) note("Couldn't search right now. Check your internet connection."); }
  }, 300);
});
$('q').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.key === 'Escape' && store.place) closeSheet();
  const first = $('results').querySelector('.opt');
  if (e.key === 'Enter' && first) first.click();
  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' && first) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
});
$('results').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const opts = [...$('results').querySelectorAll('.opt')], i = opts.indexOf(document.activeElement);
  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' && i >= 0 && i < opts.length - 1) { e.preventDefault(); opts[i + 1].focus(); }
  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' && i >= 0) { e.preventDefault(); (i ? opts[i - 1] : $('q')).focus(); }
  if (e.key === 'Escape' && store.place) closeSheet();
});
$('closeSheet').onclick = closeSheet;
$('place').onclick = openSheet;

function showPlace() {
  $('placeName').textContent = store.place ? store.place.name : 'Choose a place';
  $('place').title = store.place ? `${store.place.name}${store.place.area ? ', ' + store.place.area : ''} (click to change)` : 'Choose a place';
  $('uC').setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(!F()));
  $('uF').setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(F()));
}
async function setUnits(u) { if ((u === 'f') === F()) return; store = await api.store.set({ units: u }); showPlace(); load(true); }
$('uC').onclick = () => setUnits('c');
$('uF').onclick = () => setUnits('f');

// Fresh weather every 15 minutes (so the button stays right), and when you open the panel.
setInterval(() => load(true), 15 * 60 * 1000);
window.addEventListener('mini-panel', (e) => { if (e.detail === 'shown') load(false); });

(async () => {
  try { store = await api.store.get(); } catch {}
  showPlace();
  if (!store.place) openSheet();
  load(true);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en-GB">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src data:">
  <title>Notes</title>
  <style>
    /* The hub theme (src/theme.css) is inlined at the marker below when the library is built. */
    /* Mini Apps theme: Apple Human Interface Guidelines. System colours in light and dark (follows Windows' app mode),
   SF-style type (SF Pro when installed, otherwise the bundled Inter, which is drawn on the same principles),
   the iOS type scale, 8pt spacing, concentric radii and Apple's standard easing. No glass: solid surfaces only.
   Shared by the software centre and every panel. The library build inlines this file into each app page
   at its theme marker, so pages stay self-contained; they then set --primary etc. to their own system colour. */
@font-face {
  font-family: "Inter var"; font-style: normal; font-weight: 100 900; font-display: block;
  src: url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");
}
:root {
  color-scheme: light dark;

  /* Apple system colours, light. "-text" variants are the accessible shades for text on light backgrounds. */
  --blue: #007aff;   --blue-text: #0066cc;
  --green: #34c759;  --green-text: #248a3d;
  --red: #ff3b30;    --red-text: #d70015;
  --orange: #ff9500; --orange-text: #c93400;
  --yellow: #ffcc00; --yellow-text: #a05a00;
  --indigo: #5856d6; --indigo-text: #3634a3;
  --purple: #af52de; --purple-text: #8944ab;
  --pink: #ff2d55;   --pink-text: #d30f45;
  --cyan: #32ade6;   --cyan-text: #0071a4;
  --mint: #00c7be;   --mint-text: #0c817b;

  /* Surfaces, in the order they stack: window, grouped content, controls on content. */
  --bg: #f5f5f7;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --surface-2: #f2f2f4;
  --surface-3: #e8e8ed;
  --fill: rgba(120, 120, 128, .12);      /* resting control fill (segmented track, search fields) */
  --fill-2: rgba(120, 120, 128, .2);     /* hover */
  --line: rgba(60, 60, 67, .13);         /* hairline separators and card edges */
  --line-strong: rgba(60, 60, 67, .29);  /* Apple's separator */
  --text: #1d1d1f;
  --muted: #6e6e73;                      /* secondary label, 4.9:1 on white */
  --faint: #76767b;                      /* tertiary, small labels only, 4.5:1 on white */

  --primary: var(--blue);   --primary-hover: #0077ed; --on-primary: #ffffff; --primary-text: var(--blue-text);
  --primary-tint: rgba(0, 122, 255, .1);
  --teal: var(--green);     --on-teal: #ffffff;       --teal-text: var(--green-text);  /* switches on, success */
  --danger: var(--red);     --danger-text: var(--red-text);

  --shadow-1: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04), 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
  --shadow-2: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
  --shadow-pop: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .1), 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .14), 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06);
  --knob-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
  --focus-ring: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 45%, transparent);   /* follows each app's accent */
  --scrim: rgba(0, 0, 0, .32);

  /* 8pt grid, concentric radii (inner + padding = outer). */
  --space-1: 4px; --space-2: 8px; --space-3: 12px; --space-4: 16px; --space-5: 20px; --space-6: 24px; --space-8: 32px;
  --radius-xs: 6px; --radius-sm: 8px; --radius: 12px; --radius-lg: 16px; --radius-xl: 20px; --radius-full: 999px;

  /* Motion: Apple's default curve and a soft spring-like ease-out (no overshoot on UI chrome). */
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.25, .1, .25, 1);
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1);
  --fast: 180ms;
  --normal: 280ms;

  /* Type: iOS scale. Body text is 14px here (desktop panels), titles follow the scale above it. */
  --font: "SF Pro Text", "Inter var", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-display: "SF Pro Display", "Inter var", "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --mono: "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace;
  --text-caption2: 11px; --text-caption: 12px; --text-footnote: 13px; --text-body: 14px; --text-callout: 15px;
  --text-headline: 17px; --text-title3: 20px; --text-title2: 22px; --text-title1: 28px; --text-large: 34px;
  --track-display: -.022em;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --blue: #0a84ff;   --blue-text: #2997ff;
    --green: #30d158;  --green-text: #30d158;
    --red: #ff453a;    --red-text: #ff6961;
    --orange: #ff9f0a; --orange-text: #ffb340;
    --yellow: #ffd60a; --yellow-text: #ffd426;
    --indigo: #5e5ce6; --indigo-text: #7d7aff;
    --purple: #bf5af2; --purple-text: #da8fff;
    --pink: #ff375f;   --pink-text: #ff6482;
    --cyan: #64d2ff;   --cyan-text: #70d7ff;
    --mint: #63e6e2;   --mint-text: #66d4cf;

    --bg: #161617;
    --surface: #232325;
    --surface-2: #2c2c2e;
    --surface-3: #3a3a3c;
    --fill: rgba(120, 120, 128, .24);
    --fill-2: rgba(120, 120, 128, .34);
    --line: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
    --line-strong: rgba(84, 84, 88, .65);
    --text: #f5f5f7;
    --muted: #a1a1a6;
    --faint: #8e8e93;

    --primary-hover: #409cff;
    --primary-tint: rgba(10, 132, 255, .18);

    --shadow-1: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .06), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3);

    --shadow-pop: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .12), 0 12px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);

    .controls { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; }
    .btn { min-height: 44px; min-width: 120px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 999px; border: 0; background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; }
    .btn:active { transform: scale(.97); }
    .round { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); color: var(--muted); display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; }
    .round:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--surface-2); }
    .round:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: default; }
    .round span { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="dial" id="dial">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 120 120" aria-hidden="true"><circle class="track" cx="60" cy="60" r="54"/><circle class="arc" id="arc" cx="60" cy="60" r="54"/></svg>
    <div class="read"><div class="time" id="time" role="timer" aria-live="off">5:00</div><div class="state" id="state"></div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="presets" id="presets">
    <div class="custom"><input id="mins" type="number" min="1" max="600" placeholder="15" aria-label="Custom minutes (press Enter to start)" title="Type minutes and press Enter"><small>min</small></div>
  </div>
  <div class="controls">
    <button class="round" id="reset" type="button" aria-label="Reset" title="Reset"><svg class="ui" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 12a8 8 0 1 0 2.3-5.6"/><path d="M4 4v4h4"/></svg></button>
    <button class="btn" id="go" type="button">Start</button>
    <button class="round" id="plus" type="button" aria-label="Add a minute" title="Add a minute"><span>+1</span></button>
  </div>
<script>
'use strict';
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const api = window.miniPage;
const MIN = 60000;
const PRESETS = [1, 5, 10, 25, 45, 60];
// dur: the length you picked; endAt: when it ends (running); left: what's left (paused); doneAt: when it rang.
let s = { dur: 5 * MIN, endAt: null, left: null, doneAt: null };
const persist = () => api.store.set({ dur: s.dur, endAt: s.endAt, left: s.left, doneAt: s.doneAt }).catch(() => {});

const remaining = () => s.endAt ? Math.max(0, s.endAt - Date.now()) : s.left != null ? s.left : s.dur;
const running = () => !!s.endAt;
const fmt = (ms) => {
  const t = Math.ceil(ms / 1000), h = Math.floor(t / 3600), m = Math.floor((t % 3600) / 60), sec = t % 60;
  return h ? `${h}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(sec).padStart(2, '0')}` : `${m}:${String(sec).padStart(2, '0')}`;
};
const nice = (ms) => { const m = Math.round(ms / MIN); return m >= 60 && m % 60 === 0 ? `${m / 60} hour${m === 60 ? '' : 's'}` : `${m} minute${m === 1 ? '' : 's'}`; };

// ---------- presets ----------
const chips = PRESETS.map((m) => {
  const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'chip';
  b.textContent = m >= 60 ? `${m / 60} hr` : `${m} min`;
  b.onclick = () => pick(m * MIN, true);
  return [m, b];
});
$('presets').prepend(...chips.map(([, b]) => b));
function pick(ms, start) {
  stopRinging();
  s = { dur: ms, endAt: start ? Date.now() + ms : null, left: null, doneAt: null };
  persist(); draw();
}
$('mins').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.key !== 'Enter') return;
  const m = Math.round(Number($('mins').value));
  $('mins').value = '';
  if (!(m >= 1 && m <= 600)) return;
  $('mins').blur();
  pick(m * MIN, true);
});

// ---------- controls ----------
$('go').onclick = () => {
  if (ringing || s.doneAt) { pick(s.dur, false); return; }
  if (running()) { s.left = remaining(); s.endAt = null; }
  else { s.endAt = Date.now() + remaining(); s.left = null; }
  persist(); draw();
};
$('reset').onclick = () => pick(s.dur, false);
$('plus').onclick = () => {
  if (ringing || s.doneAt) { stopRinging(); s = { dur: MIN, endAt: Date.now() + MIN, left: null, doneAt: null }; }
  else if (running()) { s.endAt += MIN; s.dur += MIN; }
  else { s.left = remaining() + MIN; s.dur = Math.max(s.dur, s.left); }
  persist(); draw();
};
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || e.target.tagName === 'BUTTON') return;
  if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); $('go').click(); }
  if (e.key === 'r' || e.key === 'R') $('reset').click();
});

// ---------- drawing (about 4 times a second) ----------
const C = 2 * Math.PI * 54;
$('arc').style.strokeDasharray = C.toFixed(2);
let lastTitle = '';
function draw() {
  const left = remaining(), done = !!s.doneAt;
  const paused = !running() && !done && s.left != null && s.left < s.dur;
  $('time').textContent = done ? '0:00' : fmt(left);
  const frac = done ? 1 : 1 - left / Math.max(1, s.dur);
  $('arc').style.strokeDashoffset = (done ? 0 : C * frac).toFixed(2);
  $('dial').classList.toggle('done', done);
  $('dial').classList.toggle('ringing', ringing);
  $('state').textContent = done ? "Time's up" : running() ? `Ends at ${new Date(s.endAt).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}` : paused ? 'Paused' : nice(s.dur);
  $('go').textContent = done ? (ringing ? 'Stop' : 'Done') : running() ? 'Pause' : paused ? 'Resume' : 'Start';
  $('reset').disabled = !running() && !paused && !done;
  for (const [m, b] of chips) b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(m * MIN === s.dur));
  // What the taskbar button shows, e.g. "12:34"
  const title = done ? "Time's up!" : running() ? fmt(left) : paused ? `Paused ${fmt(left)}` : 'Timer';
  if (title !== lastTitle) { document.title = title; lastTitle = title; }
}

// ---------- when time's up ----------
let ringing = false, audio = null, ringIv = null, ringStop = null;
function beepPattern() {
  try {
    audio = audio || new AudioContext();
    const t0 = audio.currentTime;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const at = t0 + i * 0.25, o = audio.createOscillator(), g = audio.createGain();
      o.type = 'sine'; o.frequency.value = 880;
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, at);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.35, at + 0.02);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, at + 0.18);
      o.connect(g).connect(audio.destination);
      o.start(at); o.stop(at + 0.2);
    }
  } catch {}
}
function ring() {
  ringing = true;
  beepPattern();
  ringIv = setInterval(beepPattern, 1500);
  ringStop = setTimeout(stopRinging, 30000); // rings for 30 seconds at most
  try { new Notification("Time's up", { body: `Your ${nice(s.dur)} timer has finished.`, silent: true }); } catch {}
  if (api.show) api.show().catch(() => {});
}
function stopRinging() {
  if (!ringing) return;
  ringing = false;
  clearInterval(ringIv); clearTimeout(ringStop);
  draw();
}
function tick() {
  if (running() && remaining() <= 0) {
    s.endAt = null; s.left = null; s.doneAt = Date.now();
    persist(); ring();
  }
  draw();
}
setInterval(tick, 250);

(async () => {
  try {
    const got = await api.store.get();
    if (got && typeof got.dur === 'number' && got.dur > 0) s = { dur: got.dur, endAt: got.endAt || null, left: got.left ?? null, doneAt: got.doneAt || null };
  } catch {}
  // Finished while Mini Apps was closed? Say so, but only ring if it was just now.
  if (s.endAt && s.endAt <= Date.now()) {
    const late = Date.now() - s.endAt;
    s.endAt = null; s.left = null; s.doneAt = Date.now(); persist();
    if (late < 60000) ring();
  }
  draw();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en-GB">
<head>
