  <title>Converter</title>
  <style>
    /* The hub theme (src/theme.css) is inlined at the marker below when the library is built. */
    /* Mini Apps theme: Apple Human Interface Guidelines. System colours in light and dark (follows Windows' app mode),
   SF-style type (SF Pro when installed, otherwise the bundled Inter, which is drawn on the same principles),
   the iOS type scale, 8pt spacing, concentric radii and Apple's standard easing. No glass: solid surfaces only.
   Shared by the software centre and every panel. The library build inlines this file into each app page
   at its theme marker, so pages stay self-contained; they then set --primary etc. to their own system colour. */
@font-face {
  font-family: "Inter var"; font-style: normal; font-weight: 100 900; font-display: block;
  src: url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");
}
:root {
  color-scheme: light dark;

  /* Apple system colours, light. "-text" variants are the accessible shades for text on light backgrounds. */
  --blue: #007aff;   --blue-text: #0066cc;
  --green: #34c759;  --green-text: #248a3d;
  --red: #ff3b30;    --red-text: #d70015;
  --orange: #ff9500; --orange-text: #c93400;
  --yellow: #ffcc00; --yellow-text: #a05a00;
  --indigo: #5856d6; --indigo-text: #3634a3;
  --purple: #af52de; --purple-text: #8944ab;
  --pink: #ff2d55;   --pink-text: #d30f45;
  --cyan: #32ade6;   --cyan-text: #0071a4;
  --mint: #00c7be;   --mint-text: #0c817b;

  /* Surfaces, in the order they stack: window, grouped content, controls on content. */
  --bg: #f5f5f7;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --surface-2: #f2f2f4;
  --surface-3: #e8e8ed;
  --fill: rgba(120, 120, 128, .12);      /* resting control fill (segmented track, search fields) */
  --fill-2: rgba(120, 120, 128, .2);     /* hover */
  --line: rgba(60, 60, 67, .13);         /* hairline separators and card edges */
  --line-strong: rgba(60, 60, 67, .29);  /* Apple's separator */
  --text: #1d1d1f;
  --muted: #6e6e73;                      /* secondary label, 4.9:1 on white */
  --faint: #76767b;                      /* tertiary, small labels only, 4.5:1 on white */

  --primary: var(--blue);   --primary-hover: #0077ed; --on-primary: #ffffff; --primary-text: var(--blue-text);
  --primary-tint: rgba(0, 122, 255, .1);
  --teal: var(--green);     --on-teal: #ffffff;       --teal-text: var(--green-text);  /* switches on, success */
  --danger: var(--red);     --danger-text: var(--red-text);

  --shadow-1: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04), 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
  --shadow-2: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
  --shadow-pop: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .1), 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .14), 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06);
  --knob-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
  --focus-ring: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 45%, transparent);   /* follows each app's accent */
  --scrim: rgba(0, 0, 0, .32);

  /* 8pt grid, concentric radii (inner + padding = outer). */
  --space-1: 4px; --space-2: 8px; --space-3: 12px; --space-4: 16px; --space-5: 20px; --space-6: 24px; --space-8: 32px;
  --radius-xs: 6px; --radius-sm: 8px; --radius: 12px; --radius-lg: 16px; --radius-xl: 20px; --radius-full: 999px;

  /* Motion: Apple's default curve and a soft spring-like ease-out (no overshoot on UI chrome). */
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.25, .1, .25, 1);
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1);
  --fast: 180ms;
  --normal: 280ms;

  /* Type: iOS scale. Body text is 14px here (desktop panels), titles follow the scale above it. */
  --font: "SF Pro Text", "Inter var", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-display: "SF Pro Display", "Inter var", "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --mono: "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace;
  --text-caption2: 11px; --text-caption: 12px; --text-footnote: 13px; --text-body: 14px; --text-callout: 15px;
  --text-headline: 17px; --text-title3: 20px; --text-title2: 22px; --text-title1: 28px; --text-large: 34px;
  --track-display: -.022em;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --blue: #0a84ff;   --blue-text: #2997ff;
    --green: #30d158;  --green-text: #30d158;
    --red: #ff453a;    --red-text: #ff6961;
    --orange: #ff9f0a; --orange-text: #ffb340;
    --yellow: #ffd60a; --yellow-text: #ffd426;
    --indigo: #5e5ce6; --indigo-text: #7d7aff;
    --purple: #bf5af2; --purple-text: #da8fff;
    --pink: #ff375f;   --pink-text: #ff6482;
    --cyan: #64d2ff;   --cyan-text: #70d7ff;
    --mint: #63e6e2;   --mint-text: #66d4cf;

    --bg: #161617;
    --surface: #232325;
    --surface-2: #2c2c2e;
    --surface-3: #3a3a3c;
    --fill: rgba(120, 120, 128, .24);
    --fill-2: rgba(120, 120, 128, .34);
    --line: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
    --line-strong: rgba(84, 84, 88, .65);
    --text: #f5f5f7;
    --muted: #a1a1a6;
    --faint: #8e8e93;

    --primary-hover: #409cff;
    --primary-tint: rgba(10, 132, 255, .18);

    --shadow-1: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .06), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3);
    --shadow-2: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .08), 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
    --shadow-pop: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .12), 0 12px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
    --knob-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .16);
    --scrim: rgba(0, 0, 0, .5);
  }
}
html { font-family: var(--font); letter-spacing: -.006em; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { transition-duration: 0ms !important; animation-duration: 0ms !important; }
}
/* Keyboard focus: Apple's soft accent ring on controls. Text fields show focus on their own rounded field instead
   (pages use :focus-within on the wrapper), so the ring never lands on a bare input inside a styled box. */
:where(button, a, summary, select, [tabindex], [role="button"], [role="tab"], [role="radio"], [role="switch"], input[type="checkbox"], input[type="radio"], input[type="range"]):focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); }
:where(input, textarea):focus { outline: none; }
::selection { background: var(--primary-tint); }

    :root { --primary: var(--orange); --primary-text: var(--orange-text); --on-primary: #fff; --primary-tint: color-mix(in srgb, var(--orange) 14%, transparent); --warn: var(--red-text); }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { transition-duration: 0ms !important; animation: none !important; } }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; }
    body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font: 14px/1.45 var(--font); display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
    button, input, select { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
    .ui { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; flex: none; }
    [hidden] { display: none !important; }

    .ask { padding: 14px 14px 8px; }
    .ask label { position: relative; display: block; }
    .ask .ui { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: var(--faint); pointer-events: none; }
    .ask input { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 12px 0 38px; border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); }
    .ask input::placeholder { color: var(--faint); }
    .ask input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary); box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); }
    .ask .msg { color: var(--faint); font-size: 12px; min-height: 18px; padding: 4px 2px 0; }
    .ask .msg.bad { color: var(--warn); }

    .cats { display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 0 14px 10px; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; flex: none; }
    .cats::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .chip { flex: none; min-height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; transition: background var(--fast), color var(--fast); }
    .chip:hover { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text); }
    .chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--primary); border-color: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); }

    main { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 4px 14px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .card { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid transparent; box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
    .side { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .side input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--fill);
      font: 600 22px/1 var(--font-display); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .side input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary); box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); }
    .side output { flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--surface-2);
      font: 600 22px/1 var(--font-display); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; cursor: copy; }
    select { width: 140px; flex: none; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--fill); cursor: pointer; }
    select:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary); box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); }
    option { background: var(--surface); }
    .mid { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .mid .line { flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--line); }
    .icon-btn { width: 34px; height: 34px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--fill); color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--fast), color var(--fast); }
    .icon-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--text); }
    .icon-btn[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--primary-text); border-color: var(--primary); }
    .rate { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; text-align: center; }

    .also h2 { margin: 6px 2px 4px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--faint); }
    .also-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 6px; }
    .also-list button { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow-1);
      text-align: left; cursor: pointer; min-width: 0; transition: background var(--fast); }
    .also-list button:hover { background: var(--surface-2); }
    .also-list b { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .also-list small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

    footer { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--faint); font-size: 12px; }
    footer span { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    footer button { border: 0; background: none; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; padding: 4px; }
    footer button:hover { color: var(--text); }
    .toast { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 46px; transform: translateX(-50%); background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--text); padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; opacity: 0; transition: opacity var(--fast); pointer-events: none; }
    .toast.show { opacity: 1; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="ask">
    <label><svg class="ui" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M20 20l-3.5-3.5"/></svg>
      <input id="ask" placeholder="Try "50 usd to gbp" or "6 ft in cm"" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" aria-label="Type a conversion"></label>
    <div class="msg" id="msg" role="status"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="cats" id="cats" role="toolbar" aria-label="What to convert"></div>
  <main>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="side"><input id="amount" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Amount"><select id="from" aria-label="From"></select></div>
      <div class="mid"><span class="line"></span>
        <button class="icon-btn" id="swap" type="button" aria-label="Swap" title="Swap"><svg class="ui" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M7 4v16M3 8l4-4 4 4M17 20V4M13 16l4 4 4-4"/></svg></button>
        <button class="icon-btn" id="pin" type="button" aria-label="Show on the taskbar button" aria-pressed="false" title="Show this rate on the taskbar button"><svg class="ui" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 4h6l-1 6 4 4H6l4-4zM12 14v6"/></svg></button>
        <span class="line"></span></div>
      <div class="side"><output id="result" title="Click to copy" tabindex="0"></output><select id="to" aria-label="To"></select></div>
      <div class="rate" id="rate"></div>
    </div>
    <section class="also" id="also"><h2 id="alsoTitle">Also</h2><div class="also-list" id="alsoList"></div></section>
  </main>
  <footer><span id="status"></span><button type="button" id="refresh">Refresh rates</button></footer>
  <div class="toast" id="toast" role="status"></div>
  <script>
  (() => {
    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
    const api = window.miniPage;
    const RATE_TTL = 6 * 3600 * 1000;

    // ---------- units: [name, factor to the category's base unit] ----------
    const CATS = {
      currency: { name: 'Currency' },
      length: { name: 'Length', units: { mm: ['Millimetres', 0.001], cm: ['Centimetres', 0.01], m: ['Metres', 1], km: ['Kilometres', 1000], in: ['Inches', 0.0254], ft: ['Feet', 0.3048], yd: ['Yards', 0.9144], mi: ['Miles', 1609.344], nmi: ['Nautical miles', 1852] },
        also: ['cm', 'm', 'ft', 'in', 'km', 'mi'] },
      weight: { name: 'Weight', units: { mg: ['Milligrams', 1e-6], g: ['Grams', 0.001], kg: ['Kilograms', 1], t: ['Tonnes', 1000], oz: ['Ounces', 0.028349523125], lb: ['Pounds', 0.45359237], st: ['Stone', 6.35029318] },
        also: ['g', 'kg', 'oz', 'lb', 'st'] },
      temp: { name: 'Temperature', units: { c: ['Celsius'], f: ['Fahrenheit'], k: ['Kelvin'] }, also: ['c', 'f', 'k'] },
      volume: { name: 'Volume', units: { ml: ['Millilitres', 0.001], l: ['Litres', 1], tsp: ['Teaspoons', 0.00492892159], tbsp: ['Tablespoons', 0.0147867648], cup: ['Cups (US)', 0.2365882365], floz: ['Fl oz (UK)', 0.0284130625],
        usfloz: ['Fl oz (US)', 0.0295735296], pt: ['Pints (UK)', 0.56826125], uspt: ['Pints (US)', 0.473176473], gal: ['Gallons (UK)', 4.54609], usgal: ['Gallons (US)', 3.785411784], m3: ['Cubic metres', 1000] },
        also: ['ml', 'l', 'pt', 'cup', 'floz', 'gal'] },
      speed: { name: 'Speed', units: { kmh: ['km/h', 1 / 3.6], mph: ['mph', 0.44704], ms: ['m/s', 1], kn: ['Knots', 0.514444444], fts: ['ft/s', 0.3048] }, also: ['kmh', 'mph', 'ms', 'kn'] },
      area: { name: 'Area', units: { cm2: ['cm²', 1e-4], m2: ['m²', 1], km2: ['km²', 1e6], ft2: ['sq ft', 0.09290304], yd2: ['sq yd', 0.83612736], ac: ['Acres', 4046.8564224], ha: ['Hectares', 1e4], mi2: ['sq mi', 2589988.110336] },
        also: ['m2', 'ft2', 'ac', 'ha'] },
      data: { name: 'Data', units: { bit: ['Bits', 0.125], b: ['Bytes', 1], kb: ['KB', 1e3], mb: ['MB', 1e6], gb: ['GB', 1e9], tb: ['TB', 1e12], kib: ['KiB', 1024], mib: ['MiB', 1048576], gib: ['GiB', 1073741824], mbit: ['Megabits', 125000] },
        also: ['mb', 'gb', 'mib', 'gib', 'mbit'] },
      time: { name: 'Time', units: { ms: ['Milliseconds', 0.001], s: ['Seconds', 1], min: ['Minutes', 60], h: ['Hours', 3600], d: ['Days', 86400], wk: ['Weeks', 604800], mo: ['Months', 2629746], yr: ['Years', 31556952] },
        also: ['min', 'h', 'd', 'wk'] },
    };
    const SHORT = { mm: 'mm', cm: 'cm', m: 'm', km: 'km', in: 'in', ft: 'ft', yd: 'yd', mi: 'mi', nmi: 'nmi', mg: 'mg', g: 'g', kg: 'kg', t: 't', oz: 'oz', lb: 'lb', st: 'st',
      c: '°C', f: '°F', k: 'K', ml: 'ml', l: 'l', tsp: 'tsp', tbsp: 'tbsp', cup: 'cups', floz: 'fl oz', usfloz: 'US fl oz', pt: 'pints', uspt: 'US pints', gal: 'gal', usgal: 'US gal', m3: 'm³',
      kmh: 'km/h', mph: 'mph', ms: 'm/s', kn: 'kn', fts: 'ft/s', cm2: 'cm²', m2: 'm²', km2: 'km²', ft2: 'sq ft', yd2: 'sq yd', ac: 'acres', ha: 'ha', mi2: 'sq mi',
      bit: 'bits', b: 'B', kb: 'KB', mb: 'MB', gb: 'GB', tb: 'TB', kib: 'KiB', mib: 'MiB', gib: 'GiB', mbit: 'Mbit', s: 's', min: 'min', h: 'h', d: 'days', wk: 'weeks', mo: 'months', yr: 'years' };
    const shortOf = (cat, u) => (cat === 'currency' ? u : cat === 'time' && u === 'ms' ? 'ms' : SHORT[u] || u);
    const ALSO_CURRENCIES = ['GBP', 'USD', 'EUR', 'JPY', 'INR', 'AUD', 'CAD', 'CHF', 'CNY', 'AED'];
    const DEFAULTS = { currency: ['GBP', 'USD'], length: ['cm', 'in'], weight: ['kg', 'lb'], temp: ['c', 'f'], volume: ['ml', 'floz'], speed: ['kmh', 'mph'], area: ['m2', 'ft2'], data: ['gb', 'gib'], time: ['h', 'min'] };

    // Words people type → [category, unit]
    const ALIAS = {};
    const say = (cat, unit, ...words) => words.forEach((w) => { ALIAS[w] = [cat, unit]; });
    say('length', 'mm', 'mm', 'millimetre', 'millimetres', 'millimeter', 'millimeters');
    say('length', 'cm', 'cm', 'cms', 'centimetre', 'centimetres', 'centimeter', 'centimeters');
    say('length', 'm', 'm', 'metre', 'metres', 'meter', 'meters');
    say('length', 'km', 'km', 'kms', 'kilometre', 'kilometres', 'kilometer', 'kilometers');
    say('length', 'in', 'in', 'inch', 'inches', '"');
    say('length', 'ft', 'ft', 'foot', 'feet', "'");
    say('length', 'yd', 'yd', 'yds', 'yard', 'yards');
    say('length', 'mi', 'mi', 'mile', 'miles');
    say('length', 'nmi', 'nmi', 'nautical mile', 'nautical miles');
    say('weight', 'mg', 'mg', 'milligram', 'milligrams');
    say('weight', 'g', 'g', 'gram', 'grams', 'gramme', 'grammes');
    say('weight', 'kg', 'kg', 'kgs', 'kilo', 'kilos', 'kilogram', 'kilograms');
    say('weight', 't', 'tonne', 'tonnes', 'ton', 'tons');
    say('weight', 'oz', 'oz', 'ounce', 'ounces');
    say('weight', 'lb', 'lb', 'lbs', 'pound weight', 'pounds weight');
    say('weight', 'st', 'st', 'stone', 'stones');
    say('temp', 'c', 'c', '°c', 'celsius', 'centigrade', 'degrees c', 'deg c');
    say('temp', 'f', 'f', '°f', 'fahrenheit', 'degrees f', 'deg f');
    say('temp', 'k', 'k', 'kelvin');
    say('volume', 'ml', 'ml', 'millilitre', 'millilitres', 'milliliter', 'milliliters');
    say('volume', 'l', 'l', 'litre', 'litres', 'liter', 'liters');
    say('volume', 'tsp', 'tsp', 'teaspoon', 'teaspoons');
    say('volume', 'tbsp', 'tbsp', 'tablespoon', 'tablespoons');
    say('volume', 'cup', 'cup', 'cups');
    say('volume', 'floz', 'fl oz', 'floz', 'fluid ounce', 'fluid ounces');
    say('volume', 'pt', 'pt', 'pint', 'pints');
    say('volume', 'gal', 'gal', 'gallon', 'gallons');
    say('volume', 'usgal', 'us gal', 'us gallon', 'us gallons');
    say('volume', 'm3', 'm3', 'm³', 'cubic metre', 'cubic metres');
    say('speed', 'kmh', 'kmh', 'km/h', 'kph', 'kmph');
    say('speed', 'mph', 'mph');
    say('speed', 'ms', 'm/s', 'mps');
    say('speed', 'kn', 'kn', 'knot', 'knots');
    say('area', 'm2', 'm2', 'm²', 'sqm', 'sq m', 'square metres', 'square meters');
    say('area', 'ft2', 'ft2', 'ft²', 'sqft', 'sq ft', 'square feet');
    say('area', 'ac', 'acre', 'acres');
    say('area', 'ha', 'ha', 'hectare', 'hectares');
    say('area', 'km2', 'km2', 'km²', 'sq km');
    say('data', 'b', 'byte', 'bytes');
    say('data', 'kb', 'kb', 'kilobyte', 'kilobytes');
    say('data', 'mb', 'mb', 'megabyte', 'megabytes');
    say('data', 'gb', 'gb', 'gig', 'gigs', 'gigabyte', 'gigabytes');
    say('data', 'tb', 'tb', 'terabyte', 'terabytes');
    say('data', 'mbit', 'mbit', 'mbps', 'megabit', 'megabits');
    say('data', 'bit', 'bit', 'bits');
    say('data', 'kib', 'kib', 'kibibyte', 'kibibytes');
    say('data', 'mib', 'mib', 'mebibyte', 'mebibytes');
    say('data', 'gib', 'gib', 'gibibyte', 'gibibytes');
    say('time', 'ms', 'ms', 'millisecond', 'milliseconds');
    say('length', 'nmi', 'nmi');
    say('area', 'yd2', 'yd2', 'sq yd', 'square yards');
    say('area', 'mi2', 'mi2', 'sq mi', 'square miles');
    say('area', 'cm2', 'cm2', 'cm²');
    say('volume', 'usfloz', 'us fl oz', 'us floz');
    say('volume', 'uspt', 'us pint', 'us pints');
    say('speed', 'fts', 'ft/s', 'fps');
    say('time', 's', 's', 'sec', 'secs', 'second', 'seconds');
    say('time', 'min', 'min', 'mins', 'minute', 'minutes');
    say('time', 'h', 'h', 'hr', 'hrs', 'hour', 'hours');
    say('time', 'd', 'day', 'days');
    say('time', 'wk', 'wk', 'week', 'weeks');
    say('time', 'mo', 'month', 'months');
    say('time', 'yr', 'yr', 'yrs', 'year', 'years');
    // "pounds" on its own means money here (people say "lbs" for weight).
    const CURRENCY_WORDS = { '£': 'GBP', '$': 'USD', '€': 'EUR', '¥': 'JPY', '₹': 'INR', pound: 'GBP', pounds: 'GBP', quid: 'GBP', sterling: 'GBP', dollar: 'USD', dollars: 'USD', bucks: 'USD',
      euro: 'EUR', euros: 'EUR', yen: 'JPY', rupee: 'INR', rupees: 'INR', franc: 'CHF', francs: 'CHF', yuan: 'CNY', dirham: 'AED', dirhams: 'AED' };

    // ---------- state ----------
    let st = { cat: 'currency', from: 'GBP', to: 'USD', amount: '1', pin: null };
    let rates = null;   // { at, base: 'USD', rates: { GBP: 0.79, ... } }
    let ratesError = '';
    const save = () => api.store.set({ cat: st.cat, from: st.from, to: st.to, amount: st.amount, pin: st.pin }).catch(() => {});
    let names = null;
    try { names = new Intl.DisplayNames(['en-GB'], { type: 'currency' }); } catch {}
    const curName = (c) => { try { return (names && names.of(c)) || c; } catch { return c; } };
    const unitsOf = (cat) => (cat === 'currency' ? (rates ? Object.keys(rates.rates).sort() : ['EUR', 'GBP', 'USD']) : Object.keys(CATS[cat].units));
    const labelOf = (cat, u) => (cat === 'currency' ? curName(u) : CATS[cat].units[u][0]);

    function convert(cat, v, from, to) {
      if (cat === 'currency') {
        if (!rates || !rates.rates[from] || !rates.rates[to]) return NaN;
        return (v / rates.rates[from]) * rates.rates[to];
      }
      if (cat === 'temp') {
        const c = from === 'c' ? v : from === 'f' ? (v - 32) * 5 / 9 : v - 273.15;
        return to === 'c' ? c : to === 'f' ? c * 9 / 5 + 32 : c + 273.15;
      }
      const u = CATS[cat].units;
      return (v * u[from][1]) / u[to][1];
    }
    function fmt(cat, n, unit) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return '–';
      if (cat === 'currency') {
        const abs = Math.abs(n);
        const max = abs >= 1 || abs === 0 ? 2 : Math.min(6, 1 - Math.floor(Math.log10(abs)) + 1);
        try { return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-GB', { style: 'currency', currency: unit, currencyDisplay: 'narrowSymbol', minimumFractionDigits: Math.min(2, max), maximumFractionDigits: max }).format(n); }
        catch { return `${n.toFixed(2)} ${unit}`; }
      }
      const abs = Math.abs(n);
      const opts = abs !== 0 && (abs >= 1e12 || abs < 1e-6) ? { notation: 'scientific', maximumSignificantDigits: 5 }
        : abs >= 100 ? { maximumFractionDigits: 2 } : abs >= 1 ? { maximumFractionDigits: 3 } : { maximumSignificantDigits: 4 };
      return `${new Intl.NumberFormat('en-GB', opts).format(n)} ${shortOf(cat, unit)}`;
    }
    const parseAmount = (t) => { const v = parseFloat(String(t).replace(/,/g, '').replace(/[^\d.eE+-]/g, '')); return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : NaN; };

    // ---------- the "type it" box ----------
    function findUnit(word, catHint) {
      const w = word.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
      if (!w) return null;
      if (CURRENCY_WORDS[w]) return ['currency', CURRENCY_WORDS[w]];
      if (/^[a-z]{3}$/.test(w) && (!rates || rates.rates[w.toUpperCase()])) {
        // Three letters that are also a unit (e.g. "min") stay a unit unless we're already doing currency.
        if (!ALIAS[w] || catHint === 'currency') return rates || /^(gbp|usd|eur|jpy|inr|aud|cad|chf|cny|aed|nzd|sek|nok|dkk|pln|zar|sgd|hkd|try|mxn|brl|thb|krw)$/.test(w) ? ['currency', w.toUpperCase()] : null;
      }
      if (ALIAS[w]) {
        if (w === 'm' && catHint === 'time') return ['time', 'min'];   // "m" is minutes when it's about time
        return ALIAS[w];
      }
      return null;
    }
    const NUM = '([-+]?(?:\\d[\\d,]*)?\\.?\\d+(?:e[-+]?\\d+)?)';
    const RE_FULL = new RegExp(`^\\s*([£$€¥₹])?\\s*${NUM}?\\s*(.*?)\\s*(?:\\bto\\b|\\bin\\b|\\binto\\b|=|->|→|\\bas\\b)\\s*(.+?)\\s*$`, 'i');
    const RE_ONE = new RegExp(`^\\s*([£$€¥₹])?\\s*${NUM}\\s*(.*?)\\s*$`, 'i');
    function understand(text) {
      const t = text.trim();
      if (!t) return null;
      const m = t.match(RE_FULL) || t.match(RE_ONE);
      if (!m) return { error: 'Try something like "50 usd to gbp" or "6 ft in cm".' };
      const amount = m[2] !== undefined ? parseAmount(m[2]) : 1;
      const fromWord = m[1] || m[3] || '';
      let first = findUnit(fromWord, st.cat);
      if (!first) return { error: fromWord.trim() ? `I don't know "${fromWord.trim()}".` : 'Add a unit, like "50 usd to gbp".' };
      const toWord = m[4];
      let second = toWord ? findUnit(toWord, first[0]) : null;
      if (toWord && !second) return { error: `I don't know "${toWord.trim()}".` };
      if (second && second[0] !== first[0] && second[0] === 'time' && fromWord.trim().toLowerCase() === 'm') first = ['time', 'min'];
      if (second && second[0] !== first[0]) return { error: `Can't turn ${CATS[first[0]].name.toLowerCase()} into ${CATS[second[0]].name.toLowerCase()}.` };
      if (!second) {
        const d = DEFAULTS[first[0]];
        second = [first[0], st.cat === first[0] && st.to !== first[1] ? st.to : first[1] === d[0] ? d[1] : d[0]];
      }
      return { cat: first[0], from: first[1], to: second[1], amount };
    }
    $('ask').addEventListener('input', () => {
      const r = understand($('ask').value);
      const msg = $('msg');
      msg.className = 'msg'; msg.textContent = '';
      if (!r) return;
      if (r.error) { msg.textContent = r.error; msg.className = 'msg bad'; return; }
      st = { ...st, cat: r.cat, from: r.from, to: r.to, amount: Number.isFinite(r.amount) ? String(r.amount) : st.amount };
      draw(); save();
    });
    $('ask').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && $('ask').value) { e.stopPropagation(); $('ask').value = ''; $('msg').textContent = ''; }
      if (e.key === 'Enter') copyResult();
    });

    // ---------- drawing ----------
    function fillSelect(sel, cat, value) {
      const list = unitsOf(cat);
      if (sel.dataset.cat !== cat || sel.options.length !== list.length) {
        sel.replaceChildren(...list.map((u) => {
          const o = document.createElement('option');
          o.value = u;
          o.textContent = cat === 'currency' ? `${u} · ${curName(u)}` : labelOf(cat, u);
          return o;
        }));
        sel.dataset.cat = cat;
      }
      sel.value = value;
    }
    let lastTitle = '';
    function pinText() {
      const p = st.pin;
      if (!p) return 'Converter';
      const v = convert(p.cat, 1, p.from, p.to);
      if (!Number.isFinite(v)) return 'Converter';
      return `1 ${shortOf(p.cat, p.from)} = ${fmt(p.cat, v, p.to)}`;
    }
    function draw() {
      $('cats').querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach((b) => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.dataset.cat === st.cat)));
      if (!unitsOf(st.cat).includes(st.from)) st.from = DEFAULTS[st.cat][0];
      if (!unitsOf(st.cat).includes(st.to)) st.to = DEFAULTS[st.cat][1];
      fillSelect($('from'), st.cat, st.from);
      fillSelect($('to'), st.cat, st.to);
      if (document.activeElement !== $('amount')) $('amount').value = st.amount;
      const v = parseAmount(st.amount);
      const out = convert(st.cat, Number.isFinite(v) ? v : 0, st.from, st.to);
      $('result').textContent = fmt(st.cat, out, st.to);
      const one = convert(st.cat, 1, st.from, st.to);
      $('rate').textContent = st.cat === 'currency'
        ? (rates ? `1 ${st.from} = ${fmt('currency', one, st.to)} · 1 ${st.to} = ${fmt('currency', 1 / one, st.from)}` : ratesError || 'Getting exchange rates…')
        : st.cat === 'temp' ? '' : `1 ${shortOf(st.cat, st.from)} = ${fmt(st.cat, one, st.to)}`;
      const pinned = !!(st.pin && st.pin.cat === st.cat && st.pin.from === st.from && st.pin.to === st.to);
      $('pin').setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(pinned));
      $('pin').title = pinned ? 'Shown on the taskbar button (click to stop)' : 'Show this rate on the taskbar button';

      // The same amount in a few other units.
      const pool = st.cat === 'currency' ? ALSO_CURRENCIES : CATS[st.cat].also;
      const others = pool.filter((u) => u !== st.from && u !== st.to && unitsOf(st.cat).includes(u)).slice(0, 6);
      $('also').hidden = !others.length || !Number.isFinite(v) || (st.cat === 'currency' && !rates);
      $('alsoTitle').textContent = `${st.amount || 0} ${shortOf(st.cat, st.from)} is also`;
      $('alsoList').replaceChildren(...others.map((u) => {
        const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button';
        const big = document.createElement('b'); big.textContent = fmt(st.cat, convert(st.cat, v, st.from, u), u);
        const small = document.createElement('small'); small.textContent = labelOf(st.cat, u);
        b.append(big, small);
        b.title = `Convert to ${small.textContent}`;
        b.addEventListener('click', () => { st.to = u; draw(); save(); });
        return b;
      }));

      $('status').textContent = st.cat === 'currency'
        ? (rates ? `Rates from ${new Date(rates.at).toLocaleString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}` : ratesError ? "Couldn't get rates" : 'Getting rates…')
        : 'Works offline';
      $('refresh').hidden = st.cat !== 'currency';
      const title = pinText();
      if (title !== lastTitle) { document.title = title; lastTitle = title; }
    }

    // ---------- exchange rates ----------
    async function getJson(url) {
      const r = await api.request({ url });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('status ' + r.status);
      return JSON.parse(r.text);
    }
    async function getRates() {
      try {
        const j = await getJson('https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD');
        if (j.result === 'success' && j.rates && j.rates.GBP) return { at: (j.time_last_update_unix || Date.now() / 1000) * 1000, base: 'USD', rates: j.rates };
      } catch (e) { api.log(`open.er-api failed: ${e.message}`); }
      const j = await getJson('https://api.frankfurter.dev/v1/latest?base=USD');
      if (!j.rates) throw new Error('no rates');
      return { at: Date.parse(j.date) || Date.now(), base: 'USD', rates: { USD: 1, ...j.rates } };
    }
    let fetchedAt = 0;
    async function refreshRates(force) {
      if (!force && rates && Date.now() - fetchedAt < RATE_TTL) return;
      $('refresh').disabled = true;
      try {
        rates = await getRates();
        fetchedAt = Date.now();
        ratesError = '';
        api.store.set({ rates, fetchedAt }).catch(() => {});
        if (force) toast('Rates updated');
      } catch (e) {
        ratesError = rates ? '' : "Couldn't get exchange rates. Check your internet connection.";
        api.log(`rates failed: ${e.message}`);
        if (force) toast("Couldn't update the rates");
      } finally {
        $('refresh').disabled = false;
        draw();
      }
    }
    window.refreshRates = refreshRates;

    // ---------- events ----------
    $('cats').replaceChildren(...Object.entries(CATS).map(([k, c]) => {
      const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'chip'; b.dataset.cat = k; b.textContent = c.name;
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      b.addEventListener('click', () => { if (st.cat === k) return; st.cat = k; [st.from, st.to] = DEFAULTS[k]; $('ask').value = ''; $('msg').textContent = ''; draw(); save(); });
      return b;
    }));
    $('amount').addEventListener('input', () => { st.amount = $('amount').value; draw(); save(); });
    $('from').addEventListener('change', () => { st.from = $('from').value; draw(); save(); });
    $('to').addEventListener('change', () => { st.to = $('to').value; draw(); save(); });
    $('swap').addEventListener('click', () => { [st.from, st.to] = [st.to, st.from]; draw(); save(); });
    $('pin').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const same = st.pin && st.pin.cat === st.cat && st.pin.from === st.from && st.pin.to === st.to;
      st.pin = same ? null : { cat: st.cat, from: st.from, to: st.to };
      toast(same ? 'Removed from the button' : 'Showing on the taskbar button');
      draw(); save();
    });
    $('refresh').addEventListener('click', () => refreshRates(true));
    let toastTimer = 0;
    function toast(t) { const el = $('toast'); el.textContent = t; el.classList.add('show'); clearTimeout(toastTimer); toastTimer = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('show'), 1600); }
    async function copyResult() {
      const text = $('result').textContent;
      if (!text || text === '–') return;
      try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); toast('Copied'); } catch { toast("Couldn't copy"); }
    }
    $('result').addEventListener('click', copyResult);
    $('result').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); copyResult(); } });
    window.addEventListener('mini-panel', (e) => { if (e.detail === 'shown') { refreshRates(false); setTimeout(() => { $('ask').focus(); $('ask').select(); }, 50); } });
    window.addEventListener('online', () => refreshRates(false));

    (async () => {
      try {
        const got = await api.store.get();
        if (got.cat && CATS[got.cat]) st = { ...st, cat: got.cat, from: got.from || st.from, to: got.to || st.to, amount: got.amount != null ? String(got.amount) : st.amount, pin: got.pin || null };
        if (got.rates && got.rates.rates) { rates = got.rates; fetchedAt = got.fetchedAt || 0; }
      } catch {}
      draw();
      refreshRates(false);
      setInterval(() => refreshRates(false), 30 * 60 * 1000);
    })();
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

apps.label: Battery
apps.description: Battery levels in one place: this laptop, connected Bluetooth headphones and speakers, and Logitech mice and keyboards on a receiver. The button can show whichever is lowest, so you charge things before they die.

title.labelOption: Show the lowest battery on the button

  <style>
    /* The hub theme (src/theme.css) is inlined at the marker below when the library is built. */
    /* Mini Apps theme: Apple Human Interface Guidelines. System colours in light and dark (follows Windows' app mode),

   the iOS type scale, 8pt spacing, concentric radii and Apple's standard easing. No glass: solid surfaces only.
   Shared by the software centre and every panel. The library build inlines this file into each app page
   at its theme marker, so pages stay self-contained; they then set --primary etc. to their own system colour. */
@font-face {
  font-family: "Inter var"; font-style: normal; font-weight: 100 900; font-display: block;
  src: url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");
}
:root {
  color-scheme: light dark;

  /* Apple system colours, light. "-text" variants are the accessible shades for text on light backgrounds. */
  --blue: #007aff;   --blue-text: #0066cc;
  --green: #34c759;  --green-text: #248a3d;
  --red: #ff3b30;    --red-text: #d70015;
  --orange: #ff9500; --orange-text: #c93400;
  --yellow: #ffcc00; --yellow-text: #a05a00;
  --indigo: #5856d6; --indigo-text: #3634a3;
  --purple: #af52de; --purple-text: #8944ab;
  --pink: #ff2d55;   --pink-text: #d30f45;
  --cyan: #32ade6;   --cyan-text: #0071a4;
  --mint: #00c7be;   --mint-text: #0c817b;

  /* Surfaces, in the order they stack: window, grouped content, controls on content. */
  --bg: #f5f5f7;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --surface-2: #f2f2f4;
  --surface-3: #e8e8ed;
  --fill: rgba(120, 120, 128, .12);      /* resting control fill (segmented track, search fields) */
  --fill-2: rgba(120, 120, 128, .2);     /* hover */
  --line: rgba(60, 60, 67, .13);         /* hairline separators and card edges */
  --line-strong: rgba(60, 60, 67, .29);  /* Apple's separator */
  --text: #1d1d1f;
  --muted: #6e6e73;                      /* secondary label, 4.9:1 on white */
  --faint: #76767b;                      /* tertiary, small labels only, 4.5:1 on white */

  --primary: var(--blue);   --primary-hover: #0077ed; --on-primary: #ffffff; --primary-text: var(--blue-text);
  --primary-tint: rgba(0, 122, 255, .1);
  --teal: var(--green);     --on-teal: #ffffff;       --teal-text: var(--green-text);  /* switches on, success */
  --danger: var(--red);     --danger-text: var(--red-text);

  --shadow-1: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04), 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
  --shadow-2: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
  --shadow-pop: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .1), 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .14), 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06);
  --knob-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
  --focus-ring: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 45%, transparent);   /* follows each app's accent */
  --scrim: rgba(0, 0, 0, .32);

  /* 8pt grid, concentric radii (inner + padding = outer). */
  --space-1: 4px; --space-2: 8px; --space-3: 12px; --space-4: 16px; --space-5: 20px; --space-6: 24px; --space-8: 32px;
  --radius-xs: 6px; --radius-sm: 8px; --radius: 12px; --radius-lg: 16px; --radius-xl: 20px; --radius-full: 999px;

  /* Motion: Apple's default curve and a soft spring-like ease-out (no overshoot on UI chrome). */
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.25, .1, .25, 1);
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1);
  --fast: 180ms;
  --normal: 280ms;

  /* Type: iOS scale. Body text is 14px here (desktop panels), titles follow the scale above it. */
  --font: "SF Pro Text", "Inter var", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-display: "SF Pro Display", "Inter var", "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --mono: "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace;
  --text-caption2: 11px; --text-caption: 12px; --text-footnote: 13px; --text-body: 14px; --text-callout: 15px;
  --text-headline: 17px; --text-title3: 20px; --text-title2: 22px; --text-title1: 28px; --text-large: 34px;
  --track-display: -.022em;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --blue: #0a84ff;   --blue-text: #2997ff;
    --green: #30d158;  --green-text: #30d158;
    --red: #ff453a;    --red-text: #ff6961;
    --orange: #ff9f0a; --orange-text: #ffb340;

    --primary-hover: #409cff;
    --primary-tint: rgba(10, 132, 255, .18);

    --shadow-1: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .06), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3);
    --shadow-2: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .08), 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
    --shadow-pop: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .12), 0 12px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
    --knob-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .16);
    --scrim: rgba(0, 0, 0, .5);
  }
}
html { font-family: var(--font); letter-spacing: -.006em; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { transition-duration: 0ms !important; animation-duration: 0ms !important; }
}
/* Keyboard focus: Apple's soft accent ring on controls. Text fields show focus on their own rounded field instead
   (pages use :focus-within on the wrapper), so the ring never lands on a bare input inside a styled box. */
:where(button, a, summary, select, [tabindex], [role="button"], [role="tab"], [role="radio"], [role="switch"], input[type="checkbox"], input[type="radio"], input[type="range"]):focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); }
:where(input, textarea):focus { outline: none; }
::selection { background: var(--primary-tint); }

    :root { --primary: var(--green); --primary-text: var(--green-text); --on-primary: #fff; --mid: var(--orange); --mid-text: var(--orange-text); --low: var(--red); --low-text: var(--red-text); }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { transition-duration: 0ms !important; animation: none !important; } }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; }
    body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font: 14px/1.45 var(--font); display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
    button { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
    .ui { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; flex: none; }
    [hidden] { display: none !important; }

    main { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
    .dev { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr auto; grid-template-rows: auto auto; column-gap: 12px; row-gap: 8px; align-items: center;
      padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid transparent; box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); }
    .dev .ico { grid-row: 1 / 3; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-2); display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--muted); }
    .dev .name { font-weight: 600; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .dev .pct { font: 600 18px/1 var(--font-display); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
    .dev .pct svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: var(--mid); stroke: none; }
    .bar { grid-column: 2 / 4; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--surface-3); overflow: hidden; }
    .bar i { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--primary); transition: width 400ms ease-out; }
    .dev.mid .bar i { background: var(--mid); }
    .dev.low .bar i { background: var(--low); }
    .dev.low .pct { color: var(--low); }
    .dev .sub { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; }
    .dev.nolevel .pct { font: 600 12px/1.2 var(--font); color: var(--primary-text); }
    .dev.nolevel .bar { display: none; }
    .dev.nolevel { grid-template-rows: auto; }
    .dev.asleep { opacity: .62; }

    .empty { margin: auto; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); max-width: 290px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 20px 0; }
    .empty .ui { width: 40px; height: 40px; color: var(--faint); }
    .empty b { color: var(--text); font-size: 15px; }
    .empty p { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; }
    .skel { flex: none; height: 78px; border-radius: var(--radius); background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--surface) 0%, var(--surface-2) 50%, var(--surface) 100%); background-size: 200% 100%; animation: shimmer 1.4s infinite; }
    @keyframes shimmer { to { background-position: -200% 0; } }

    .note { color: var(--faint); font-size: 12px; margin: 6px 2px 0; }
    footer { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--faint); font-size: 12px; }
    footer span { flex: 1; }
    footer button { border: 0; background: none; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; padding: 4px; }
    footer button:hover { color: var(--text); }
    footer button:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: default; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <main id="main" aria-live="polite"><div class="skel"></div><div class="skel"></div></main>
  <footer><span id="status"></span><button type="button" id="refresh">Check now</button></footer>
  <script>
  (() => {
    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
    const api = window.miniPage;
    const LOW = 20, MID = 40;
    const ICONS = {
      laptop: '<path d="M5 6h14v9H5zM3 18h18"/>',
      headphones: '<path d="M4 15v-3a8 8 0 0 1 16 0v3"/><rect x="3" y="14" width="4" height="6" rx="1.5"/><rect x="17" y="14" width="4" height="6" rx="1.5"/>',
      buds: '<path d="M8 4a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v2a3 3 0 0 0 3 3v8M16 4a3 3 0 0 1 3 3v2a3 3 0 0 1-3 3v8"/>',
      mouse: '<rect x="7" y="3" width="10" height="18" rx="5"/><path d="M12 7v3"/>',
      keyboard: '<rect x="2" y="6" width="20" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M6 10h.01M10 10h.01M14 10h.01M18 10h.01M7 14h10"/>',
      gamepad: '<path d="M7 8h10a4 4 0 0 1 4 4v1a3 3 0 0 1-5.2 2l-1.3-1.3h-5l-1.3 1.3A3 3 0 0 1 3 13v-1a4 4 0 0 1 4-4z"/><path d="M8 11v3M6.5 12.5h3M16 12h.01M18 11h.01"/>',
      phone: '<rect x="7" y="2" width="10" height="20" rx="2"/><path d="M11 18h2"/>',
      speaker: '<rect x="5" y="2" width="14" height="20" rx="3"/><circle cx="12" cy="14" r="3.5"/><path d="M12 6.5h.01"/>',
      watch: '<rect x="6" y="6" width="12" height="12" rx="3"/><path d="M9 6l1-3h4l1 3M9 18l1 3h4l1-3"/>',
      pen: '<path d="M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4z"/>',
      device: '<rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="3"/><path d="M9 12h6"/>',
      plug: '<path d="M9 2v6M15 2v6M6 8h12v3a6 6 0 0 1-12 0zM12 17v5"/>',
    };
    const svg = (name) => `<svg class="ui" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">${ICONS[name] || ICONS.device}</svg>`;
    function kindOf(d) {
      if (d.kind === 'pc') return 'laptop';
      const n = d.name.toLowerCase(), c = (d.cls || '').toLowerCase();
      if (/buds|airpods|earbud|wf-|beats (fit|studio buds|solo buds)/.test(n)) return 'buds';
      if (/headphone|headset|wh-|bose|qc\d|jabra|sennheiser|momentum|soundcore|jbl (live|tune)|arctis|hyperx cloud/.test(n)) return 'headphones';
      if (/mouse|mx (master|anywhere)|trackball|deathadder|viper|basilisk/.test(n)) return 'mouse';
      if (/keyboard|mx keys|\bkeys\b/.test(n)) return 'keyboard';
      if (/controller|xbox|dualsense|dualshock|gamepad|joy-con/.test(n)) return 'gamepad';
      if (/\bpen\b|stylus/.test(n)) return 'pen';
      if (/watch|\bband\b|fitbit/.test(n)) return 'watch';
      if (/speaker|boom|\bflip\b|soundlink|sonos/.test(n)) return 'speaker';
      if (/iphone|pixel|galaxy s|phone/.test(n)) return 'phone';
      if (d.type === 'pc') return 'laptop';
      if (d.type && ICONS[d.type]) return d.type;
      if (c === 'audioendpoint' || c === 'media') return 'headphones';
      if (c === 'mouse') return 'mouse';
      if (c === 'keyboard') return 'keyboard';
      return 'device';
    }
    const short = (n) => (n.length > 16 ? n.slice(0, 15).trim() + '…' : n);

    let list = null, error = '', checkedAt = 0, busy = false, lastTitle = '';
    // Remember receiver devices, so a mouse that's asleep still shows its last level.
    const KEEP = 12 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    function remember(now) {
      let seen = {};
      try { seen = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('seen') || '{}') || {}; } catch {}
      const names = new Set(now.map((d) => d.name.toLowerCase()));
      for (const d of now) if (d.kind === 'logitech') seen[d.name.toLowerCase()] = { ...d, at: Date.now() };
      const out = [...now];
      for (const [k, d] of Object.entries(seen)) {
        if (Date.now() - d.at > KEEP) { delete seen[k]; continue; }
        if (!names.has(k)) out.push({ ...d, asleep: true, charging: false });
      }
      try { localStorage.setItem('seen', JSON.stringify(seen)); } catch {}
      return out;
    }
    const hm = (t) => new Date(t).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    function draw() {
      const main = $('main');
      $('status').textContent = busy ? 'Checking…' : checkedAt ? `Checked ${new Date(checkedAt).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}` : '';
      if (list === null) return;   // first check still running: keep the placeholders
      if (!list.length) {
        const box = document.createElement('div'); box.className = 'empty';
        box.innerHTML = svg('plug');
        const b = document.createElement('b'); b.textContent = error ? "Couldn't check the batteries" : 'No batteries to show';
        const p = document.createElement('p');
        p.textContent = error || "No connected Bluetooth devices, Logitech receivers or PC battery found. Switch a device on, or connect it, then check again.";
        box.append(b, p);
        main.replaceChildren(box);
      } else {
        // This PC first, then the rest, lowest first.
        const lv = (d) => (d.level == null ? 101 : d.level) + (d.asleep ? 200 : 0);
        const sorted = [...list].sort((a, b) => (b.kind === 'pc') - (a.kind === 'pc') || lv(a) - lv(b));
        main.replaceChildren(...sorted.map((d) => {
          const row = document.createElement('div');
          const has = d.level != null;
          row.className = `dev${!has ? ' nolevel' : d.level <= LOW ? ' low' : d.level <= MID ? ' mid' : ''}${d.asleep ? ' asleep' : ''}`;
          row.setAttribute('role', 'group');
          row.setAttribute('aria-label', `${d.name}: ${has ? d.level + '%' : 'connected'}${d.charging ? ', charging' : ''}${d.asleep ? ', asleep' : ''}`);
          const ico = document.createElement('div'); ico.className = 'ico'; ico.innerHTML = svg(kindOf(d));
          const name = document.createElement('div'); name.className = 'name'; name.textContent = d.name;
          const via = d.source === 'receiver' ? 'Logitech receiver' : d.source === 'bluetooth' ? 'Bluetooth' : '';
          const subText = d.asleep ? `Asleep · last seen ${hm(d.at)}`
            : d.kind === 'pc' ? (d.charging ? 'Charging' : 'On battery')
            : !has ? "Doesn't share its battery level"
            : d.charging ? 'Charging' : d.full ? 'Fully charged'
            : d.level <= LOW ? 'Needs charging soon' : [via, d.approx ? 'approximate' : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
          if (subText) { const s = document.createElement('div'); s.className = 'sub'; s.textContent = subText; name.append(s); }
          const pct = document.createElement('div'); pct.className = 'pct';
          if (d.charging) pct.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M13 2L4 14h7l-1 8 9-12h-7z"/></svg>';
          pct.append(has ? `${d.approx ? '~' : ''}${d.level}%` : 'Connected');
          const bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.className = 'bar';
          const fill = document.createElement('i'); fill.style.width = `${Math.max(2, d.level || 0)}%`; bar.append(fill);
          row.append(ico, name, pct, bar);
          return row;
        }));
        const note = document.createElement('p'); note.className = 'note';
        note.textContent = 'Bluetooth devices show while connected. Logitech mice and keyboards are read from their receiver.';
        main.append(note);
      }
      // The button shows the lowest battery that isn't charging.
      const low = list.filter((d) => !d.charging && !d.asleep && d.level != null).sort((a, b) => a.level - b.level)[0];
      const title = low ? `${low.kind === 'pc' ? 'Battery' : short(low.name)} ${low.level}%` : 'Battery';
      if (title !== lastTitle) { document.title = title; lastTitle = title; }
    }

    async function check() {
      if (busy) return;
      busy = true; $('refresh').disabled = true; draw();
      try {
        list = remember(await api.devices());
        error = '';
      } catch (e) {
        error = String(e.message || e).replace(/^Error invoking remote method '[^']+': (Error: )?/, '');
        if (list === null) list = [];
      }
      checkedAt = Date.now();
      busy = false; $('refresh').disabled = false;
      draw();
    }
    $('refresh').addEventListener('click', check);
    window.addEventListener('mini-panel', (e) => { if (e.detail === 'shown' && Date.now() - checkedAt > 60 * 1000) check(); });
    if (!api.devices) { error = 'Update Mini Apps (Check for updates) to use this app.'; list = []; draw(); $('refresh').hidden = true; }
    else { check(); setInterval(check, 5 * 60 * 1000); }
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

apps.name: Parcels
apps.label: Parcels
apps.description: Paste a tracking number or link and it works out the courier (Royal Mail, Evri, DPD, Yodel, UPS, DHL, FedEx, Amazon and more). Or connect your Outlook / Hotmail email and it finds the parcels in your delivery emails by itself (read-only). Add a free Ship24 key for steadier tracking through their API (the courier pages stay as the backup). It checks in the background and the button tells you when something's out for delivery.

<body>
  <form id="addForm" autocomplete="off">
    <div class="row"><input id="num" placeholder="Tracking number or link" spellcheck="false" aria-label="Tracking number or link"><button class="add" id="addBtn" type="submit">Add</button></div>
    <div class="row"><input id="name" placeholder="What is it? (optional)" maxlength="40" aria-label="What is it"><select id="carrier" aria-label="Courier"></select></div>
    <div class="hint" id="hint" role="status"></div>

  </form>
  <main id="main"></main>
  <footer><span id="status"></span><button type="button" id="checkAll">Check all now</button></footer>
  <script>
  (() => {
    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
    const api = window.miniPage;
    const CHECK_EVERY = 90 * 60 * 1000;     // background checks for parcels still on the way
    const KEEP_DELIVERED = 7 * 86400000;     // delivered parcels tidy themselves away after a week
    const RULES = 2;                         // bump when the page-reading rules change, so "Delivered" verdicts get rechecked

    // ---------- couriers ----------
    const COURIERS = {
      royalmail: { name: 'Royal Mail', test: /^[A-Z]{2}\d{9}GB$/i, url: (n) => `https://www.royalmail.com/track-your-item#/tracking-results/${n}`, host: /royalmail\.com$/ },
      parcelforce: { name: 'Parcelforce', test: /^[A-Z]{2}\d{7}$/i, url: (n) => `https://www.parcelforce.com/track-trace?trackNumber=${n}`, host: /parcelforce\.com$/ },
      evri: { name: 'Evri', test: /^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{15}$/i, url: (n) => `https://www.evri.com/track/parcel/${n}/details`, host: /(evri|myhermes)\.(com|co\.uk)$/ },
      dpd: { name: 'DPD', test: /^\d{14}$/, url: (n) => `https://track.dpd.co.uk/parcels/${n}`, host: /dpd(local)?\.co\.uk$/ },
      dhluk: { name: 'DHL eCommerce UK', test: /^\d{14}$/, url: (n) => `https://track.dhlecommerce.co.uk/?con=${n}`, host: /dhl(ecommerce|parcel)\.co\.uk$/ },
      yodel: { name: 'Yodel', test: /^JD\d{16,18}$/i, url: (n) => `https://www.yodel.co.uk/track/${n}`, host: /yodel\.co\.uk$/ },
      ups: { name: 'UPS', test: /^1Z[0-9A-Z]{16}$/i, url: (n) => `https://www.ups.com/track?loc=en_GB&tracknum=${n}`, host: /ups\.com$/ },
      dhl: { name: 'DHL', test: /^(\d{10}|JJD\d{10,20}|JVGL\d{8,})$/i, url: (n) => `https://www.dhl.com/gb-en/home/tracking/tracking-parcel.html?submit=1&tracking-id=${n}`, host: /dhl\.(com|co\.uk|de)$/ },
      fedex: { name: 'FedEx', test: /^(\d{12}|\d{15})$/, url: (n) => `https://www.fedex.com/fedextrack/?trknbr=${n}`, host: /fedex\.com$/ },
      amazon: { name: 'Amazon', test: /^TB[ACM]\d{9,}$/i, url: (n) => `https://track.amazon.co.uk/tracking/${n}`, host: /amazon\.(co\.uk|com)$/ },
      usps: { name: 'USPS', test: /^9[2-5]\d{20}$/, url: (n) => `https://tools.usps.com/go/TrackConfirmAction?tLabels=${n}`, host: /usps\.com$/ },
      other: { name: 'Other (17TRACK)', test: /^$/, url: (n) => `https://t.17track.net/en#nums=${n}`, host: /17track\.net$/ },
    };
    const courierName = (k) => (k === 'other' ? 'tracking' : COURIERS[k].name);
    function detect(input) {
      const raw = String(input).trim();
      if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)) {
        let u; try { u = new URL(raw); } catch { return null; }
        if (u.protocol !== 'https:') return null;
        const host = u.hostname.toLowerCase();
        const key = Object.keys(COURIERS).find((k) => COURIERS[k].host.test(host)) || 'other';
        const num = (raw.match(/(?:[?&#/=])([A-Z0-9]{8,30})(?=$|[/?&#])/i) || [])[1] || '';
        return { carrier: key, number: num.toUpperCase(), url: u.href };
      }
      const n = raw.replace(/\s+/g, '').toUpperCase();
      if (n.length < 6 || n.length > 40 || !/^[A-Z0-9]+$/.test(n)) return null;
      // Some formats are shared (DPD and DHL eCommerce UK both use 14 digits): the others are tried if the first doesn't know it.
      const keys = Object.keys(COURIERS).filter((k) => COURIERS[k].test.test(n));
      const key = keys[0] || 'other';
      return { carrier: key, number: n, url: COURIERS[key].url(n), alts: keys.slice(1) };
    }

    // ---------- reading a tracking page ----------
    // Tracking pages all differ, so this reads them like a person would: the first clear status line wins.
    const S = {
      delivered: /(has been delivered|was delivered|is delivered|been delivered|successfully delivered|delivered to\b|delivered on\b|delivered at\b|delivered today|delivered yesterday|parcel delivered|item delivered|order delivered|shipment delivered|signed for by|^delivered\b)/i,
      out: /(out for delivery|with (your|our|the) (driver|courier)|on (its|the) way to you today|arriving today|due today|on the van)/i,
      problem: /(attempted delivery|delivery attempt|we missed you|sorry we missed|failed delivery|could ?n[o']t deliver|unable to deliver|held at|being returned|returned to sender|address (issue|problem|incomplete)|customs (hold|charge|fee)|fee to pay|\bexception\b|\bdelayed\b)/i,
      transit: /(in transit|on its way|on the way|dispatched|shipped|has left|departed|arrived at|at (our|the|a|your) (local |delivery |sorting |sortation )?(hub|depot|sorting|delivery office|facility|centre|center)|received (by|at)|collected|picked up|accepted|in the network|we('ve| have) (got|received)|ready to ship|label created|preparing|processing|information received|shipment information|pre-?advice|awaiting (collection|pick ?up)|on hold for collection|at the delivery depot|clearance)/i,
    };
    const NOT_FOUND = /(no (results|information|tracking)( details)? (found|available)|could ?n[o']t find|can'?t find|not (been )?found|invalid tracking|not recogni[sz]ed|no matching)/i;
    const BLOCKED = /(access denied|captcha|are you a robot|verify you are (a )?human|request (was )?blocked|unusual traffic|enable javascript|checking your browser|just a moment)/i;
    const NOISE = /(will be|to be |should be|expected|estimated|how |when |faq|\?|if you|can i|need help|sign up|track another|get (it|your parcel) delivered|delivery options|choose|preferences|cookie)/i;
    // A bare word or two with no number ("Collected", "Delivered") is usually a step in a progress bar, not this parcel's news.
    const isLabel = (l) => l.split(/\s+/).length <= 3 && !/\d/.test(l);
    const FOOTER = /^(company information|about (us|dhl|royal mail|dpd|evri|ups|fedex)|careers|press( cent(er|re))?|privacy|terms( (and|&) conditions)?|cookie (settings|policy)|follow us|legal|sitemap|quick answers|frequently asked|faqs?)\b/i;
    function lineStatus(line) {
      const l = line.replace(/\([^)]*\)/g, ' ');   // "(1 parcel expected)" isn't a forecast
      if (S.delivered.test(l) && !NOISE.test(l)) return 'delivered';
      if (S.out.test(l) && !/(\?|if you|what does)/i.test(l)) return 'out';
      if (S.problem.test(l) && !NOISE.test(l)) return 'problem';
      if (S.transit.test(l) && !NOISE.test(l)) return 'transit';
      return '';
    }
    function readStatus(text, num) {
      const lines = String(text || '').split(/\n+/).map((l) => l.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()).filter((l) => l.length >= 4 && l.length <= 160);
      const body = lines.join('\n');
      if (BLOCKED.test(body) && lines.length < 40) return { status: 'blocked', text: '' };
      // Lines that mention the parcel's number first (they're about this parcel), then full sentences, then bare labels.
      const N = String(num || '').toUpperCase();
      // Bare labels are only trusted above the site's footer (DHL's footer links to its "Delivered" magazine).
      const foot = lines.findIndex((l) => FOOTER.test(l));
      const top = foot > 0 ? lines.slice(0, foot) : lines;
      const passes = [N ? lines.filter((l) => l.toUpperCase().includes(N)) : [], lines.filter((l) => !isLabel(l)), top];
      for (const pass of passes) {
        // Delivered is final: if any line in this pass says so, that wins over older events listed with it.
        const done = pass.find((l) => lineStatus(l) === 'delivered');
        if (done) return { status: 'delivered', text: done };
        for (const l of pass) { const st = lineStatus(l); if (st) return { status: st, text: l }; }
      }
      if (NOT_FOUND.test(body)) return { status: 'unknown', text: "The courier doesn't know this number yet. It can take a day to show up." };
      return { status: lines.length < 15 ? 'blocked' : 'unknown', text: '' };
    }
    const ETA = /(?:expected|estimated|arriving|due|delivery (?:date|day|window)|get it)[^\n]{0,24}?\b((?:today|tomorrow)(?:[^\n]{0,24}?\d{1,2}[:.]\d{2}[^\n]{0,12})?|(?:mon|tue|wed|thu|fri|sat|sun)[a-z]*,?\s*\d{1,2}(?:st|nd|rd|th)?\s+[a-z]{3,9}|\d{1,2}(?:st|nd|rd|th)?\s+(?:jan|feb|mar|apr|may|jun|jul|aug|sep|oct|nov|dec)[a-z]*|between \d{1,2}[:.]\d{2}[^\n]{0,20})/i;
    // A delivery time slot ("between 17:39 and 18:39", "17:39 - 18:39") on a line about delivery.
    const SLOT = /\b(\d{1,2})[:.](\d{2})\s*(?:-|–|—|to|and)\s*(\d{1,2})[:.](\d{2})\b/i;
    const slotOf = (text) => {
      for (const l of String(text || '').split(/\n+/)) {
        if (!/deliver|due|expect|arriv|slot|window|estimated|between/i.test(l)) continue;
        const m = l.match(SLOT);
        if (m && +m[1] < 24 && +m[3] < 24) return `${m[1].padStart(2, '0')}:${m[2]}–${m[3].padStart(2, '0')}:${m[4]}`;
      }
      return '';
    };
    // "Tuesday 10th November" -> "Today" / "Tomorrow" / "Tue 10 Nov".
    const MONTHS = ['jan', 'feb', 'mar', 'apr', 'may', 'jun', 'jul', 'aug', 'sep', 'oct', 'nov', 'dec'];
    const shortDay = (s) => {
      if (/^(today|tomorrow)$/i.test(s)) return s[0].toUpperCase() + s.slice(1).toLowerCase();
      const m = s.match(/^(?:(?:mon|tue|wed|thu|fri|sat|sun)[a-z]*,?\s*)?(\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)?\s+([a-z]{3})[a-z]*$/i);
      const mi = m ? MONTHS.indexOf(m[2].toLowerCase()) : -1;
      if (mi < 0) return s;
      const now = new Date(); const today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
      const d = new Date(now.getFullYear(), mi, +m[1]);
      if (d - today < -180 * 864e5) d.setFullYear(d.getFullYear() + 1);   // "2 Jan" seen in December
      const days = Math.round((d - today) / 864e5);
      if (days === 0) return 'Today';
      if (days === 1) return 'Tomorrow';
      return d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short' }).replace(',', '');
    };
    const etaOf = (text) => {
      const m = String(text || '').match(ETA);
      let day = m ? m[1].replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() : '';
      const slot = slotOf(text);

        });
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status === 401 || r.status === 403 ? 'Outlook said no. Disconnect and connect again.' : `Outlook said ${r.status}.`);
        const msgs = (JSON.parse(r.text).value || []);
        const since = Date.now() - MAIL_DAYS * 864e5;
        for (const msg of msgs) {
          const when = Date.parse(msg.receivedDateTime) || 0;
          if (when < since) continue;
          const text = `${msg.subject || ''}\n${(msg.body && msg.body.content) || ''}`;
          for (const d of findInEmail(text)) {
            if (mail.known.includes(d.number) || parcels.some((p) => p.number === d.number)) { remember(d.number); continue; }
            const sender = ((msg.from && msg.from.emailAddress && msg.from.emailAddress.name) || '').replace(/\.(co\.uk|com)$/i, '').trim();
            const isCourier = Object.values(COURIERS).some((c) => sender && c.name.toLowerCase().includes(sender.toLowerCase().split(' ')[0]));
            const name = (isCourier || !sender ? (msg.subject || '') : `From ${sender}`).slice(0, 40);
            const p = { id: `p${Date.now().toString(36)}${added}`, number: d.number, name, carrier: d.carrier, url: d.url, status: '', text: '', eta: '', checked: 0, changed: 0, added: when || Date.now(), src: 'email' };
            if (d.alts && d.alts.length) p.alts = d.alts;
            parcels.unshift(p);
            remember(d.number);
            added++;
            api.log(`email: added a ${d.carrier} parcel (${d.how})`);
          }
        }
        mail.scanned = Date.now();
        if (added) { save(); draw(); checkDue(false); }
        if (byHand || added) mailNote = added ? `Found ${added} parcel${added === 1 ? '' : 's'} in your email` : 'No new parcels in your email';
        if (mailNote) setTimeout(() => { mailNote = ''; drawMail(); }, 6000);
      } catch (e) {
        mailNote = `Couldn't look: ${String(e.message).replace(/^Error invoking remote method '[^']+': (Error: )?/, '')}`;
        api.log(`email scan failed: ${e.message}`);
      }
      mailSave();
      mailBusy = false; drawMail();
    }
    async function initMail(got) {
      if (got && got.mail) mail = { scanned: Number(got.mail.scanned) || 0, known: Array.isArray(got.mail.known) ? got.mail.known : [] };
      try { canMail = !!(api.accounts && (await api.accounts.available()).includes('microsoft')); } catch { canMail = false; }
      if (!canMail) return;
      try { mailAcct = (await api.accounts.list()).find((x) => x.provider === 'microsoft') || null; } catch {}
      drawMail();
      setInterval(() => { if (mailAcct && Date.now() - mail.scanned > MAIL_EVERY) scanMail(false); }, 60 * 1000);
      if (mailAcct && Date.now() - mail.scanned > MAIL_EVERY) setTimeout(() => scanMail(false), 8000);
    }

    $('checkAll').addEventListener('click', () => checkDue(true));
    window.addEventListener('mini-panel', (e) => { if (e.detail === 'shown') { draw(); if (!parcels.length) setTimeout(() => $('num').focus(), 50); } });

    (async () => {
      let got = null;
      try { got = await api.store.get(); if (Array.isArray(got.parcels)) parcels = got.parcels.filter((p) => p && p.id && COURIERS[p.carrier] && /^https:\/\//.test(p.url)); } catch {}
      initMail(got).catch((e) => api.log(`email: ${e.message}`));
      try { ship24 = !!(api.apiKey && (await api.apiKey.has('ship24'))); } catch { ship24 = false; }
      drawKey();
      // 14-digit DHL numbers added before 1.0.1 point at DHL's global site: they're DHL eCommerce UK parcels.
      let moved = false;
      for (const p of parcels) {
        if (p.carrier === 'dhl' && /^\d{14}$/.test(p.number || '') && /(^|\.)dhl\.com$/.test(new URL(p.url).hostname)) {
          p.carrier = 'dhluk'; p.url = COURIERS.dhluk.url(p.number); p.status = ''; p.text = ''; p.checked = 0; moved = true;
        }
      }
      if (moved) save();
      draw();
      setTimeout(() => checkDue(false), 20 * 1000);
      setInterval(() => checkDue(false), 10 * 60 * 1000);
      setInterval(draw, 60 * 1000);
    })();
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  --line: rgba(60, 60, 67, .13);         /* hairline separators and card edges */

  --primary: var(--blue);   --primary-hover: #0077ed; --on-primary: #ffffff; --primary-text: var(--blue-text);
  --primary-tint: rgba(0, 122, 255, .1);
  --teal: var(--green);     --on-teal: #ffffff;       --teal-text: var(--green-text);  /* switches on, success */
  --danger: var(--red);     --danger-text: var(--red-text);

  --shadow-1: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04), 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
  --shadow-2: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
  --shadow-pop: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .1), 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .14), 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06);
  --knob-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
  --focus-ring: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 45%, transparent);   /* follows each app's accent */
  --scrim: rgba(0, 0, 0, .32);

  /* 8pt grid, concentric radii (inner + padding = outer). */
  --space-1: 4px; --space-2: 8px; --space-3: 12px; --space-4: 16px; --space-5: 20px; --space-6: 24px; --space-8: 32px;
  --radius-xs: 6px; --radius-sm: 8px; --radius: 12px; --radius-lg: 16px; --radius-xl: 20px; --radius-full: 999px;

  /* Motion: Apple's default curve and a soft spring-like ease-out (no overshoot on UI chrome). */
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.25, .1, .25, 1);
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1);
  --fast: 180ms;

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {

    --blue: #0a84ff;   --blue-text: #2997ff;

    --pink: #ff375f;   --pink-text: #ff6482;

    --mint: #63e6e2;   --mint-text: #66d4cf;

    --bg: #161617;
    --surface: #232325;
    --surface-2: #2c2c2e;
    --surface-3: #3a3a3c;
    --fill: rgba(120, 120, 128, .24);
    --fill-2: rgba(120, 120, 128, .34);
    --line: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
    --line-strong: rgba(84, 84, 88, .65);
    --text: #f5f5f7;
    --muted: #a1a1a6;
    --faint: #8e8e93;

    --primary-hover: #409cff;
    --primary-tint: rgba(10, 132, 255, .18);

    --shadow-1: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .06), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3);
    --shadow-2: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .08), 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
    --shadow-pop: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255, 255, 255, .12), 0 12px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
    --knob-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .16);
    --scrim: rgba(0, 0, 0, .5);
  }
}
html { font-family: var(--font); letter-spacing: -.006em; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { transition-duration: 0ms !important; animation-duration: 0ms !important; }
}
/* Keyboard focus: Apple's soft accent ring on controls. Text fields show focus on their own rounded field instead
   (pages use :focus-within on the wrapper), so the ring never lands on a bare input inside a styled box. */
:where(button, a, summary, select, [tabindex], [role="button"], [role="tab"], [role="radio"], [role="switch"], input[type="checkbox"], input[type="radio"], input[type="range"]):focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); }
:where(input, textarea):focus { outline: none; }
::selection { background: var(--primary-tint); }

    :root { --accent: #ff375f; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { transition-duration: 0ms !important; animation: none !important; } }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; }
    body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font: 14px/1.4 var(--font); overflow: hidden; position: relative; }
    button { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
    [hidden] { display: none !important; }

    /* The album art, blurred, fills the background so the panel takes the song's colours. */
    .backdrop { position: absolute; inset: -40px; background-size: cover; background-position: center; filter: blur(40px) saturate(1.4); opacity: .55; transform: scale(1.1); transition: opacity 400ms ease; }
    .backdrop::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 35%, transparent), var(--bg) 92%); }
    main { position: relative; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 22px 22px 18px; gap: 14px; }
    .art { width: min(100%, calc(100vh - 232px)); aspect-ratio: 1; flex: none; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface-2) center / cover no-repeat;
      box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.35), 0 0 0 .5px var(--line-strong); display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--faint);
      transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); }
    .paused .art { transform: scale(.94); }
    .art svg { width: 38%; height: 38%; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .art.has svg { display: none; }
    .meta { width: 100%; text-align: center; min-width: 0; }
    .title { font: 700 17px/1.25 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -.02em; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
    .artist { color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
    .from { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted);
      background: var(--fill); padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 10px; }
    .time { width: 100%; }
    .bar { height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--fill-2); overflow: hidden; }
    .bar i { display: block; height: 100%; width: 0; background: var(--text); border-radius: 2px; }
    .nums { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; margin-top: 4px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .controls { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 18px; }
    .controls button { border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--text);
      transition: background 120ms ease, transform 100ms ease; }
    .controls button:hover { background: var(--fill); }
    .controls button:active { transform: scale(.92); }
    .controls button:disabled { opacity: .35; cursor: default; background: none; }
    .controls .skip { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
    .controls .play { width: 56px; height: 56px; background: var(--text); color: var(--bg); }
    .controls .play:hover { background: var(--text); opacity: .9; }
    .controls svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: currentColor; }
    .controls .play svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; }
    :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

    .empty { margin: auto; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; max-width: 260px; }
    .empty svg { width: 44px; height: 44px; fill: none; stroke: var(--faint); stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .empty b { color: var(--text); font-size: 15px; }
    .empty p { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="backdrop" id="backdrop"></div>
  <main id="player" hidden>
    <div class="art" id="art" role="img" aria-label="Album art"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 18V5l12-2v13"/><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="16" r="3"/></svg></div>
    <div class="meta">
      <div class="title" id="title"></div>
      <div class="artist" id="artist"></div>
      <div class="from" id="from"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="time" id="time">
      <div class="bar"><i id="fill"></i></div>
      <div class="nums"><span id="pos">0:00</span><span id="dur">0:00</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="controls">
      <button type="button" class="skip" id="prev" aria-label="Previous"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 5h2v14H6zM20 5v14L9 12z"/></svg></button>
      <button type="button" class="play" id="play" aria-label="Play"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" id="playIcon"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg></button>
      <button type="button" class="skip" id="next" aria-label="Next"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M16 5h2v14h-2zM4 5v14l11-7z"/></svg></button>
    </div>
  </main>
  <main id="none">
    <div class="empty">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 18V5l12-2v13"/><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="16" r="3"/></svg>
      <b>Nothing's playing</b>
      <p>Play something in Spotify, a browser, or any app, and it shows up here with its controls.</p>
    </div>
  </main>
  <script>
  (() => {
    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
    const api = window.miniPage;
    const PLAY = 'M8 5v14l11-7z', PAUSE = 'M7 5h4v14H7zM13 5h4v14h-4z';
    let now = { has: false };
    let shownArt = null;
    const fmt = (s) => { s = Math.max(0, Math.round(s || 0)); return `${Math.floor(s / 60)}:${String(s % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`; };

    // Where the song is now: Windows says the position at a moment ("at"); while playing, it carries on from there.
    function position() {
      if (!now.has) return 0;
      let p = now.position || 0;
      if (now.playing && now.at) p += Math.max(0, (Date.now() - now.at) / 1000);
      return now.duration ? Math.min(p, now.duration) : p;
    }

    function render() {
      $('player').hidden = !now.has;
      $('none').hidden = !!now.has;
      document.body.classList.toggle('paused', now.has && !now.playing);
      if (!now.has) {
        $('backdrop').style.backgroundImage = '';
        document.title = 'Now Playing';
        return;
      }
      $('title').textContent = now.title || 'Unknown title';
      $('artist').textContent = [now.artist, now.album].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || ' ';
      $('from').textContent = now.appName ? `Playing in ${now.appName}` : '';
      $('from').hidden = !now.appName;
      if (now.art !== shownArt) {
        shownArt = now.art;
        $('art').style.backgroundImage = now.art ? `url("${now.art}")` : '';
        $('art').classList.toggle('has', !!now.art);
        $('backdrop').style.backgroundImage = now.art ? `url("${now.art}")` : '';
      }
      $('playIcon').firstElementChild.setAttribute('d', now.playing ? PAUSE : PLAY);
      $('play').setAttribute('aria-label', now.playing ? 'Pause' : 'Play');
      $('prev').disabled = now.canPrev === false;
      $('next').disabled = now.canNext === false;
      $('time').hidden = !(now.duration > 0);
      tick();
      // The taskbar button shows the song (if "Show the song on the button" is on).
      document.title = now.playing && now.title ? [now.title, now.artist].filter(Boolean).join(' – ') : 'Now Playing';
    }
    function tick() {
      if (!now.has || !(now.duration > 0)) return;
      const p = position();
      $('fill').style.width = `${(p / now.duration) * 100}%`;
      $('pos').textContent = fmt(p);
      $('dur').textContent = fmt(now.duration);
    }

    const send = (cmd) => api.media.control(cmd).catch((e) => api.log(`control failed: ${e.message}`));
    $('play').onclick = () => { now = { ...now, playing: !now.playing, position: position(), at: Date.now() }; render(); send('toggle'); };
    $('prev').onclick = () => send('previous');
    $('next').onclick = () => send('next');
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'k') { e.preventDefault(); $('play').click(); }
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'l') send('next');
      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'j') send('previous');
    });

    api.media.onChange((v) => { now = v || { has: false }; render(); });
    api.media.get().then((v) => { now = v || { has: false }; render(); }).catch((e) => api.log(`media: ${e.message}`));
    setInterval(tick, 500);
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  --text: #1d1d1f;
  --muted: #6e6e73;                      /* secondary label, 4.9:1 on white */
