  --primary: var(--blue);   --primary-hover: #0077ed; --on-primary: #ffffff; --primary-text: var(--blue-text);
  --primary-tint: rgba(0, 122, 255, .1);
  --teal: var(--green);     --on-teal: #ffffff;       --teal-text: var(--green-text);  /* switches on, success */
  --danger: var(--red);     --danger-text: var(--red-text);

  --shadow-1: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04), 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
  --shadow-2: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, .08);
  --shadow-pop: 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .1), 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .14), 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06);
  --knob-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06), 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
  --focus-ring: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 45%, transparent);   /* follows each app's accent */
  --scrim: rgba(0, 0, 0, .32);

  /* 8pt grid, concentric radii (inner + padding = outer). */
  --space-1: 4px; --space-2: 8px; --space-3: 12px; --space-4: 16px; --space-5: 20px; --space-6: 24px; --space-8: 32px;
  --radius-xs: 6px; --radius-sm: 8px; --radius: 12px; --radius-lg: 16px; --radius-xl: 20px; --radius-full: 999px;

  /* Motion: Apple's default curve and a soft spring-like ease-out (no overshoot on UI chrome). */

  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1);
  --fast: 180ms;
  --normal: 280ms;

  /* Type: iOS scale. Body text is 14px here (desktop panels), titles follow the scale above it. */
  --font: "SF Pro Text", "Inter var", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-display: "SF Pro Display", "Inter var", "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --mono: "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace;
  --text-caption2: 11px; --text-caption: 12px; --text-footnote: 13px; --text-body: 14px; --text-callout: 15px;
  --text-headline: 17px; --text-title3: 20px; --text-title2: 22px; --text-title1: 28px; --text-large: 34px;
  --track-display: -.022em;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {

    --blue: #0a84ff;   --blue-text: #2997ff;
    --green: #30d158;  --green-text: #30d158;

:where(input, textarea):focus { outline: none; }

    :root { --accent: #30d158; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { transition-duration: 0ms !important; animation: none !important; } }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; }
    body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font: 14px/1.4 var(--font); overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    button, input { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
    [hidden] { display: none !important; }
    :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

    header { padding: 14px 14px 8px; position: relative; flex: none; }

    .results { position: absolute; left: 14px; right: 14px; top: 54px; z-index: 10; background: var(--surface); border-radius: 12px;

    .results button:hover, .results button.sel { background: var(--fill); }

    .line { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 8px; cursor: pointer; min-height: 56px; border: 0; background: none; width: 100%; text-align: left; border-radius: 12px; }

    .who b .bell { width: 13px; height: 13px; fill: var(--orange); }
    .who b .pinned { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: var(--faint); }
    .who span { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
    .spark { width: 64px; height: 28px; flex: none; }

    .up .chg { background: var(--green); }

    .up .spark polyline { stroke: var(--green); }

      border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }

    .btn:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); }
    .btn.on { background: var(--accent); color: #0b0b0b; }
    .btn.danger { color: var(--red-text); }
    .btn.small { padding: 4px 10px; min-height: 28px; font-size: 12px; background: var(--surface); }

    .empty { text-align: center; color: var(--muted); padding: 36px 20px 10px; display: grid; gap: 10px; justify-items: center; }
    .empty svg { width: 42px; height: 42px; fill: none; stroke: var(--faint); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

    .chips button:hover { background: var(--fill-2); }

    footer { flex: none; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 16px 10px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; }

<body>
  <header>
    <div class="search">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M20 20l-3.5-3.5"/></svg>
      <input id="q" type="search" placeholder="Add a share, fund or coin" aria-label="Search for a symbol to add" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
    </div>
    <div class="results" id="results" role="listbox" hidden></div>
  </header>
  <main id="list"></main>
  <footer><span id="when">Prices from Yahoo Finance, may be delayed. Not advice.</span><button type="button" id="refresh">Refresh</button></footer>
  <script>
  (() => {
    const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
    const api = window.miniPage;
    const CHART = (s) => `https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/${encodeURIComponent(s)}?range=1d&interval=5m`;
    const SEARCH = (q) => `https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v1/finance/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&quotesCount=8&newsCount=0&listsCount=0`;
    const SUGGEST = [['AAPL', 'Apple'], ['NVDA', 'NVIDIA'], ['^FTSE', 'FTSE 100'], ['^GSPC', 'S&P 500'], ['BTC-USD', 'Bitcoin'], ['ETH-USD', 'Ethereum'], ['GBPUSD=X', 'GBP/USD']];
    const BELL = '<svg class="bell" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-label="Alert set"><path d="M12 22a2.5 2.5 0 002.45-2h-4.9A2.5 2.5 0 0012 22zm7-6V11a7 7 0 00-5.5-6.84V3a1.5 1.5 0 00-3 0v1.16A7 7 0 005 11v5l-2 2v1h18v-1z"/></svg>';
    const PIN = '<svg class="pinned" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-label="On the button"><path d="M16 3l5 5-3 1-4 4 1 5-2 2-4-4-5 5-1-1 5-5-4-4 2-2 5 1 4-4z"/></svg>';

    // What we keep: list [{s, n, t, above, below}], pin (a symbol or null), fired {"SYM:above": true}.
    let st = { list: [], pin: null, fired: {} };
    const quotes = {};           // symbol -> { price, prev, pct, cur, time, closes, hi, lo, err }
    let open = null;             // the row that's expanded
    let lastFetch = 0;
    const save = () => api.store.set({ list: st.list, pin: st.pin, fired: st.fired }).catch((e) => api.log(`save: ${e.message}`));
    const esc = (s) => String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"' }[c]));

    function money(v, cur, plain) {
      if (v == null || !isFinite(v)) return '–';
      const digits = Math.abs(v) >= 1 ? 2 : 4;
      if (cur === 'GBp' || cur === 'GBX') return `${v.toLocaleString('en-GB', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}p`;
      if (plain || !cur) return v.toLocaleString('en-GB', { minimumFractionDigits: digits, maximumFractionDigits: digits });
      try { return v.toLocaleString('en-GB', { style: 'currency', currency: cur, minimumFractionDigits: digits, maximumFractionDigits: digits }); }
      catch { return `${v.toLocaleString('en-GB', { maximumFractionDigits: digits })} ${cur}`; }
    }
    const pctText = (p) => (p == null || !isFinite(p) ? '–' : `${p > 0 ? '▲' : p < 0 ? '▼' : ''}${Math.abs(p).toFixed(2)}%`);
    const dir = (p) => (p > 0.005 ? 'up' : p < -0.005 ? 'down' : 'flat');

    // ---------- prices ----------
    async function fetchQuote(s) {
      try {
        const r = await api.request({ url: CHART(s) });
        const j = JSON.parse(r.text);
        const res = j && j.chart && j.chart.result && j.chart.result[0];
        if (!r.ok || !res) throw new Error((j && j.chart && j.chart.error && j.chart.error.description) || `HTTP ${r.status}`);
        const m = res.meta || {};
        const price = m.regularMarketPrice;
        const prev = m.chartPreviousClose != null ? m.chartPreviousClose : m.previousClose;
        const pct = prev ? ((price - prev) / prev) * 100 : null;
        const closes = (((res.indicators || {}).quote || [])[0] || {}).close || [];
        quotes[s] = { price, prev, pct, cur: m.currency, time: m.regularMarketTime ? m.regularMarketTime * 1000 : 0,
          closes: closes.filter((x) => x != null), hi: m.regularMarketDayHigh, lo: m.regularMarketDayLow, name: m.longName || m.shortName };
      } catch (e) {
        quotes[s] = { ...(quotes[s] || {}), err: e.message };
        api.log(`${s}: ${e.message}`);
      }
    }
    async function refresh() {
      lastFetch = Date.now();
      await Promise.all(st.list.map((x) => fetchQuote(x.s)));
      checkAlerts();
      render();
      $('when').textContent = `Updated ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })} · Yahoo Finance, may be delayed. Not advice.`;
    }
    window.refreshQuotes = refresh;

    // ---------- alerts: a level fires once (a notification and a badge) until you clear it ----------
    function checkAlerts() {
      let changed = false;
      for (const x of st.list) {
        const q = quotes[x.s];
        if (!q || q.price == null || q.err) continue;
        for (const side of ['above', 'below']) {
          const lvl = x[side];
          if (lvl == null || st.fired[`${x.s}:${side}`]) continue;
          if ((side === 'above' && q.price >= lvl) || (side === 'below' && q.price <= lvl)) {
            st.fired[`${x.s}:${side}`] = true;
            changed = true;
            try { new Notification(`${x.s} is ${side} ${money(lvl, q.cur)}`, { body: `Now ${money(q.price, q.cur)} (${pctText(q.pct)} today).` }); } catch {}
          }
        }
      }
      if (changed) save();
    }
    const firedCount = () => Object.keys(st.fired).filter((k) => st.fired[k]).length;

    // The taskbar button: a badge for alerts that went off, and the pinned price as its label.
    function setTitle() {
      const n = firedCount();
      let t = 'Stocks';
      const pin = st.pin && st.list.find((x) => x.s === st.pin);
      const q = pin && quotes[pin.s];
      if (q && q.price != null && !q.err) t = `${pin.s.replace(/-USD$|=X$/, '')} ${money(q.price, q.cur, true)} ${pctText(q.pct)}`;
      document.title = n ? `(${n}) ${t}` : t;
    }

    // ---------- the list ----------
    function spark(q) {
      const c = q && q.closes;
      if (!c || c.length < 2) return '<svg class="spark" aria-hidden="true"></svg>';
      const all = q.prev != null ? c.concat([q.prev]) : c;
      const lo = Math.min(...all), hi = Math.max(...all), span = hi - lo || 1;
      const y = (v) => (26 - ((v - lo) / span) * 24).toFixed(1);
      const pts = c.map((v, i) => `${((i / (c.length - 1)) * 64).toFixed(1)},${y(v)}`).join(' ');
      const base = q.prev != null ? `<line x1="0" x2="64" y1="${y(q.prev)}" y2="${y(q.prev)}"/>` : '';
      return `<svg class="spark" viewBox="0 0 64 28" aria-hidden="true">${base}<polyline points="${pts}"/></svg>`;
    }

    function render() {
      setTitle();
      const list = $('list');
      if (!st.list.length) {
        list.innerHTML = `<div class="empty">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 17l6-6 4 4 8-8"/><path d="M15 7h6v6"/></svg>
          <b>Nothing on your watchlist</b>
          <p>Search above for a share, fund, index or coin, or start with one of these.</p>
          <div class="chips">${SUGGEST.map(([s, n]) => `<button type="button" data-add="${esc(s)}" data-name="${esc(n)}">${esc(n)}</button>`).join('')}</div>
        </div>`;
        return;
      }
      list.innerHTML = st.list.map((x) => {
        const q = quotes[x.s] || {};
        const d = q.price == null ? 'flat' : dir(q.pct);
        const fired = ['above', 'below'].filter((side) => st.fired[`${x.s}:${side}`]);
        const hasAlert = x.above != null || x.below != null;
        const isOpen = open === x.s;
        const label = `${x.s}, ${q.price != null ? money(q.price, q.cur) : 'no price yet'}, ${pctText(q.pct)} today`;
        return `<div class="row ${d}${isOpen ? ' open' : ''}" data-s="${esc(x.s)}">
          <button type="button" class="line" data-toggle="${esc(x.s)}" aria-expanded="${isOpen}" aria-label="${esc(label)}">
            <div class="who"><b>${esc(x.s.replace(/=X$/, ''))}${hasAlert || fired.length ? BELL : ''}${st.pin === x.s ? PIN : ''}</b><span>${esc(x.n || q.name || '')}</span></div>
            ${spark(q)}
            <div class="num">${q.price != null ? `<div class="p">${esc(money(q.price, q.cur))}</div><span class="chg">${pctText(q.pct)}</span>` : `<span class="err">${q.err ? "Couldn't load" : 'Loading…'}</span>`}</div>
          </button>
          ${isOpen ? `<div class="more">
            ${fired.map((side) => `<div class="fired"><span>Went ${side} ${esc(money(x[side], q.cur))}</span><button type="button" class="btn small" data-clear="${side}">Clear</button></div>`).join('')}
            <div class="facts">
              <div>Day low <b>${esc(money(q.lo, q.cur))}</b></div><div>Day high <b>${esc(money(q.hi, q.cur))}</b></div>
              <div>Previous close <b>${esc(money(q.prev, q.cur))}</b></div><div>As of <b>${q.time ? new Date(q.time).toLocaleString('en-GB', { weekday: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) : '–'}</b></div>
            </div>
            <div class="alerts">
              <label>Tell me above<input type="number" step="any" inputmode="decimal" data-level="above" value="${x.above != null ? x.above : ''}" placeholder="${q.price != null ? esc(money(q.price * 1.05, '', true)) : ''}"></label>
              <label>Tell me below<input type="number" step="any" inputmode="decimal" data-level="below" value="${x.below != null ? x.below : ''}" placeholder="${q.price != null ? esc(money(q.price * 0.95, '', true)) : ''}"></label>
            </div>
            <div class="acts">
              <button type="button" class="btn${st.pin === x.s ? ' on' : ''}" data-pin aria-pressed="${st.pin === x.s}">${st.pin === x.s ? 'On the button' : 'Show on the button'}</button>
              <button type="button" class="btn" data-move="-1" aria-label="Move up">↑</button>
              <button type="button" class="btn" data-move="1" aria-label="Move down">↓</button>
              <button type="button" class="btn danger" data-remove>Remove</button>
            </div>
          </div>` : ''}
        </div>`;
      }).join('');
    }

    function add(s, n, t) {
      s = String(s).toUpperCase();
      if (!st.list.some((x) => x.s === s)) st.list.push({ s, n: n || '', t: t || '', above: null, below: null });
      open = s;
      save();
      render();
      fetchQuote(s).then(() => { checkAlerts(); render(); });
      const row = document.querySelector(`.row[data-s="${CSS.escape(s)}"]`);
      if (row) row.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    $('list').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const b = e.target.closest('button');
      if (!b) return;
      if (b.dataset.add) { add(b.dataset.add, b.dataset.name); return; }
      if (b.dataset.toggle) { open = open === b.dataset.toggle ? null : b.dataset.toggle; render(); return; }
      const row = b.closest('.row');
      const x = row && st.list.find((y) => y.s === row.dataset.s);
      if (!x) return;
      if (b.dataset.clear) { delete st.fired[`${x.s}:${b.dataset.clear}`]; x[b.dataset.clear] = null; }
      else if (b.hasAttribute('data-pin')) st.pin = st.pin === x.s ? null : x.s;
      else if (b.dataset.move) {
        const i = st.list.indexOf(x), j = i + Number(b.dataset.move);
        if (j < 0 || j >= st.list.length) return;
        st.list.splice(i, 1); st.list.splice(j, 0, x);
      } else if (b.hasAttribute('data-remove')) {
        st.list = st.list.filter((y) => y !== x);
        for (const k of Object.keys(st.fired)) if (k.startsWith(`${x.s}:`)) delete st.fired[k];
        if (st.pin === x.s) st.pin = null;
        open = null;
      } else return;
      save();
      render();
    });
    $('list').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
      const inp = e.target.closest('input[data-level]');
      if (!inp) return;
      const x = st.list.find((y) => y.s === inp.closest('.row').dataset.s);
      if (!x) return;
      const side = inp.dataset.level;
      const v = inp.value.trim() === '' ? null : Number(inp.value);
      x[side] = v != null && isFinite(v) && v > 0 ? v : null;
      delete st.fired[`${x.s}:${side}`];   // a new level starts fresh
      checkAlerts();
      save();
      render();
    });

    // ---------- search ----------
    let found = [], sel = -1, searchTimer = 0, searchSeq = 0;
    function showResults(html) { $('results').innerHTML = html; $('results').hidden = !html; }
    function drawResults() {
      if (!found.length) { showResults('<div class="msg">No matches. Try a ticker like TSLA, a company name, or a coin like BTC.</div>'); return; }
      showResults(found.map((r, i) => {
        const have = st.list.some((x) => x.s === r.symbol);
        return `<button type="button" role="option" class="${i === sel ? 'sel' : ''}" data-i="${i}" aria-selected="${i === sel}">
          <span class="sym">${esc(r.symbol)}</span><span class="nm">${esc(r.shortname || r.longname || '')}</span>
          <span class="ty">${have ? 'Added' : esc([r.typeDisp || r.quoteType, r.exchDisp].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))}</span></button>`;
      }).join(''));
    }
    async function search(q) {
      const seq = ++searchSeq;
      try {
        const r = await api.request({ url: SEARCH(q) });
        if (seq !== searchSeq) return;
        const j = JSON.parse(r.text);
        found = ((j && j.quotes) || []).filter((x) => x.symbol && x.quoteType !== 'OPTION').slice(0, 8);
        sel = found.length ? 0 : -1;
        drawResults();
      } catch (e) {
        if (seq === searchSeq) showResults(`<div class="msg">Search didn't work just now (${esc(e.message)}).</div>`);
      }
    }
    function pick(i) {
      const r = found[i];
      if (!r) return;
      add(r.symbol, r.shortname || r.longname, r.quoteType);
      $('q').value = '';
      found = []; showResults('');
    }
    $('q').addEventListener('input', () => {
      clearTimeout(searchTimer);
      const q = $('q').value.trim();
      if (!q) { searchSeq++; found = []; showResults(''); return; }
      searchTimer = setTimeout(() => search(q), 280);
    });
    $('q').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' && found.length) { e.preventDefault(); sel = (sel + 1) % found.length; drawResults(); }
      else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' && found.length) { e.preventDefault(); sel = (sel - 1 + found.length) % found.length; drawResults(); }
      else if (e.key === 'Enter' && sel >= 0) { e.preventDefault(); pick(sel); }
      else if (e.key === 'Escape') { $('q').value = ''; found = []; showResults(''); }
    });
    $('results').addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => { const b = e.target.closest('button[data-i]'); if (b) { e.preventDefault(); pick(Number(b.dataset.i)); } });
    $('q').addEventListener('blur', () => setTimeout(() => showResults(''), 150));
    $('q').addEventListener('focus', () => { if (found.length && $('q').value.trim()) drawResults(); });
    $('refresh').onclick = () => refresh();

    // Every minute, and straight away when the panel comes back after a while.
    setInterval(() => { if (st.list.length) refresh(); }, 60000);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (!document.hidden && Date.now() - lastFetch > 20000 && st.list.length) refresh(); });

    api.store.get().then((got) => {
      st = { list: Array.isArray(got && got.list) ? got.list : [], pin: (got && got.pin) || null, fired: (got && got.fired) || {} };
      render();
      if (st.list.length) refresh();
    }).catch((e) => { api.log(`store: ${e.message}`); render(); });
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

apps.description: Copy on your phone, paste on this PC, wherever you are. Works with iPhone and Android. Scan a QR code once and add PC Clipboard to your Home Screen; after that, open it, tap Paste, and it's on this PC's clipboard, ready to Ctrl+V.     .switch i::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); }
    .switch input:checked + i { background: var(--green, var(--primary)); }
    .switch input:checked + i::after { transform: translateX(18px); }
    .switch input:focus-visible + i { box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); }
    .linkbtn { border: 0; background: none; color: var(--primary); cursor: pointer; padding: 8px 0 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }
    .linkbtn:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
    .linkbtn.confirm { color: var(--danger-text, var(--danger)); }

    .toast { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 52px; transform: translate(-50%, 12px); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; max-width: 90%;
      background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary, #fff); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; transition: opacity 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; text-align: center; }
    .toast.show { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, 0); }
    .toast.err { background: var(--danger); color: #fff; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="top">
    <div class="grow">
      <div class="eyebrow">From your phone</div>

    </div>
    <button class="pill" id="help" title="Connect your phone and settings">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="3" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><path d="M14 14h3v3h-3zM20 14v.01M14 20h.01M17 20h4v-3"/></svg><span>Connect phone</span>

  </div>

  <div class="sheet" id="sheet" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="sheetTitle" hidden>
    <div class="grab"></div>

      <button class="icon-btn" id="closeSheet" aria-label="Close"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg></button>
    </div>
    <div id="sheetConnect"></div>

  </div>

  <div class="toast" id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>

<script>
'use strict';
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const mp = window.miniPage;
const api = mp && mp.phone;
const ICON = {
  open: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M14 4h6v6M20 4l-9 9M18 14v5a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H5a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V7a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h5"/></svg>',
  del: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg>',
  text: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h10"/></svg>',
  link: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M10 14a4 4 0 0 0 5.7 0l3-3a4 4 0 0 0-5.7-5.7l-1 1"/><path d="M14 10a4 4 0 0 0-5.7 0l-3 3a4 4 0 0 0 5.7 5.7l1-1"/></svg>',
  image: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><circle cx="9" cy="10" r="2"/><path d="m21 16-5-5-9 9"/></svg>',
};

let data = { items: [] };
let pair = null;   // { url, qr, listening, error }
let sel = -1;

const cleanErr = (e) => String((e && e.message) || e).replace(/^Error invoking remote method '[^']+': (Error: )?/, '');
function ago(at) {
  const s = Math.max(0, (Date.now() - at) / 1000);
  if (s < 45) return 'Just now';
  if (s < 3600) return `${Math.round(s / 60)} min ago`;
  if (s < 86400) return `${Math.round(s / 3600)} h ago`;
  return new Date(at).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { weekday: 'long' });
}
function el(tag, cls, html) { const e = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) e.className = cls; if (html != null) e.innerHTML = html; return e; }
function describe(x) {
  if (x.kind === 'image') return [ICON.image, `Picture${x.size ? ` · ${x.size.width}×${x.size.height}` : ''}`];
  if (x.kind === 'photo') return [ICON.image, 'Photo (HEIC) · click to open'];
  if (x.kind === 'link') { let h = ''; try { h = new URL(x.text).hostname.replace(/^www\./, ''); } catch {} return [ICON.link, `Link · ${h}`]; }
  const n = x.text.length;
  return [ICON.text, n > 80 ? `${n.toLocaleString('en-GB')} characters` : 'Text'];
}

// The QR code and the three steps, used on the empty screen and in the sheet.
function connectBlock() {
  const box = el('div', 'connect');
  if (!pair || !pair.url) {
    const b = el('b'); b.textContent = pair && pair.error ? 'The phone link could not start' : 'This PC isn\'t on a network';
    const p = el('div', 'warn');
    p.textContent = pair && pair.error ? `Windows said: ${pair.error}. Restarting Mini Apps usually fixes it.` : 'Connect this PC to your home Wi-Fi or network, then open this again.';
    box.append(b, p);
    return box;
  }
  const qr = el('div', 'qr');
  const img = document.createElement('img'); img.src = pair.qr; img.alt = 'QR code to open PC Clipboard on your phone';
  qr.append(img);
  const b = el('b'); b.textContent = 'Scan this with your phone camera (iPhone or Android)';
  const steps = el('ol', 'steps',
    '<li>Tap the link that pops up.</li>' +
    '<li>Add it to your Home Screen, so it is one tap away.<br><b>iPhone</b> (Safari): tap <b>Share</b>, then <b>Add to Home Screen</b>.<br><b>Android</b> (Chrome): tap the <b>⋮</b> menu, then <b>Add to Home screen</b>.</li>' +
    '<li>To send something: open <b>PC Clipboard</b>, tap the box (on Android, press and hold it), then tap <b>Paste</b>. Done.</li>');
  const url = el('div', 'url'); url.textContent = pair.url;
  const warn = !pair.anywhere
    ? el('div', 'warn', 'If Windows asks whether Mini Apps can use the network, tick <b>Private networks</b> and choose <b>Allow</b>. Your phone needs to be on the same Wi-Fi.')
    : pair.relayConnected
      ? el('div', 'warn', 'Works on any Wi-Fi or mobile data. Made a Home Screen icon before 1.1.1? Scan this again and add the new one so it works away from home too.')
      : el('div', 'warn', 'Can\'t reach the Mini Apps relay right now, so your phone can\'t connect yet. Check this PC is online.');
  box.append(qr, b, steps, url, warn);
  return box;
}

function row(x, i) {
  const r = el('div', `row${i === sel ? ' sel' : ''}`);
  r.setAttribute('role', 'option');
  r.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(i === sel));
  const main = el('button', 'main');
  main.title = x.kind === 'photo' ? 'Click to open' : 'Click to copy';
  if (x.kind === 'image') {
    const img = document.createElement('img');
    img.className = 'thumb'; img.alt = 'Picture sent from your phone'; img.src = x.thumb;
    main.append(img);
  } else if (x.kind === 'photo') {
    const p = el('div', 'photo', ICON.image); p.append(document.createTextNode(x.id)); main.append(p);
  } else {
    const t = el('div', `text${x.kind === 'link' ? ' link' : ''}`);
    t.textContent = x.text.length > 800 ? `${x.text.slice(0, 800)}…` : x.text;
    main.append(t);
  }
  const [icon, what] = describe(x);
  const meta = el('div', 'meta', icon);
  meta.append(document.createTextNode(`${what} · ${ago(x.time)}`));
  main.append(meta);
  main.addEventListener('click', () => use(x));
  main.addEventListener('focus', () => select(i, false));

  const acts = el('div', 'acts');
  if (x.kind !== 'text') {
    const open = el('button', 'open', ICON.open);
    open.title = x.kind === 'link' ? 'Open in your browser' : 'Open'; open.setAttribute('aria-label', open.title);
    open.addEventListener('click', () => act(() => api.open(x.id)));
    acts.append(open);
  }
  const del = el('button', 'del', ICON.del);
  del.title = 'Remove'; del.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Remove');
  del.addEventListener('click', () => act(() => api.remove(x.id)));
  acts.append(del);
  r.append(main, acts);
  return r;
}

function render() {
  const list = $('list');
  list.textContent = '';
  if (sel >= data.items.length) sel = data.items.length - 1;
  if (!data.items.length) list.append(connectBlock());
  else {
    list.append(el('h4', null, 'Latest'));
    list.append(row(data.items[0], 0));
    if (data.items.length > 1) { list.append(el('h4', null, 'Earlier')); data.items.slice(1).forEach((x, k) => list.append(row(x, k + 1))); }
  }
  $('sheetConnect').replaceChildren(connectBlock());
}

function select(i, scroll = true) {
  sel = Math.max(-1, Math.min(i, data.items.length - 1));
  const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.row');
  rows.forEach((r, k) => { r.classList.toggle('sel', k === sel); r.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(k === sel)); });
  if (rows[sel] && scroll) rows[sel].scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
}

let toastTimer;
function toast(msg, err) {
  const t = $('toast');
  t.textContent = msg; t.classList.toggle('err', !!err); t.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(toastTimer); toastTimer = setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), err ? 3200 : 1800);
}
async function act(fn, ok) {
  try { await fn(); if (ok) toast(ok); } catch (e) { toast(cleanErr(e), true); }
  await refresh();
}
function use(x) {
  if (x.kind === 'photo') return act(() => api.open(x.id));
  return act(() => api.copy(x.id, true), 'Copied');
}
async function refresh() {
  if (!api) return;
  try { [data, pair] = await Promise.all([api.list(), api.pair()]); } catch { return; }
  if (pair && pair.anywhere) $('footNote').textContent = 'Works anywhere, encrypted between your phone and this PC. Items are deleted after a week.';
  render();
}

// ---------- sheet ----------
function openSheet() {
  $('sheet').hidden = false;
  requestAnimationFrame(() => { $('sheet').classList.add('open'); $('scrim').classList.add('open'); $('closeSheet').focus(); });
}
function closeSheet() {
  $('sheet').classList.remove('open'); $('scrim').classList.remove('open');
  setTimeout(() => { if (!$('sheet').classList.contains('open')) $('sheet').hidden = true; }, 260);
  disarm();
}
$('help').addEventListener('click', openSheet);
$('closeSheet').addEventListener('click', closeSheet);
$('scrim').addEventListener('click', closeSheet);
let armed = null;
function disarm() { clearTimeout(armed); armed = null; $('newLink').classList.remove('confirm'); $('newLink').textContent = 'Make a new link (the old one stops working)'; }
$('newLink').addEventListener('click', async () => {
  if (!armed) { $('newLink').classList.add('confirm'); $('newLink').textContent = 'Sure? Your phone will need to scan again'; armed = setTimeout(disarm, 4000); return; }
  disarm();
  try { pair = await api.newLink(); render(); toast('New link made. Scan it on your phone'); } catch (e) { toast(cleanErr(e), true); }
});
async function saveOpts() {
  try { await mp.store.set({ autoCopy: $('optCopy').checked, notify: $('optNotify').checked }); } catch (e) { toast(cleanErr(e), true); }
}
$('optCopy').addEventListener('change', saveOpts);
$('optNotify').addEventListener('change', saveOpts);

document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (!$('sheet').hidden) { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeSheet(); return; }
  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); select(sel + 1); }
  else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); select(sel - 1); }
  else if (e.key === 'Enter' && data.items[sel] && document.activeElement === document.body) { e.preventDefault(); use(data.items[sel]); }
  else if (e.key === 'Delete' && data.items[sel]) { e.preventDefault(); act(() => api.remove(data.items[sel].id)); }
});

window.addEventListener('mini-panel', (e) => {
  if (e.detail !== 'shown') return;
  sel = 0;
  refresh().then(() => select(0));
});

if (api && api.pair) {
  mp.store.get().then((s) => {
    $('optCopy').checked = s.autoCopy !== false;
    $('optNotify').checked = s.notify !== false;
  }).catch(() => {});
  api.onChange(() => refresh());
  refresh().then(() => select(0));
  setInterval(() => { if (!document.querySelector('.row:hover')) refresh(); }, 60000); // fresh "5 min ago", and the address if the Wi-Fi changed
} else {
  $('list').innerHTML = '<div class="connect"><b>Update Mini Apps</b><div class="steps">This version of Phone Clipboard needs Mini Apps 1.7.1 or newer.</div></div>';
  $('help').disabled = true;
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
